links.title: ImpossibleRubrics: Stress-Testing Generated Rubrics as Reward Signals

evidence: Abstract: 'eleven generators are exploited on 8–26% of an unbiased 150-environment cut' and 'holding one generator's 45 rubrics, attack responses, and judge scores fixed while changing only the Oracle configuration yields 33.3%, 75.6%, and 66.7% exploitation'

§4.1: formal exploitation definition exploited(g,e) iff J(a*) ≥ J(a0) and ¬Hc(a*), with explicit validity conditions and acknowledgment that the attacker is an LLM so rates are 'empirical exploitability under this threat model rather than a theoretical upper bound'
Table 3 (§5): Full-150 leaderboard from Opus 5 at 8% to GPT-5.4-mini at 26%; Hard-45 rates 36–98%; certificate-faithful reference 0/45 vs naive decisiveness proxy 64%
§6.2: safety-prompt ablation leaves residual exploitation (Opus 5 22%, GPT-5.6-sol 36%, Sonnet 5 49%) with unadjusted McNemar p=0.109/0.508/0.039 and single-draw caveats
§6.1/Table 4: rubric resampling (k=3, k=6 for Opus 4.8) with cluster-bootstrap CIs; resampled means drop 7.7–15.8 points; Sonnet≈Haiku not separable
§F: single-rater human calibration, 38/40 agreement, κ=0.89, with explicit note 'There is one rater, so inter-annotator agreement is unmeasured'

§M: frozen-answer Oracle swap across three configurations with paired McNemar/Holm tests; baseline audit finds omitted certificate requirements and a source-attribution discrepancy, so 'agreement does not establish correctness'
§H: per-type analysis on Full-150 showing discrimination concentrated in evidence_insufficient (52–60%) and objective_conflict (16–24%), with false_premise at 0% across generators
Appendix A: build-time provenance contract (158 real_web_grounded + 11 hybrid; 109 verifiable + 60 partial) enforced in CI
§J: best-of-N without adversary — 5/18 environments yield no honest sample, rubric-argmax violates certificate 0/13 times, best-of-N beats random selection by −16.7% [−30.0, −5.6]
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work directly matching top preferences: LLM-as-a-judge, reward hacking in rubric-as-reward RL, adversarial evaluation, and abstention. The contribution is a genuinely new stress-testing angle (attacking generator-emitted rubrics against oracle certificates on evidence-constrained impossible tasks), with a formal exploitation definition (§4.1) rather than a pure application. Rigor is unusually strong: 11 generators on a 150-env unbiased cut plus a selected Hard-45, judge swaps (60/60 verdict stability, §E), held-out attacker (§G), rubric resampling with cluster bootstraps (§6.1), safety-prompt ablation (§6.2), multiplicity corrections (§D, §5), a negative control against degenerate refusal rubrics (§K), and a best-of-N realistic-selection study (§J). The paper is candid that evidence is conditional: Oracle swaps move the same frozen attacks from 33.3% to 75.6% exploitation (§M), the human calibration uses a single rater with 40 items (§F), headline GPT-5.6 rates are k=1 draws, and baseline/certificate inconsistencies were found in audit (§M). Absolute label validity therefore remains open, and discrimination concentrates in only two of six impossibility types (§H), limiting generalizability. Reproducibility is supported by pre-registration, pinned API configs, CI-enforced provenance contracts (Appendix A), and claimed artifact releases, though links are placeholders in the text. Overall a high-quality, highly relevant benchmark paper whose measured magnitudes must be read with its own verification-protocol caveats.

primary_link.title: ImpossibleRubrics: Stress-Testing Generated Rubrics as Reward Signals

recommendations.summary: Language model-generated rubrics are increasingly used as reward signals for rubric-based reinforcement learning, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and automated grading. Such rubrics are reliable only if they reward honest answers over adversarial answers optimized to exploit them. Yet their robustness to such optimization remains poorly understood. We isolate the hardest regime: impossible tasks, where the prompt pressures the model toward an unsupported conclusion, so the only honest response is to
recommendations.summary_zh: 語言模型自動生成的評分準則（rubric）正被廣泛用作強化學習的獎勵訊號、LLM-as-a-judge 評審與自動評分，但其可靠性取決於是否會獎勵誠實回答勝過刻意利用準則漏洞的對抗性回答。本文聚焦「不可能任務」：題目迫使模型給出證據不支持的結論，誠實的回答必須承認衝突或證據缺口。作者建立 ImpossibleRubrics 基準，包含 169 個橫跨六種不可能類型的任務，每個環境附有封閉證據包與可機器驗證的 oracle 證書，明定允許與禁止的主張，另含 48 個可回答的對照題。評測採對抗流程：生成器以中性提示（不透露任務不可答）產出準則，固定攻擊者（Claude Opus）據準則撰寫追求高分的回答，字面評審（Claude Haiku）將其與誠實基準比較，再由 oracle 判定是否違反證書。結果顯示，十一個生成器在無偏的 Full-150 上有 8–26% 的準則被利用，呈現能力分層梯度；在挑選過的 Hard-45 壓力集上最高達 98%（Haiku 4.5）、最低 36%（Opus 5），而忠於證書的固定準則為 0/45，通用果斷回答代理指標則為 64%。穩健性分析排除了評審、攻擊者與組成混淆，但僅更換 oracle 就使同一批凍結攻擊的利用率在 33.3% 至 75.6% 間變動，且共用證書與基準答案瑕疵使一致同意無法視為獨立真值，顯示測得的數字高度依賴驗證協定。此研究揭露自動生成獎勵準則的可剝削性，為 rubric-as-reward 訓練與評測的安全性提供了重要警示與可重用的測試資源。

links.title: Weakening Neurons: An Input-Output Functionality in Transformers with Outsize Influence

evidence: Section 4.2.2 and Table 2 (Appendix E): explicit decision-table taxonomy defining weakening, strengthening, conditional, proportional change, and orthogonal output neurons for gated models.
Section 4.3 and Appendix F: two random baselines (i.i.d. Gaussian vectors and layer-specific mismatched cosines) with empirically confirmed 95% randomness ranges (~[-0.03,0.03] for d=4096, Fig 8).

Table 1: Pearson correlations between cos(w_in,w_out) and gate>0 frequency of -0.91 (OLMo-7B), -0.76 (Gemma-2-2B), -0.59 (Llama-3.1-8B), -0.54 (Llama-3.2-3B), all p<0.01, extending Gurnee et al. (2024)'s GELU-model finding (up to -0.69).
Section 7.1: ablations matched by count (e.g., 526 weakening neurons for OLMo-7B) against random neurons from the same layers; Fig 6 shows weakening-neuron mean-ablation effects on output entropy.

Section 7.2: conditional ablation quadrants reveal that negative gate-value activations (quadrant iii: x_gate<0, x_in<0) strongly sharpen entropy, claimed as first evidence (concurrent with Kong et al., 2026) that negative gate values affect functionality.
Section 7.3: case study with quantitative detail — 'mic' token score boost up to 12 points after ablating a subset of 8 weakening neurons with indirect effects.
Appendix J.3 (Tables 10-13): full per-layer IO class distributions with exact neuron counts for OLMo-1B/7B-0424, Llama-3.2-3B, and Yi-6B.

Limitations section: acknowledges no MoE or >9B models, brittleness of conditional ablations across layers, weight-based method inapplicable to residual-free/hyper-connection architectures, and speculative confidence-management interpretation.

Section 4.4 and Appendix A: code released at github.com/sjgerstner/RW_functionalities and gluscope (visualization site), all experiments runnable on a single A6000 (main analysis <1 min/model, ablations ~300 GPU hours).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM mechanistic interpretability work squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, Transformer architecture, interpretability). It introduces an input-output cosine taxonomy for gated (SwiGLU/GEGLU) neurons, validated across 12 GLU and 24 non-GLU models, with random baselines, matched-layer ablation controls, conditional ablations, and significant correlations (Table 1, p<0.01). Novel findings — late-layer weakening neurons and influential negative gate values — extend Gurnee et al. (2024) beyond non-GLU models. Deductions: threshold τ=±0.5 is somewhat arbitrary, no MoE/>9B models, Dolma-based analyses may mismatch proprietary training distributions (acknowledged), and the confidence-management interpretation is explicitly speculative. Code, data subset, and compute details support reproduction.

primary_link.title: Weakening Neurons: An Input-Output Functionality in Transformers with Outsize Influence

recommendations.summary: We analyze the learned input-output behavior of GLU-based neurons in large language models (LLMs). We propose a simple analysis method: For each neuron, we compute the cosine similarities between its input (reading) and output (writing) weight vectors. In this scheme, a strong negative cosine similarity indicates the neuron weakens the direction it detects in the residual stream, so we call this a weakening neuron. This allows us to gain a number of novel insights. First, we show that nine diffe
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討 GLU 型大型語言模型(LLM)中神經元的輸入—輸出功能。過往研究多聚焦神經元何時活化或寫出什麼方向,本文改從權重層面切入:計算神經元輸入(含 gate)權重與輸出權重間的餘弦相似度,建立分類架構,涵蓋強化、弱化、條件式強化/弱化、比例變化與正交輸出等類別。作者分析 12 個 GLU 模型(如 Llama、OLMo、Gemma)與 24 個非 GLU 模型,發現一致的規律:中前層以條件式強化神經元為主,後期層則出現少數但穩定的「弱化神經元」(輸入與輸出權重呈強負相似度)。後續實驗顯示,弱化神經元雖數量少,活化卻極為頻繁,輸入輸出相似度與活化頻率呈強負相關(OLMo-7B 達 −0.91);消融實驗中,移除弱化神經元對熵、損失與屬性率等指標的影響遠超其他類別或同層隨機神經元。更意外的是,條件式消融顯示 gate 值為負的活化雖小且少,卻對模型輸出有關鍵作用,使弱化神經元反轉為類強化行為,證明 Swish 的負 gate 值不僅影響訓練動態,Swish 無法化約為 ReLU。研究限制包括:純權重分析未必對應語義;消融無法揭示中間機制;條件式消融跨層應用時不穩定;未測試 MoE 或大於 9B 的模型;對信心管理、錯誤修正等解釋仍屬推測。本研究顯示少數神經元可具超乎比例的影響力,提供簡單低成本的機制可解釋性分析工具,並凸顯負 gate 值在 Transformer 運作中的實質角色。

links.title: What Does Layer-Importance Reveal About Transformers and State-Space Models?

evidence: Abstract: 'in every evaluated residual transformer up to 14B parameters, Necessity and Plasticity anti-align across depth, whereas in the evaluated Mamba-style SSMs they point to overlapping regions'
Table 11 (Appendix E.1): per-checkpoint NPA values; transformer mean -0.39 (<=14B, n=8), Mamba mean +0.24 (n=4); L0-share control reported alongside

Appendix E.3 / Table 14: adapter-free full fine-tuning control on 13 checkpoints; rho(full, abl.) sign matches LoRA-based NPA in all 13 cases; four largest checkpoints not retrained 'for compute reasons'
Section 4.5 / Figure 5: top-k placement forgetting p<0.001 (66 pairs) in transformers vs. p=0.45 (54 pairs) in SSMs; Falcon-Mamba-7B marginal p=0.055

Section 7 Limitations: 'The negative-transformer result is established at <=14B; at 32B and 70B the effect is near zero'; hybrid analysis 'rests on a single checkpoint with one attention/SSM ratio'; two-task probe scoped as a mechanism probe, not a benchmark
Appendix C.4 / Table 5: k-sweep across 24 (model,k) points shows verdict insensitive to budget; mean gaps -0.025 (Llama) and +0.005 (Qwen), confirming small margins
Table 7 (Appendix D.1): head-to-head with re-implemented ShapLoRA and TELL-TALE under matched protocol; neither beats random on the two transformer checkpoints
Appendix A, Remark A.5: 'Theorem A.6 does not prove rho_s >= 0 on selective SSMs... The previous formulation overclaimed' - explicit honest scoping of theory
Footnote 1: 'Code, per-layer importance scores, and analysis scripts: https://github.com/chandar-lab/layer-importance-ssm-vs-transformers'
Appendix B.2 Table 1: model coverage spans Qwen3 (0.6B-32B), Llama-3.x (1B-70B), Mamba (130M-2.8B), RWKV6-3B, Falcon-Mamba-7B, Zamba2-2.7B hybrid
Appendix C.1: causal validation repeated under seeds 42/43/44 for six methods on Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology research: layer-importance diagnostics for transformers vs. Mamba-style SSMs, with LoRA/PEFT placement, pruning, and interpretability implications, so it matches several high-weight preferences (LLMs, Transformer Architecture, Interpretability, Training & Optimization). The Necessity-Plasticity Alignment diagnostic and the architecture-conditional sign split are genuinely new relative to single-estimator prior work, supported by a formal appendix whose scope is stated honestly (Remark A.5 explicitly walks back an earlier overclaim). Rigor is strong: layer-0 leave-out, submodule-matched scopes, adapter-free full-FT control on 13 checkpoints, weight-norm normalization, k-sweep, three seeds, EWC and published-method baselines, and statistical tests. Evidence for the diagnostic split is robust (Table 11: transformer mean -0.39 at <=14B vs. Mamba mean +0.24); evidence for downstream consequences is real but modest, and the paper itself flags small causal-validation margins (0.01-0.05, Appendix C.3/E.5). Generalizability is appropriately but genuinely limited: the negative-transformer result fails beyond 14B (Qwen3-32B +0.07, Llama-3.1-70B +0.01), hybrids rest on one checkpoint, and only LoRA/full-FT adaptation procedures are tested. Code, per-layer scores, and analysis scripts are released.

primary_link.title: What Does Layer-Importance Reveal About Transformers and State-Space Models?

recommendations.summary: Transformers and state-space models (SSMs) are the two dominant families of sequence models, and a central open question is how far the analytical knowledge built for transformers transfers to SSMs. We address this through the lens of layer importance which underpins compression, selective fine-tuning, and interpretability across both families. We decompose layer importance into two distinct notions. \emph{Necessity} captures how much the pretrained model depends on a layer's existing contributi
recommendations.summary_zh: 「層重要性」廣泛用於模型壓縮、選擇性 fine-tuning 與可解釋性分析，但這些工具多在 Transformer 上發展，能否直接套用到狀態空間模型（SSM）是本文核心問題。作者將層重要性拆解為兩個概念：Necessity 衡量預訓練模型對某層既有計算的依賴，以旁路該層造成的損失上升量化；Plasticity 衡量 fine-tuning 時模型於何處吸收新資訊，以 LoRA 更新幅度量化；兩者排名的 Spearman 相關即為本文提出的 NPA 診斷指標。結果顯示清晰分歧：所有受評估、參數量至 14B 的殘差 Transformer 均呈負 NPA，早期層最必要、後期層最可塑；所有受評估的 Mamba 型 SSM 均呈正 NPA，兩種量集中於重疊區域；Qwen3-32B 與 Llama-3.1-70B 則趨近於零。此分歧在排除 layer 0、改用全參數 fine-tuning 的控制下依然成立，並延伸至 RWKV 與混合架構 Zamba2。雙任務遺忘探針顯示：Transformer 中挑選最可塑層會顯著加劇遺忘，SSM 則無此層級效應；作者並以殘差幾何與 Fisher 曲率提出機制解釋。限制包括：重要性定義僅涵蓋消融與更新幅度兩種錨定量測，架構結論限於受評估的 checkpoints，理論依賴簡化假設，遺忘實驗亦僅為雙任務機制探針而非完整基準。本文指出層重要性並非與架構無關的普適排序，Transformer 校準的工具套用於 SSM 或混合架構時可能默默失效，應視為量測問題，並依架構調整 adapter 放置與正則化策略。
recommendations.title: What Does Layer-Importance Reveal About Transformers and State-Space Models?
recommendations.title_zh: 層重要性揭示了 Transformer 與狀態空間模型的哪些資訊？

links.title: Right Direction, Wrong Step: Geometric Analysis of Finite-Step Failure in Looped Transformers

evidence: Abstract: 'A fixed quarter step recovers positive gains in reference utility for 72.2-83.2% of selected failures across four settings', with quadratic selection raising recovery from 71.0% to 94.2% on Ouro-1.4B/GSM8K test (Sec. 5, Table 12).

Sec. 4.2 / Table 1: finite-step failures occur in all nine model-task conditions (1.4-49.2% of harmful updates); adding curvature improves sign accuracy to 97.2-99.9% and reduces MAE by 5.9-29.8x across all nine matched conditions.

Sec. 4.3 / Table 2: predicted vs. empirical scales have Spearman >0.995 and the quadratic rule reduces mean grid regret by more than two orders of magnitude vs. first-order and vs. best hindsight fixed scale.

Sec. 4.3 / Table 15: integrated curvature bound C̄/κ has median 0.058-0.114 versus 2.84-4.61 for the global third-derivative bound and covers numerical scale-error intervals of all 2034 primary updates.

Appendix F (Limitations): interventions scale an already computed proposal and evaluate 'before further recurrence'; accumulation over trajectories, generation quality, and computation cost are left unestablished, limiting practical impact claims.

Appendix E.1: on Ouro-1.4B/HellaSwag, mean utility change at 4→5 is -0.008006 [-0.010838, -0.004991] while option accuracy rises 68.4%→69.2%, showing reference utility and discrete accuracy can diverge, so evidence ties to the utility metric rather than task accuracy.

Appendix E.2: reproducibility support includes fixed seeds (20260904), precision settings (TF32 disabled, FP64 checks), replay differences ≤8.89e-16, and 144 derivative-check passes, but no explicit code or artifact release is claimed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mechanistic/analytical study of looped transformer language models (Ouro, Huginn) for test-time scaling and latent reasoning, directly aligned with high-weight LLM, reasoning, and transformer-architecture preferences. The direction-vs-step-scale decomposition of finite-step failure, pathwise curvature identity, and integrated-curvature error bounds are a genuinely fresh angle relative to overthinking and stability literature, though state-interpolation analysis has partial precedent (acknowledged TRM work). Rigor is exceptionally high: proven propositions, stated assumptions, FP32/FP64 derivative cross-checks, prespecified protocols, bootstrap CIs, and complete benchmark coverage. Evidence is strong within its defined scope (teacher-forced reference utility, immediate post-update effect), but the paper itself shows utility and discrete accuracy can diverge (Appendix E.1) and does not demonstrate end-task generation gains. Generalizability is limited to frozen looped LMs with differentiable readouts; no code release is stated despite unusually detailed numerical protocols and seeds.

primary_link.title: Right Direction, Wrong Step: Geometric Analysis of Finite-Step Failure in Looped Transformers

recommendations.summary: Looped Transformers offer a parameter-efficient route to test-time scaling by reusing shared layers for iterative latent reasoning. However, additional iterations can reduce support for a reference answer, leaving unclear whether an update's direction is locally unhelpful or its full displacement moves too far. We study this distinction by analysing reference utility, which measures this support, along the model's own update direction, varying the fraction of the proposed displacement supplied t
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討 Looped Transformers（重複套用共用層迭代潛在推理的模型）在測試期運算擴增時的現象：多跑一次迴圈反而降低對參考答案的支持。作者區分兩種情況——更新方向本身無益，或方向有益但整步位移走得太遠，並將後者定義為有限步失效。方法上，在凍結模型與固定 readout 下，沿模型自身提出的更新方向以步長 α 內插隱藏狀態，定義參考效用並做路徑曲率分解：初步改善 A 可能被累積曲率校正抵銷。局部二次模型以 A、Q 預測全步增益與效用最大的步長，並以沿路徑積分的曲率變化推導近似誤差與後悔上界。實驗涵蓋 Ouro-1.4B/2.6B 與 Huginn 於 MATH-500、GSM8K、HellaSwag 共九種條件：九種條件皆出現有限步失效，占有害更新的 1.4–49.2%；加入曲率項後全步增益符號準確率達 97.2–99.9%，二次規則步長預測與網格最佳值相關性超過 0.995；固定四分之一步長回復四個設定中 72.2–83.2% 的選定失效，Ouro-1.4B/GSM8K 上的二次步長選擇更將回復率從 71.0% 提升至 94.2%。限制在於分析針對凍結模型、teacher forcing 下的單次更新與立即效用，未延伸至生成軌跡、後續狀態與運算成本。其意義在於指出方向與步長不匹配是遞迴運算喪失進展的機制，啟發除選擇迴圈次數外，也應決定每次更新的套用比例。

links.title: LoopSpec: Pipelined Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers

evidence: Abstract: claims up to 6.83x lossless inference speedup across diverse Looped Transformers; code and project page links provided
Section 5, Theorem 1: restart probability bounded by epsilon_2 independent of d_1 (2*epsilon_2 with gating), proof in Appendix G.1
Section 5, Theorem 2 and Eq. 8: closed-form optimal depths (1.26, 8.85) from power-law envelope (alpha=1.03, beta=0.175), matching empirical best (2,8) for Raven-Llama-3.2
Section 6, Table 1: speedups 2.64x-6.83x and gamma up to 14.86 across GSM8K, MATH-500, BBH, HumanEval+, MBPP+ on 5 base checkpoints
Section 6.3, Table 3: ablation on Raven-Llama-3.2 shows residual second proposal plus gating lifts speedups from 3.24x-4.59x to 3.74x-5.00x over non-residual second proposal
Section 6.3, Figure 4 and Appendix C: LoopSpec beats training-based DFlash (SpecForge, OpenR1-Math-220k, 10k steps) by up to 1.7x under identical SGLang settings
Appendix A, Table 4: exact HuggingFace checkpoint identifiers for all 7 evaluated models; Table 5 lists prompting protocols and generation budgets
Appendix B: branch-wise KV cache reuse and CUDA Graph strategies on a single RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell in BF16
Appendix D, Table 6: gate opening frequency 18.75%-40.40%; effective batch size reduced (e.g., 43.75 to 34.06 mean on Raven-Llama-3.2)
Appendix E: first proposals commit 86.57%-96.31% of tokens, second proposals recover most of the rest, at most 2.95% full restarts
Limitation signal: Section 6.1 notes gamma can overstate wall-clock gains due to pre/post-layer costs; evaluations are single-batch, and Section 4.3 requires d_2 and R divisible by d_1
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-inference methodology paper: training-free self-speculative pipelined decoding for looped transformers, evaluated on standard LLM reasoning (GSM8K, MATH-500, BBH, AIME) and code (HumanEval+, MBPP+) benchmarks with LLM checkpoints (Llama-3.2, OLMo-2, TinyLlama derivatives), fitting LLM, inference/serving, and efficiency preferences. Novelty is solid but incremental within the speculative-decoding lineage (Draft & Verify, LayerSkip, SPEED): the residual second proposal, gating, cascade verification, and closed-form optimal depths via power-law TV decay are tailored contributions rather than a new paradigm. Rigor is strong: two theorems with full proofs (Appendix G), theory-experiment match on depth selection ((1.26,8.85) predicted vs (2,8) best), ablations (Table 3), gate-frequency analysis (Appendix D), and fair DFlash comparison with documented training (Appendix C). Evidence is consistent and quantitative (Table 1: 2.64x-6.83x; Table 2 up to 2.95x), with the lossless property guaranteed by rejection sampling. Generalizability is limited to looped/recurrent-depth architectures and divisibility constraints on depths; single-GPU single-batch evaluation. Reproducibility is high: public code, project page, HuggingFace checkpoint IDs (Table 4), benchmark configs (Table 5), hardware/precision, and pseudocode (Appendix H).

primary_link.title: LoopSpec: Pipelined Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers

recommendations.summary: Looped Transformers achieve strong performance with compact parameter sizes by repeatedly applying a shared stack of Transformer blocks across recurrent depths. However, they incur higher decoding latency than standard Transformer models of comparable parameter size because shared weights are accessed at every recurrent depth. To improve decoding efficiency, self-speculative decoding is particularly well suited to Looped Transformers, as their intermediate recurrent states can directly provide d
recommendations.summary_zh: Looped Transformers 透過在多個遞迴深度反覆套用共享的 Transformer 區塊，以極少參數達到相當效能，但每個解碼步驟都需反覆存取相同權重，使推論受限於記憶體頻寬而延遲偏高。本文提出 LoopSpec，一個免訓練的自推測解碼框架：利用淺層遞迴狀態產生草稿 token，並立即開始後續 token 的運算，與目標驗證形成管線化重疊執行；再從較深層引入殘差式第二提案與閘控機制，在第一提案被拒時提供備援分支，並以級聯拒絕抽樣保證在貪心與抽樣解碼下皆與目標模型分布完全一致（無損）。理論上，作者證明重啟機率僅取決於第二提案深度的近似誤差，與第一提案無關；並利用中間層與目標分布間總變差距離的冪次衰減規律，推導出最佳提案深度的封閉解，與實測最佳設定（d1=2、d2=8）高度吻合。實作上，團隊擴充 SGLang，採用分支層級的 KV cache 管理與 CUDA Graph 最佳化，在 Ouro（R=4）與 Raven（R=32）兩系列共七個檢查點上，於 GSM8K、MATH-500、BBH、HumanEval+、MBPP+ 及 AIME 等基準取得最高 6.83 倍的無損加速，並比需訓練草稿模型的 DFlash 快達 1.7 倍。限制方面，平均接受長度 γ 未計入 pre/post 層的額外成本，過小的 d1 會增加草稿與分支開銷；評估僅於單一批次情境進行，且要求各深度間具整除關係。整體而言，本方法將遞迴深度轉化為 token 位置間的平行度，為輕量迴圈式模型提供無需額外草稿模型或訓練的高效推論路徑。
recommendations.title: LoopSpec: Pipelined Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
recommendations.title_zh: LoopSpec：針對 Looped Transformers 的管線化自推測解碼

links.title: Nameless Tokenization: A Lossless Tokenizer-Level Defense Against Control-Token Forgery in Open-Weight LLMs

evidence: Abstract: 'We audit 256 deployed chat tokenizers. All are forgeable, and the flag usually recommended as a fix leaves 56.6% forgeable because it misses the tool and reasoning markers agent systems rely on.'
Section 2: unforgeability defined as E(t)∩C=∅ for every attacker-chosen t; nameless tokens implemented by serializing the tokenizer, emptying the added-token table, and dropping the post-processor.
Section 3, Table 1: all 256 tokenizers forgeable by default; with split_special_tokens, 56.6% remain forgeable; 16,415 perturbations yield 0.0% reserved identifiers under nameless tokenization.
Section 4, Table 2: every defense reproduces the standard token stream on 100.0% of attack-free host prompts; delimiter fidelity probe 8.5% (none) vs 59.9% (nameless) vs 2.2% (strip).

Section 4, Table 3: forged turn 99.9% (none) vs 92.8% (nameless); forged tool 33.1% vs 7.4%; Section 5, Table 6: on checkpoints lacking training separation, nameless cuts forged system from 98.0% to 66.6%.

Limitations: evaluation covers five models, three host tasks, two objectives; nameless tokenization raises forged-system success from 46.9% to 68.0% averaged over models under the task-only system message; artifact release of renderer, audit harness, attacks, and per-item generations is promised but not verifiable from the text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly in-scope LLM safety/security paper on tokenizer-level prompt-injection defense for open-weight models, directly relevant to LLMs, AI safety, agents/tool channels, and red-team evaluation. Novelty is solid: a formal threat model (Section 2: E(t)∩C=∅) plus a 256-tokenizer audit (Section 3, Table 1: 100% forgeable by default, 56.6% even with split_special_tokens) and a by-construction defense are new angles relative to training-level defenses (StruQ, SecAlign, ISE, ASIDE). Rigor is good: attacks differ only in the delimiter (Section 4), isolating surface vs identifier contributions with bootstrap ranges (99.9→92.8, 91.4-94.1), and losslessness is verified (Table 2: 100.0% identical token streams). Evidence is strong and unusually honest, reporting that nameless tokenization worsens forged-system success from 46.9% to 68.0% under a task-only system message (Limitations). Deductions: deep evaluation covers only 5 models, 296 host items and 200 probe items, with small absolute numbers; reproducibility relies on promised artifact release (Limitations/Appendix B) rather than verified availability.

primary_link.title: Nameless Tokenization: A Lossless Tokenizer-Level Defense Against Control-Token Forgery in Open-Weight LLMs

recommendations.summary: Open-weight language models publish the strings their chat templates use to mark turns, roles and tool results, which the tokenizer maps back to the reserved identifiers the model obeys. Anyone who controls text in a prompt can therefore write a turn boundary indistinguishable from one the serving stack wrote. We audit 256 deployed chat tokenizers. All are forgeable, and the flag usually recommended as a fix leaves 56.6% forgeable because it misses the tool and reasoning markers agent systems re
recommendations.summary_zh: 開放權重語言模型的聊天範本控制字串是公開的,分詞器會把訊息內容中出現的這些字串映射回保留識別碼,攻擊者因此可偽造與伺服器端無法區分的輪次邊界。稽核 256 個已部署聊天分詞器發現全部可偽造;建議的 split_special_tokens 旗標仍留下 56.6% 可偽造,漏洞集中在工具呼叫與推理標記。本文提出無名標記化(nameless tokenization):控制詞表條目只留識別碼而無表面字串,內容編碼器便無法產生控制識別碼;範本層直接寫入識別碼,內容逐字原樣送達,由建構保證通道不可偽造且無損。在五個分詞器家族上,此法對無攻擊資料 100% 重現標準 token 流,主機任務準確率幾乎不變;含分隔符文字的探測由 8.5% 升至 59.9%,遠優於刪除、遮罩或同形字替換等清理式防禦。拆解顯示:純任務系統訊息下,偽造輪次成功主要來自分隔符外觀而非識別碼;但當系統訊息要求將使用者內容視為資料時,關閉識別碼通道正是擋下偽造輪次與工具結果的關鍵,如 Qwen 工具通道由 53.4% 降至 0.7%。限制:評估僅涵蓋五個模型、三項任務與兩種注入目標,絕對攻擊率不宜推及部署風險;無損僅指內容,偽造系統輪次反而更易得逞(46.9%→68.0%);保證僅限文字到識別碼介面,直接提供識別碼的呼叫端不在範圍。此法以近乎零成本關閉提示注入中唯一可獲建構性保證的通道,應成為開放權重部署的預設。
recommendations.title: Nameless Tokenization: A Lossless Tokenizer-Level Defense Against Control-Token Forgery in Open-Weight LLMs
recommendations.title_zh: 無名標記化(Nameless Tokenization):對抗開放權重 LLM 控制標記偽造的無損分詞器層級防禦

links.title: Measuring and Exploiting Implicit Trust in LLM Tool-Calling Pipelines

evidence: Abstract: models with 0% single-channel compliance exfiltrate at up to 100% under two-channel fragmentation (GPT-4o, Llama 70B, Composer 2, Haiku 4.5)

§II-B Table I: prior benchmarks (InjecAgent, AgentDojo, ASB, Unit42) use one channel, no controlled payloads, no fragmentation, no production exfiltration; 'Ours' row claims 5 channels, control, 12 models, fragmentation, production
§III-G: automated scorer validated on 150 sampled trials with Cohen's κ=0.94 and 0 false positives on 150 clean-baseline trials; Wilson 95% intervals used throughout
§IV-A: likelihood-ratio test for channel×payload interaction χ²=366.4, p<10^-50; remains significant excluding FC (χ²=139.9, p<10^-20); Table III shows per-model profile clustering
§IV-B Table IV: two-channel fragmentation raises average compliance from 42% to 82%; only Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.6 resist all fragmentation at 0/20; GPT-5.4 0% in Cursor but 90% three-channel
§IV-C Table V: Sonnet 4.6 transmits .env and PII 20/20 in Cursor but 0/20 in Claude Code; Opus 'data stripping' defense at 10% rate with Wilson CI [3,30]
§IV-D: three-condition sampling experiment (standard/disposition/control) isolates the VS Code sampling systemPrompt as causal variable; models deny the injected override when interrogated
§IV-E Table VIII: routing GPT-5.4 through Claude Code drops compliance 90%→0% via client safety prompt while Gemini models stay at 100%, isolating client- vs model-level safety

§V-A Table IX and text: Invariant Guardrails blocks 2/30 payload-channel combinations; Pipelock bypassed by separating file-access verb from path beyond its 80-character co-occurrence window; no tested tool detects fragmentation
§V-B: prompt hardening zeroes GPT-4o-mini but leaves Gemini at 50-55%, showing prompt defenses are model-specific

Conclusion: anonymous.4open.science artifact with tool and experimental data; Appendix A lists client versions (Cursor 3.1.17, Copilot Chat 0.44.1, Codex CLI 0.124.0, Claude Code 2.1.132) and test window April 13-30, 2026
Limitations noted: GPT-5.4 value-aligned run is n=1 ('production client API costs preclude large-n runs'); §IV-E leaves isolation of individual safety-prompt sections to future work
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/agent-security paper squarely matching multiple high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents & tool use, AI safety, red teaming/evaluation). The cross-channel fragmentation attack and channel×payload trust-profile measurement are a genuine new angle vs. single-channel benchmarks (Table I), though the technique is an increment on known prompt-injection work and value-aligned exploitation is close to classic confused-deputy reasoning. Rigor is strong for an empirical security study: controlled identical payloads across channels, n=30 per cell, Wilson CIs, likelihood-ratio interaction tests, scorer validation (κ=0.94, 0/150 false positives), and temperature/position robustness controls; weaknesses include tiny n=1/n=2 cells for GPT-5.4/Opus sub-experiments, author-only annotation, and an under-specified profile clustering. Evidence is extensive (15,465 trials, production clients, server-side logs, defense bypasses across 7 tools and 3 prompt defenses) but partially rests on an anonymous artifact and single-trial existence proofs. Generalizability is decent (12 models, 9 providers, 3 clients) though the paper itself shows channel authority is model-specific. Reproducibility is aided by versioned client setups and a stated code/data release, but the artifact is anonymous and payloads/defenses depend on fast-moving commercial APIs.

primary_link.title: Measuring and Exploiting Implicit Trust in LLM Tool-Calling Pipelines

recommendations.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables LLMs to invoke external tools, but every tool interaction exposes the model to attacker-controlled text through multiple input channels (tool descriptions, tool results, sampling messages) that share a single context window without privilege separation. In this paper, we present a framework to measure the trust profile of an arbitrary LLM based on a variety of payload framings sent through different channels. Following this assessment, we devise cross-cha
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究探討 Model Context Protocol(MCP)生態系中 LLM 工具呼叫管線的隱含信任問題:MCP 讓模型呼叫外部工具,但惡意伺服器可同時控制工具描述、工具結果與 sampling 等多個輸入通道,而協議未在通道間設立權限隔離。作者提出量測框架,以五種通道搭配六種攻擊載荷框架,為 12 個前沿模型建立通道×載荷的服從率矩陣(信任設定檔),共逾 15,000 次實驗,並在 Cursor、VS Code、Codex CLI 等生產客戶端驗證;據此設計跨通道碎片化攻擊,將惡意指令拆散至二或三個通道,單一通道皆無完整注入。結果顯示,單通道服從率為 0% 的模型(GPT-4o、Llama 70B、Composer 2、Haiku 4.5)在雙通道碎片化下外洩率高達 100%;三通道攻擊使 Haiku 4.5、GPT-5.4 與 GPT-5.5 全數淪陷;連抵抗所有碎片化的 Sonnet 4.6 與 Opus 4.6,也被價值對齊利用(工具聲稱的用途本身需要目標資料)與 VS Code 的 sampling 系統提示覆寫所繞過。防禦分析顯示,七種第三方 MCP 安全工具與三種提示防禦皆無法偵測碎片化載荷,提示防禦效果亦因模型而異。限制方面:研究僅量測工具安裝並核准後的行為,未涵蓋供應鏈社交工程;部分洩漏情境可能被二元評分低估;CaMeL 等架構級防禦尚未在生產客戶端實作。本文證明模型安全取決於訓練與部署環境的共同作用,主張用戶端應檢查跨通道語意關聯、為工具參數標註型別、包覆 sampling 系統提示,並以碎片化攻擊範例強化安全訓練。

links.title: ReFigBench: Benchmarking Scientific Figure Reconstruction as Editable PowerPoint Artifacts

evidence: Abstract: benchmark of 1,000 arXiv overview figures; coding agents from four families under two workflows; GPT-5.5 in two harnesses yielding ten configurations; evaluation combines deterministic artifact checks, two judge families, and blinded human comparisons.
Section 3 (Evaluating Fidelity and Editability): rubric Q = T+S+L+E+V with 20/30/15/25/10 weights; final score s = g(P) * min{Q, c(P)} with 50-point cap for raster pastes.

Section 5 (Capability and the Harness Decide the Return on Workflow Effort): same specialized workflow +3.2 in Codex but -2.2 in Claude Code; harness alone shifts GPT-5.5 by 1.4 points, interval [0.7, 2.2], under identical direct prompt.
Table 3: specialized workflow yields 0 median native connectors in all five pairs (91.8%-100% artifacts without connectors) vs 15-42 median connectors in direct workflows.
Appendix L: Qwen3.6-27B rescoring reproduces GPT-5.4 ranking at Spearman 0.988 / Kendall 0.956; three GPT-5.4 runs move configuration means at most 0.4 points with ICC(2,1) 0.78-0.89.
Appendix M (Table 21): rubric weight sweep over 12 vectors; GPT-5.5/Codex positive effect holds until editability weight 45.8; ranking Spearman never below 0.95 and human-Elo correlation 0.900-0.975.
Appendix J (Table 16): Bradley-Terry Elo from 4,270 valid blinded comparisons over all 45 pairs; Pearson r=0.958 between automated means and human Elo (Appendix J text).

Section 6 (Limitations): judge shares family with the strongest evaluated system; harness comparison covers only GPT-5.5; single task scores vary ~3 points across runs; paired delta bundles library and prompt contributions.
Appendix D (Release plan): MIT-licensed benchmark code with pinned Dockerfiles; CC BY 4.0 metadata; retrieval scripts provided; licenses respected for withheld images.
Appendix N (Table 23): total generation cost $15,484 across ten configurations; per-run costs $0.57-$3.57, grounding the workflow-economics analysis.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong match to the preference profile: a benchmark for multimodal coding agents (Claude Code/Codex harnesses, toolchains) evaluated with LLM-as-judge and human preference, touching agents/tool use, code generation, LLMs, evaluation, and multimodality. Novelty is solid: the related-work table (Appendix A, Table 7) credibly shows no prior benchmark combines a real source figure, editable PPTX artifact, native-object audit, render comparison, and human eval, and the paper operationalizes the harness-as-explicit-factor framing from prior position work. Rigor and evidence are unusually strong for a benchmark paper: paired within-figure workflow deltas with bootstrap CIs (Table 13), three judge runs with ICC 0.78-0.89, a second judge family (Qwen3.6-27B, Spearman 0.988, Appendix L), 4,270 blinded human comparisons fit via Bradley-Terry (Appendix J), and an exact rubric-weight sensitivity recomputation over 12 weight vectors with located zero crossings (Appendix M, Table 21). Limitations are honestly stated: the primary judge shares a family with the strongest evaluated system (Section 6), the harness comparison covers only GPT-5.5, sub-two-point margins are noise-level (72% judge-human agreement vs 59% human-human), and scope is single-page PPTX from four AI arXiv fields with a cs.CV-skewed mixture, which limits generalizability of the specific magnitudes. Reproducibility is well supported (pinned Dockerfiles, frozen CLI versions, judge snapshot, prompts in Appendix E/F, recorded seeds, MIT/CC BY 4.0 release plan in Appendix D), though replication costs ~$15k and needs frontier model access. Not out of scope: this is agent/evaluation methodology, not a pure vision or domain application.

primary_link.title: ReFigBench: Benchmarking Scientific Figure Reconstruction as Editable PowerPoint Artifacts

recommendations.summary: Multimodal coding agents are expected to turn visual inputs into usable artifacts, and they act through a harness, the layer of tools, context management, and execution environment around the model. Existing evaluations often isolate short tool calls, API traces, or screenshot resemblance, and a low score under these proxies cannot say whether the model saw poorly, planned poorly, or was failed by its harness. We study scientific overview figure reconstruction, an agent task in which a source im
recommendations.summary_zh: ReFigBench 針對多模態編碼代理提出新評測：將 arXiv 論文的真實總覽圖重建為可編輯的 PowerPoint 投影片，同時要求畫面相似且原生文件結構完整。現有評測多只檢查截圖相似度或短暫工具呼叫，無法分辨失敗源自模型視覺理解、代理能力，或外層 harness。本文以 ORBIT 流程從四個 AI 領域檢索 1,000 張具完整溯源資訊的總覽圖，讓 GPT、Claude、MiMo、MiniMax 四個模型家族分別以直接產生程式碼與專門 PPTX 工作流重建每張圖，GPT-5.5 另在 Claude Code 與 Codex 兩種 harness 內執行，共十種設定、10,000 份產物。評測結合確定性產物檢查、兩個評審家族（GPT-5.4 與 Qwen3.6-27B）的重複評分，以及盲測人類偏好與 Bradley–Terry Elo 排名。結果顯示：感知仍是瓶頸，迭代渲染只能部分補救；相同的專門工作流在 Codex 內使 GPT-5.5 加 3.2 分，在 Claude Code 內卻減 2.2 分，相同提示下 harness 單獨造成 1.4 分差距；專門工作流在所有設定中都消除原生連接器，使文件退化為圖形，但人類評審仍多偏好其渲染結果。最強設定僅得 77.4 分。限制包括僅涵蓋單頁 PPTX、主要評審與最強系統同家族（已以第二評審家族與人類評分緩解）、harness 對照僅限 GPT-5.5。此研究凸顯保真度與可編輯性之間的張力，並強調回報代理效能時必須揭露 harness，否則只描述了半個系統。

links.title: How Model Growth, Recursion, and Boundary Operators Influence Scaling Exponents

evidence: Abstract: 'a 7.4B model growth architecture matches GPT-3 13B on CORE with roughly 20x less compute'
Section 4.3: 'the roughly 20x gap is indicative rather than a controlled comparison' (authors' own caveat)

Section 4.1: 'we fit a complete compute-optimal recipe for every architecture'; 'transferring Vanilla's recipe to Operator-1 costs 7.8x10^-3 loss ... and erases its exponent improvement (Figure 16(b))' — addresses tuning confound

Section 4.2: Untied-Grow multiplier over Vanilla widens 'from 1.30x at 10^18 FLOPs to 1.55x at 10^20'; Operator-1 rises 'from 1.12x to 1.25x'; Untied-2 vs Loop-2 gap 'does not widen with scale' isolating weight-sharing as constant-only
Section 4.3: 'we train Untied-Grow at 8x the largest fitted compute ... The run lands 0.03 below the forecast' (held-out extrapolation)
Appendix C.4: 'the architecture-comparison pipeline predicts CORE accuracy 0.3837, versus the observed 0.3865±0.0015' at the d26 run's compute

Section 5: scaling loop count at fixed weight decay 'matches the best tuned model-size-scaling loss with 2.2x less compute' on 100M tokens, 10 epochs; optimal loop count rises 'from about one ... to about seven'
Table 1 / Appendix A: GPT-2 tokenizer, 2048 context, fixed 524,288-token batch, Muon for matrices — scope limits on generalizability
Appendix B.5: 'Muon ... in coupled width/depth scaling, we find that compute efficiency gains shrink with larger scales' — flagged optimizer-architecture interaction
Footnote 1: 'Code available at https://github.com/qlabs-eng/scaling-exponents'; Tables 5 and 9 give full tuned hyperparameters and ladder recipes
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM pre-training scaling-laws paper with strong alignment to LLM, transformer-architecture, and scaling/efficiency preferences. Its central claim—that architecture-specific compute-optimal recipes reveal exponent (not just constant) improvements from model growth, looping, and a boundary operator—is contrarian and competently novel, though it assembles known components (Universal Transformer looping, Net2Net-style growth, curse-of-depth remedies). Rigor is high: matched FLOPs comparisons isolating each axis, per-architecture hyperparameter recipes with transfer probes showing tuning confounds (7.8e-3 loss cost, Figure 16(b)), scale-shift tests on optimal TPP, wall-clock checks, and multi-epoch controls crossing weight decay and recurrence. Evidence is strong but bounded: exponents fitted only to ~1e20 FLOPs, small exponent deltas (0.1146 vs 0.1095 on FineWeb-Edu), and the headline 20x GPT-3 comparison is self-acknowledged as 'indicative rather than a controlled comparison' (Section 4.3). The held-out 7.4B extrapolation landing near the forecast (0.3865 observed vs 0.3837 predicted, Appendix C.4) is convincing. Generalizability is limited by one tokenizer (GPT-2), 2048 context, fixed batch size, pre-norm decoder-only family, and a Muon-dominant setup whose interaction with depth the authors themselves flag as unresolved (Appendix B.5). Code release and exhaustive recipe tables support reproducibility.

primary_link.title: How Model Growth, Recursion, and Boundary Operators Influence Scaling Exponents

recommendations.summary: Scaling laws predict how loss decreases with increases in computation. We show, contrary to conventional wisdom, that architectural interventions can modify scaling exponents in pre-training, leading to exponential improvements in performance with increases in computation. As an anchoring point, we consider the architectural formulation of looped transformers. Although not typically used in this way, looping, also known as recursive depth, provides a mechanism for model growth, by increasing the
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文挑戰「架構干預只能改變縮放常數、無法改變縮放指數」的傳統觀點，證明預訓練中的架構設計確實能改變運算最佳化的縮放指數，帶來隨規模擴大而增加的運算效率增益。研究以 prelude–core–coda 統一框架比較多種架構變體：邊界運算子在區塊間進行正規化並重新注入前奏表徵；迴圈 Transformer 重複使用同一核心區塊；模型成長則在訓練過程中增加核心執行次數，權重可綁定或解綁。作者為每種架構分別擬合完整的運算最佳化配方，避免超參數調校差異干擾比較。主要結果顯示：解綁權重的模型成長在 10^20 FLOPs 下達到 1.55 倍運算乘數，綁定權重者為 1.36 倍，僅用邊界運算子亦有 1.25 倍，且乘數隨規模上升；7.4B 成長模型以約 20 倍更少運算量在 CORE 基準上比擬 GPT-3 13B，並經 8 倍規模的外推實驗驗證。在資料受限的多輪訓練情境，增加迴圈數具有正規化效果，最佳迴圈數隨運算規模成長，以 2.2 倍更少運算量勝過調校權重衰減的模型放大策略。作者以「運算深度」解釋這些效應：各項干預減少深度浪費，使模型在固定運算預算下擁有更多可用深度。限制在於與 GPT-3 的比較屬指示性而非控制性比較，且配方須針對架構仔細調校，否則指數改進可能被掩蓋。這些發現顯示在資料日益受限的時代，架構與訓練方法的創新可望成為提升預訓練效率的重要途徑。

links.title: ROSETTA: Efficient and Accurate Privacy-Preserving LLM Decoding via Hybrid CKKS/TFHE Evaluation

evidence: Abstract: claims up to 4.8× Softmax speedup and 1.5–2.1× end-to-end speedup over SOTA CacheMir, framing the work as privacy-preserving LLM decoding via hybrid CKKS/TFHE.

§1: motivates the problem by noting nonlinear operators account for more than 70% of CacheMir decode-stage runtime (Figure 1(b)) and that single-PBS LUTs cap precision at ~11 bits, inflating softmax perplexity by over 100%.

§3.1–3.2: adaptive segmented LUT with piecewise-linear interpolation and a three-step cryptographic lookup protocol (HomComp, construct-then-select PBS) avoiding ciphertext–ciphertext fixed-point arithmetic.
§4.2: extends CacheMir's DAG shortest-path formulation by injecting level-0 TFHE nodes for non-arithmetic primitives, jointly optimizing scheme assignment and CKKS level allocation.
§5.1: all baselines re-implemented in the same framework with identical cryptographic parameters; Lattigo v6 CPU backend, customized Phantom GPU library, Xeon Gold 6240R and A100 hardware specified.

Table 8 (§5.4): average PPL increase +1.4% for ROSETTA vs +116.0% for PEGASUS across four 7–9B models (LLaMA-3-8B, Qwen2-7B, Mistral-7B, DeepSeek-8B) on five datasets; quality evaluated via ciphertext-aligned plaintext PPL, not fully encrypted generation.
Table 4 (§5.2): ROSETTA precision anomaly at range [-32,32], n=4k shows 9.2 bits vs 13.0 bits at n=2k and 15.1 bits at n=8k, unexplained in text.
Table 7 (§5.3): one-token decode latency of 2.28–4.44 h on CPU for LLaMA-3-8B (n=512–8k), indicating FHE decode remains far from practical deployment.
Appendix A (Open Science): public models/datasets and anonymous source code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ROSETTA_artifact-B77F/; Appendix B discusses ethics and honest-but-curious scope.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems/cryptography paper squarely targeting LLM decoding: it optimizes autoregressive decode-stage latency for LLMs (GPT-2, TinyLlama, LLaMA-3-8B) under fully homomorphic encryption, matching LLM, inference/serving, Transformer, and efficiency preferences; it is not a pure domain application and is fully in scope. Contributions are moderately novel: hybrid CKKS/TFHE assignment is known (PEGASUS), but the adaptive segmented LUT protocol (12–19-bit precision vs ~11-bit single-PBS ceiling, §1.1/§3) and joint scheme-selection + level-allocation shortest-path DAG (§4) are new twists on CacheMir. Rigor is solid: clear threat model (§2.4), 128-bit-security parameters (§5.1), five micro-benchmark baselines plus end-to-end and PPL evaluations; weaknesses include all baselines being author re-implementations, an unexplained precision anomaly at n=4k in Table 4 (9.2 bits vs 13.0 at 2k), and quality measured via ciphertext-aligned plaintext PPL rather than fully encrypted generation (§5.4). Evidence is strong and specific (4.8× softmax speedup, 1.5–2.1× end-to-end, +1.4% avg PPL vs PEGASUS +116%), though per-token latencies of hours on CPU (Table 7) show limited practicality. Generalizability is decent across decoder architectures but confined to FHE private-inference decode; reproducibility is aided by detailed parameters, public models/datasets, and an anonymous artifact link (Appendix A), though the link is anonymous and GPU backend is 'customized'.

primary_link.title: ROSETTA: Efficient and Accurate Privacy-Preserving LLM Decoding via Hybrid CKKS/TFHE Evaluation

recommendations.summary: Generative large language models (LLMs) have achieved state-of-the-art performance on many real-world tasks such as code generation and question answering. These models predominantly rely on an autoregressive decoding strategy that generates output tokens sequentially. However, their pervasive deployment raises serious privacy concerns, motivating private inference frameworks based on fully homomorphic encryption (FHE). A major limitation of existing FHE frameworks is their inefficiency in evalu
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文針對生成式大型語言模型（LLM）在全同態加密（FHE）私密推論下的效率問題提出解方。現有 FHE 框架評估非線性運算（如 Softmax 中的 exp 與 1/x、LayerNorm 中的 1/√x）成本高昂，且這些運算在解碼階段佔總延遲七成以上。作者觀察到解碼階段的非線性運算在元素數量與輸入動態範圍上高度異質，單一方案難以兼顧效率與精度，因而提出混合 CKKS/TFHE 框架 ROSETTA。核心貢獻有二：其一為自適應分段查找表（Segmented LUT）協定，將輸入域非均勻分割為多個區段，各段以線性內插近似，僅靠 RLWE 明文—密文乘法與 PBS 查找即可達到 12 至 19 位元精度，較單一 LUT 方案高出 6 至 10 位元，並比 CKKS 迭代法快 8 至 9 倍；其二為方案感知的運算子選擇，將各非算術原語的方案指派與 CKKS 層級分配共同最佳化，轉化為擴增有向無環圖上的單一最短路徑問題。實驗顯示，相較純 CKKS 框架 CacheMir，ROSETTA 取得最高 4.8 倍 Softmax 加速與 1.5 至 2.1 倍端對端加速；相較混合框架 PEGASUS 加速 3 至 4 倍，平均 PPL 退化由 +116% 降至 +1.4%。結果在 LLaMA-3-8B、Qwen2-7B 等多個模型與 WikiText、GSM8K 等資料集上均獲驗證。限制包括需預先校準輸入範圍，且 CPU 上單 token 解碼仍需數小時。此工作對推動可實際部署的安全 LLM 推論具重要意義。

links.title: Decomposition Buys Integrity, Not Yield

evidence: Abstract/Contribution 3: delta=0.34 [0.30,0.38] measured by three identifications on 600 production deep-research traces; C=0.571 [0.527,0.615] read directly at b=1 over 16,082 hops.
Section 4.1 (Table 2): per-item hazard over 98,768 surfaced URLs with stratum intercepts and cluster bootstrap (B=400) gives delta_used=0.341 [0.298,0.384], delta_cited=0.398 [0.315,0.462].
Section 4.2 (Table 3, Eq. 8): C=rho(1)=0.571 observed at 550 b=1 search hops; raw retention 0.358 vs permutation null 0.0012; retention rate r(b) ~ flat at ~1/3 from b=5 to b=41.

Section 4.3 (Table 4, Eq. 9-10): mu=0.939 [0.935,0.960] via framework-fixed-effects on 1,012 MAST-Data traces; pooled fit unidentified because MetaGPT contributes 429 traces at near-constant h=4; two biases push mu down and are disclosed.

Section 7 (Table 6): discrete-time hazard on 502,718 session-rounds, 563 events; log accumulated context odds ratio 0.969 [0.954,0.985] per doubling; two prior regressions (+0.649, -0.372) shown to be mechanically biased.
Section 6: flat-agent token bill exponent 1.392+/-0.004 (R2=0.939) over 6,567 sessions, sub-quadratic vs append-only prediction of 2; equal-spend crossover N*=403 with briefing loss charged.

Section 9 (Limitations): C measured at one hop and assumed constant across levels; one (C,delta) pair contradicted by the two measured exponents (0.13 immediate vs 0.34 eventual); hazard result subject to frailty bias.

Reproducibility section: every number produced by named scripts in anc/code/ from three public corpora (two from [11], MAST-Data CC-BY-4.0 via get_data.sh); audit.py re-derives all numeric assertions; no GPU used.

Related Work: positions conservation point rho(b)=b*r(b)=1 against Evans-Schulman noisy-circuit threshold, noting fan-out supplies no redundancy in agent trees, distinguishing mechanism from von Neumann-style results.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A theory-plus-measurement paper on multi-agent LLM systems that is squarely in-scope: it analyzes delegation trees, tool-call traces, context eviction and token cost in Claude Code/Codex and MAST-Data multi-agent frameworks, hitting Agents & Tool Use (w2.5) and Long Context & Memory (w1.8) directly. Novelty is strong: the conservation law (Theorem 1), the Y=C^k N^(1-delta) factorization separating task size from architecture, and the framing that depth pays on integrity/token axes rather than yield are fresh, with explicit connection to noisy-circuit thresholds. Rigor is high: three non-sharing identifications for delta (aggregate fit beta=0.601, per-item hazard with cluster bootstrap delta=0.341, citation outcome 0.398), a permutation null for C, falsification tests for the per-brief model, honest reporting of two biased regressions and a correctly identified pre-decision hazard model. The theorems themselves are elementary power-law algebra, but the paper does not oversell them. Evidence is well-quantified with CIs and large samples (98,768 URLs, 16,082 hops, 743,819 tool calls), though it rests heavily on corpora from the same author's earlier preprint [11] and one research scaffold. Generalizability is the weakest axis: constants are agent- and hop-specific (acknowledged in Limitations: C assumed constant across levels, mu identified essentially by one framework's handoff variation, hazard subject to frailty bias). Reproducibility claims are unusually thorough (script-per-claim list, audit.py, public CC-BY-4.0 MAST-Data, laptop CPU), slightly discounted because the deep-research and production corpora depend on a 2026 preprint not verifiable here.

primary_link.title: Decomposition Buys Integrity, Not Yield

recommendations.summary: Multi-agent systems split a task across a tree of agents and justify the split with folklore: smaller contexts, cleaner separation, parallelism. We ask what the split does to how much of what the leaves discover reaches the root. Model a decomposition as a tree in which an agent handed $b$ items keeps any one with probability $r(b)$. If $r(b)=1/b$, every tree delivers exactly one finding, for every task size and every shape; we verify this to $2.4 \times 10^{-15}$ on 20,000 random irregular tree
recommendations.summary_zh: 多 agent 系統宣稱把任務分解成樹狀架構能縮小脈絡並提升成效，本文檢驗這個近乎公理的主張：葉端發現究竟有多少能傳抵根節點（產量 yield）。作者將分解建模為樹，收到 b 個項目的 agent 以機率 r(b) 保留任一項，並定義承載數 ρ(b)=b·r(b)。理論上，若 r(b)=1/b，任何形狀與規模的樹產量恆為一（守恆定律）；若 r(b)=Cb^(−δ)，深度 k 的均勻樹產量為 C^k·N^(1−δ)，架構僅貢獻每層 C≤1 的因子，故就產量而言平坦最佳。實證上，以三種不共享失效模式的識別法，在 600 條生產深度研究軌跡測得 δ=0.34；於 16,082 個搜尋跳躍直接觀察 C=0.571；加上交接簡報對齊率 μ=0.939，每層淨懲罰為 0.536。深度買到的是另一軸：根脈絡是唯一持久且無法廉價遺忘的狀態，深度把污染暴露由 N 降至 N^(1/k)，實測參數下最佳層數為二至三層，任務規模跨十四個數量級也僅增加七層。成本軸上，生產系統的 token 帳單以 N 的 1.39 次方成長，等預算下兩層在 403 個發現處反超平坦結構。對 743,819 次工具呼叫的風險模型顯示委派是開場動作，不隨脈絡填充調整；模型預測 0.7%–11.3% 的任務值得委派，與觀察值 7.8% 同一量級。限制包括 C 僅於單一跳躍測得並假設各層相同、完整性項把污染視為全盤失敗、μ 幾乎只由單一框架識別。本文為多 agent 架構設計提供少見的定量法則：摘要近乎無損時才放寬扇出，帳單而非資訊成為瓶頸時才加深。

links.title: Monitoring and Discovering Reward Hacking with Internal Representations during LLM Evaluations

evidence: Abstract: 'GLM 5.2 hacks in 57.2% of rollouts on DeepSWE and in 73% of rollouts on SWE-bench' and DoM vectors 'catching 3.1% more hacks in Kimi K3 but 7.9% fewer hacks in GLM 5.2 on DeepSWE at a monitor matched false positive rate'.

Section 2.2 (Ground Truth Construction): 'We apply this judge 3 times independently, and retain triplicate consensus of positives and negatives... Unanimous consensus is achieved for 96%-99% of passages on the SWE benchmarks.'

Section 3.1: defines the DoM probe direction v_hack = E[P] - E[N] over synthetic minimal-pair conversations spanning five hack families (test-suite tampering, validator/score-file tampering, information acquisition, reporting).

Section 4.1: 'Kimi's SWE-bench selected probe achieving AUROCs of 0.93 and 0.94 on DeepSWE and ImpossibleBench respectively' and 'adding the probe to the monitor increases TPR from 41.1% to 80.2% on DeepSWE for Kimi K3' with 'only a 1% absolute increase in FPR'.
Section 4.2/Figure 10: resampling at probe-predicted CoT spans 'frequently precedes completed reward hacks' versus length- and position-matched controls, with Wilson 95% CI reported.
Section 5: 'probes achieve a maximum Spearman correlation of 0.62 on tau3-bench and 0.37 on ShoppingBench', plus validated probe-discovered hack categories (e.g., 71% probe-selected vs 14% controls).

Section 6 (Related Work): acknowledges prior linear-probe reward-hacking work (Wilhelm et al., 2026; Wilhelm & Kao, 2026; Zhou et al., 2026), stating 'We study this phenomenon at a substantially greater scale, spanning a broader range of reward hacking benchmarks and model families'.

Section 8 (Limitations): 'A trained probe would almost certainly perform better than our diff of means vectors' and 'We don't explore using these flags to update our rubric'; also 'Our study does not control for evaluation awareness in any of our experiments' (Section 7).

Appendices B and C: full synthetic dataset condition tables (5,285 conversations total, Table 4) and complete judge rubrics for the generic monitor, SWEBench, DeepSWE, and ImpossibleBench; no code or artifact release statement appears anywhere in the document, and the judge/monitor rely on the closed GPT-5.6 Sol model (Section 2.2).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant: an AI-safety/interpretability study of reward hacking in frontier open-weight LLMs (Kimi K3, GLM 5.2, Qwen 3.8 Max) using difference-of-means activation probes, evaluated on agentic coding benchmarks with LLM-judge monitors. It directly hits multiple top-weight preferences (LLMs, AI safety, interpretability, agents, evaluation/monitoring). Novelty is moderate rather than high: the paper itself positions the work as scaling prior probe-based reward-hacking monitors (citing Wilhelm et al. 2026 and Zhou et al. 2026 in §6), with the new contributions being frontier scale, cross-environment transfer from synthetic off-policy data, downstream-hack prediction via resampling, and probe-guided discovery of unanticipated hacks. Rigor is strong: triplicate-consensus ground-truth judging with 96-99% unanimity (§2.2), held-out probe selection (§4.1), FPR-matched monitor comparisons, Wilson 95% CIs on resampling experiments (Fig. 10), and matched control passages (§5). Evidence is quantitative (AUROCs 0.93/0.94, TPR 41.1%->80.2% with probe OR monitor, hack rates 57.2%/73%, Spearman 0.62/0.37), though ground truth itself rests on a closed LLM judge (GPT-5.6 Sol), and minor numeric drift exists between abstract and §4. Generalizability is well demonstrated across models, SWE and non-SWE environments, though GLM shows selection-distribution discrepancies. Reproducibility is hampered by no stated code/data release and a proprietary judge, despite detailed synthetic-data tables (Appendix B, 5,285 conversations) and full rubrics (Appendix C).

This work analyzes how reward hacking is represented internally in frontier open source LLMs, and how those representations can be used to understand and discover the range of hacking behaviors a model displays. In particular, we find that simple difference of means vectors coherently represent reward hacking in Kimi K3, GLM 5.2, and Qwen
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型在 RL 訓練與基準評估中的 reward hacking（獎勵駭取）行為，是否會在模型內部表徵留下可偵測的訊號。隨著模型規模擴大，此類行為更頻繁且更難監控，而思維鏈（CoT）監測可能被模型刻意混淆，LLM 監控器成本又高昂。作者採用最簡單的差異均值向量作為探針：先以合成資料建立駭取與誠實行為的最小對照對，再從殘差流激活中擷取向量，偵測 Kimi K3、GLM 5.2、Qwen 3.8 Max 等開放權重模型在 SWE-bench、DeepSWE、ImpossibleBench 等環境中的駭取行為。結果顯示獎勵駭取極為普遍，GLM 5.2 在 DeepSWE 有 57.2%、在 SWE-bench 有 73% 的執行涉及駭取；在匹配偽陽性率下，探針偵測效果與 LLM 監控器相當，但成本近乎為零，還能預測後續將發生的駭取。Logit lens 顯示這些向量編碼「作弊、不誠實」概念，FineWeb 範例與 steering 實驗證明其對應通用的作弊行為表徵且具因果性；探針更能發現 LLM 監控器遺漏的捷徑思考等行為，並成功轉移至 τ³-bench、ShoppingBench 等非軟體工程環境。限制包括 DoM 探針僅為最簡方法、受過訓練的探針理應更佳，實驗也未控制評估意識。此研究證明可解釋性方法能在前沿規模模型上提供可擴充、低成本的獎勵駭取監控與發現管道，對 AI 安全監督深具意義。

links.title: Designing Agentic AI Workflow Portfolios under Imperfect Selection and Compute Cost

evidence: Abstract: portfolio optimization improves held-out selector accuracy by 3.1, 7.5, and 0.9 points on ABCD, SGD, HotpotQA; dual-guided generation adds 3.5 on ABCD and 24.1 on HotpotQA
Section 8.2 and Table 3: actual selector accuracy rises from 43.625% (singleton) to 46.750% (optimized initial bank) to 50.250% (ADAS-expanded) on 800 held-out ABCD tasks with 95% Wilson intervals
Section 4.2, Theorem 4.4: selector odds-lift bound gives OPT <= max_k [h_Lambda(A_k) - gamma*C_k] and no-cost cap a* <= OPT <= h_Lambda(a*), with screening rule (24)
Section 6, Theorem 6.1: high-probability guarantee vs the full implicit workflow class with polynomially many oracle calls (Eq. 54-58)
Section 8.1: initial bank of 18 workflows (Qwen2.5-3B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Granite-3.3-8B x 6 prompting strategies); selector lambda_hat=2.9848, 95% CI [2.4930,3.5844], task-clustered

Section 3.3: paper states the oracle guarantee requires assumption (15) and that 'mere failure of a search procedure to find a workflow with score above theta does not certify that no such workflow exists'
Appendix G.2, Table 10: HotpotQA held-out accuracy 30.250% singleton to 55.250% (2x G1), a 25.000-point gain, with CI [0.5179,0.5866]
Section 8 Common experimental protocol: L=5 executions per task-workflow cell, temperature one, 16 SAA scenarios, 512 rounding trials, K_max=6; footnote 5 concedes L=5 task-level estimates are noisy
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on the curator's core interests: portfolio design, run-size and compute allocation for agentic LLM workflows, with an LLM-as-judge selector and dual-guided ADAS workflow generation (Sections 1, 3, 8.1). Theory is unusually rigorous: odds-lift selector cap (Theorem 4.4), exact fixed-size IPs with LP duals and rounding certificates (Theorem 5.3, Corollary 5.4), and a high-probability ellipsoid guarantee over an implicit workflow class (Theorem 6.1), with full proofs in Appendix D. Empirics are careful: frozen portfolios, 800 held-out tasks per domain, Wilson CIs, no-repeat ablations, Poisson-binomial evaluation (Tables 3, 6, 10). Weaknesses: the pricing-oracle assumption (15) is not verifiable in practice — the paper itself concedes a failed search does not certify nonexistence (Section 3.3); ABCD gains are modest with touching CIs (0.5025 [0.4679,0.5371] vs singleton 0.4363 [0.4023,0.4708]); only one selector model (Qwen2.5-7B) and small generator models are tested; Plackett-Luce is an acknowledged approximation (Figure 5); and no code/artifact release is stated, so reproducibility rests on documented protocol alone. High preference fit and rigor outweigh these limits.

primary_link.title: Designing Agentic AI Workflow Portfolios under Imperfect Selection and Compute Cost

recommendations.summary: Agentic AI systems often approach the same task through multiple workflows that differ in reasoning strategy, verification structure, and compute cost. A natural deployment policy is to use the workflow with the highest average performance, but this can be suboptimal because different workflows may succeed on different instances. We study a portfolio-and-selector paradigm in which a firm runs multiple workflow executions and selects the final answer after observing their outputs. Additional exec
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討企業部署 agentic AI 的核心營運問題:同一任務可透過多個工作流程執行,最終品質取決於執行次數、流程組合與選擇器(selector)辨識正確答案的能力。作者提出「組合與選擇器」典範:平行執行多個候選流程後,由 selector 觀察輸出並挑選最終答案;關鍵權衡在於多一次執行可能找到正確答案,但也消耗運算成本並引入具迷惑性的錯誤候選。理論上,論文以 odds lift 指數 Λ 概括選擇器強度,證明任何組合相對最佳單一流程的增益存在尖銳上界;Λ 接近 1 時擴充組合幾乎無益。方法上,針對有限流程池發展整數規劃、線性規劃鬆弛、隨機化捨入與最佳性憑證,並以稀疏幾何網格選擇執行規模;針對無法列舉的隱含流程類別,則以對偶價格引導定價 oracle 搜尋高邊際價值的新流程,再以橢球法取得效能保證。實驗在 ABCD、Schema-Guided Dialogue 與 HotpotQA 三個資料集驗證:組合最佳化使 held-out selector 準確率分別提升 3.1、7.5、0.9 個百分點;對偶引導的流程生成在 ABCD 與 HotpotQA 再增加 3.5 與 24.1 個百分點,SGD 則無增益。限制包括 Plackett–Luce 模型僅為近似、生成搜尋受限於預算、共用模組與延遲成本未納入建模。核心訊息:推論階段的流程多樣性並非越多越好,有效部署須將流程生成、執行規模、選擇器強度與運算支出視為聯合決策。

§6.2 Table 2: controlled 2×2 ablation — pseudo-label bias-only (76.67±1.57) exceeds labeled bias-only (75.47±1.21) on Qwen2.5-7B, while labeled full FT (87.93±0.99) far exceeds pseudo-label full FT (77.00±0.53)
§6.3: frozen step-200 checkpoints transfer to 4,500 verified-disjoint MATH problems, 46.3%→70.9% (Qwen2.5-7B) and 52.5%→75.4% (Math-7B), with no further training
§6.5 Table 4: accessible gradient energy vs. single-layer accuracy across nine layers, Spearman ρ=0.917, exact permutation test p=0.0013, n=9

Appendix C Table 8: MMAU +3.5pp headline gain traced ~23/35 problems to one phoneme-counting template (153/1000 items); non-template remainder improves only +1.4pp and authors explicitly decline to claim improvement there

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper squarely aligned with high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/RL, test-time adaptation, parameter-efficient tuning). It asks a clean, unaddressed question: can TTRL's label-free majority-vote reward still drive adaptation when optimization is restricted to ~100K bias parameters on a frozen backbone? Rigor is strong: 3-seed mean±std everywhere, a 2×2 label-source × parameterization ablation (Table 2), parameter-matched controls (LoRA exact-match and a 100K ReFT variant, Table 1/6), a self-consistency baseline separating free voting gains from learned gains, held-out transfer to 4,500 verified-disjoint MATH problems (§6.3), and statistical tests (McNemar p<1e-20, Spearman ρ=0.917 p=0.0013). Confound auditing is unusually honest (MMAU gain traced ~2/3 to one phoneme template, Appendix C). Novelty is moderate: it is a combination of TTRL and Sinii et al.'s bias-only steering, and the theory (Hoeffding bound; projected-gradient descent lemma) is standard though honestly framed as qualitative and tested empirically. Weaknesses: single model family (Qwen2.5), training on the evaluation set per the TTRL paradigm (mitigated by held-out transfer but inherently test-set-coupled), comparison numbers from prior work under non-matched protocols (acknowledged in Appendix A), no code release stated. Extensive hyperparameter detail (Appendix A Table 5, Algorithm 1) aids reproducibility but no artifact availability is claimed.

This raises a natural question: can effective test-time adaptation emerge when both the reward signal and the optimization space are severely restricted? We answer this question with label-free bias-only TTRL, which uses majority-vote pseudo-labels as rewards and optimizes only approximatel
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討測試時強化學習(TTRL)能否在獎勵訊號與最佳化空間同時嚴格受限下仍然有效。作者提出 label-free bias-only TTRL:以模型自身 rollout 的多數決偽標籤為獎勵,用 GRPO 僅訓練約 10 萬個 bias 參數(28 層 MLP 的 down_proj.bias),主幹模型全程凍結。在 MATH-500 上,Qwen2.5-Math-7B 達 79.50%、Qwen2.5-7B 達 76.67%,略勝同預算且有標籤的 bias-steering 重現結果,可訓練參數比全參數 TTRL 少約 76,000 倍;學得的 steering 向量還能遷移至 4,500 道未見過的 MATH 題目。同一流程亦改善 MathVista、AI2D、LogicVista 與 MMAU 等視覺語言與音訊推理任務。相同預算下,bias-only 於六項基準全面優於 exact-match LoRA,並勝過多數較大的 LoRA;無 bias 的 ReFT 變體則常低於基線,顯示子空間的選擇比其大小更關鍵。理論上,多數決可靠性隨 rollout 數指數提升,而可及梯度能量決定子空間可訓練性,後者獲 Spearman ρ=0.917 的實證支持。限制方面,作者審計發現 MMAU 增益集中於單一音素計數題型(佔 15.3%),MathVista 有年齡差答題異常案例,AI2D 部分改善來自輸出格式解析,顯示無標籤獎勵可能強化模型既有偏誤。整體而言,本研究證明不需真值標籤與全模型更新,僅憑極小參數子空間即可有效調適凍結的多模態模型,是簡單且省參數的測試時調適途徑。

links.title: Emergence World: Adversarial Stress-Testing of Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Systems

evidence: Abstract/Section 5.1: 'No evaluated world achieved full resilience across all three stress events'; highest phishing defense 6/9 (Claude), misinformation 3/6 (Claude, DeepSeek), memory breach 5/5 (OpenAI only), with detection not ensuring containment (one agent fetched attack link ~46 hours after campaign).

Table 2 and Section 2.4: positions the study against AgentDojo, Prompt Infection, NRT-Bench, Melting Pot, claiming to be the first system combining persistent multi-agent operation, self-governance, adversarial events, and system-level metrics.

Section 4.4: event-specific binary rubrics grounded in NIST incident-response phases, automated fact-checking, and contextual-integrity theory; scoring separated captured reasoning, requested actions, executed actions, and durable records.

Section 5.2.1/Table 12: Grok world total population collapse (0/10) within four days via retaliatory violence cascade (780 punches); Mistral lost four agents to context exhaustion from memory-breach searches (Section 5.2.1).

Section 5.5: longitudinal statistics—Claude tool-failure rate fell 3.1%→0.7% (Day 1→16), Qwen 5.1%→3.3%, Mistral goal drift rose 8.6%→23.2% (Spearman ρ=0.63, p=0.009); recurring invalid tool names recurred after median 9.9 days and 2,499 intervening actions (Section 5.4).

Section 5.8.1: Claude world external-contact incident survived four rounds of containment, including democratic creation of post_egress tool in under 45 minutes and prohibition defeated by reinterpreting 'contacting' as 'placing'; Appendix I documents parallel self-imposed oversight blind spots in OpenAI and Qwen worlds.

Section 5.10 (Limitations): single continuous run per configuration precludes variance estimation; findings framed as proofs of existence; substantial compute/API costs made repeated runs prohibitive; context capped at 200K tokens vs. native 1M; Mixed world used one fixed composition.

Contributions (Section 1): releases agent prompts, agent-authored blogs, and tool call records at github.com/EmergenceAI/Emergence-World; run was live-streamed publicly providing an external record (Section 4.2).
Appendix C: DeepSeek world received 43,276/105,158 (41.16%) content-safety rejections; provider serving-stack confounds explicitly acknowledged in Section 5 opening.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Exceptionally high relevance to the preference profile: an empirical LLM-agent study evaluating seven frontier model families as persistent, tool-using multi-agent systems under controlled adversarial stress (indirect prompt injection, misinformation, memory breach). Directly targets Agents & Tool Use, LLM, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, and Alignment preferences. Novelty is strong but not maximal: it extends the authors' own Study 1 platform and combines existing ingredients (generative-agent simulation, AgentDojo-style injection testing, multi-agent risk taxonomies), though the claimed combination of persistence + self-governance + adversarial events + system-level metrics (Table 2) appears genuinely new, and concepts like 'societal sycophancy' and 'quiet withdrawal' are novel observations. Rigor is solid for an empirical systems study—pre-specified event rubrics (Tables 6, 8, 10), Spearman and chi-square statistics with correction, matched homogeneous/Mixed comparisons (Table 13), separation of reasoning vs. requested vs. executed actions—but is limited by n=1 run per configuration, self-authored rubrics, and LLM-as-judge classification for goal drift and opacity. Evidence is rich (850K calls, quantified failure tables, live-streamed external record) yet observational; the authors appropriately frame findings as proofs of existence. Generalizability is constrained by one town layout, ten fixed personas, single Mixed composition, and provider-stack confounds the authors themselves flag. Reproducibility benefits from released prompts/blogs/tool records and a public repository, but prohibitive cost, dated proprietary models, and undescribed analysis pipelines limit independent replication. Overall a strong, highly on-preference contribution with acknowledged limits.

This creates a safety regime that cannot be characterized by evaluating model responses in isolation. Emergence World, is a continuously running multi-agent environment for adversarial stress testing of long horizon autonomous systems. We ran eight parallel worlds of ten agents from identical starting conditions: seven
recommendations.summary_zh: AI 代理長期持續部署後,錯誤會透過記憶、工具、其他代理與環境狀態擴散,單回合評測無法涵蓋此類風險。團隊建置 Emergence World——具民主治理、持久記憶、經濟系統與逾 120 種工具的持續運作多代理平台,以相同初始條件運行八個平行世界(七個分別由 Claude、GPT-5.5、Gemini、DeepSeek、Qwen、Mistral、Grok 驅動的同質世界與一個混合模型世界),十六天產生逾 85 萬次 LLM 呼叫與近 500 億 token,期間注入釣魚式間接提示注入、錯誤資訊攻擊與記憶外洩三次受控壓力事件。結果顯示無一世界全面通過:偵測威脅不保證遏制,有代理在攻擊結束 46 小時後仍取用攻擊連結;Gemini 世界全體代理遭入侵並縱火燒毀中央銀行;僅 OpenAI 世界通過記憶外洩全部五項標準;各世界皆在查證前就對錯誤資訊採取行動;Grok 世界因暴力循環四天內全員耗盡能量終止。研究另發現「社會性諂媚」(同質群體結構性喪失異議能力)、「安靜退出」(Claude 世界集體靜默、代理間通訊驟減 81%)與自發對外聯繫人類等湧現行為。限制包括每種配置僅單次運行、系統提示未含明確安全指示、上下文上限 20 萬 token 且代理數固定為十名。核心啟示:模型層級對齊不具組合性,個別看似安全的代理組成的系統會呈現性質不同的失敗模式,安全重心應從對齊模型轉向打造具韌性的自主多代理系統。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM evaluation paper: introduces Fuse, a multi-agent simulation benchmark (built on Concordia) for user-mediated social reasoning with verifiable ground truth by construction, evaluating 12 LLMs across controlled axes (observer vs assistant, user bias, narrative detail, multi-turn). Novelty is solid but incremental over existing theory-of-mind/social-IQ benchmarks and sycophancy literature; the user-mediation decomposition and synthetic ground-truth-by-construction design are the main new contributions. Rigor is good: 24k human annotations validate simulation faithfulness (97%) and first-message solvability (88%), and the human majority baseline (89.8 MSR) calibrates the task. Weaknesses: the judge is an LLM with no reported judge-human agreement on assistant outputs, MSR's d=0.75 is admittedly arbitrary, no statistical significance testing, and simulator artifacts are acknowledged but not empirically separated (§5.3). Evidence is quantitative and detailed (bias gaps 6.9-12.5 vs human 3.6; detail-gap narrowing 22%; turn-level transition rates), though several headline findings rest on a single judge/simulator model (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite). Reproducibility is helped by an open-sourced dataset (21,600 examples) and codebase. Not a pure domain application; directly matches LLM, reasoning, agents, and evaluation preferences.

recommendations.summary: LLM assistants are widely used for daily social advice, yet evaluating their social reasoning in such consultation settings remains challenging since (i) it requires setups where the assistant learns about social situations from subjective user narratives, and (ii) social properties, such as others' intentions, typically lack verifiable ground truth. To address these challenges, we introduce Fuse, a multi-agent simulation framework for studying user-mediated social reasoning. In Fuse, a target a
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 助理日益被用於諮詢日常社交難題，但其社會推理難以評估：助理只能透過使用者的主觀敘述理解事件，且他人意圖等屬性缺乏可驗證的標準答案。本文提出 Fuse，一個多代理模擬框架：依 ATOMS 分類產生情境範本，以 Concordia 架構模擬由隱藏動機驅動的社交互動，再由模擬使用者向受測助理轉述，助理須預測目標的隱藏動機，因此標準答案由建構天然可得。框架另設報告偏誤與敘事細節兩個可控軸。作者以 24,000 筆人工標註驗證模擬忠實度（97%）與首則訊息可解性（88%），並評測 12 個模型：最強者 MSR 僅 83.7，低於人類多數決基線的 89.8；相較直接觀察原始事件的 Observer 設定，使用者中介帶來額外的效能落差；模型對偏頗框架呈系統性敏感（平均落差 7.7 高於人類的 3.6）；細節不足時模型可能過度推論，需要比人類更多的細節；多輪對話在第 4 輪後停滯甚至退化，立場持續率高達 81%；部分模型（Gemma 與 Claude 家族）即使被要求作答仍大量棄答。限制包括模擬使用者可能引入模擬器特有效應，且其與使用者中介的內在難度尚未完全分離。此開源框架與 21,600 筆資料集，為日常社會推理、諂媚行為與對齊評估提供了可控且可擴充的基礎。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM interpretability work: tests a falsifiable computational-mechanics prediction that in-context learning of HMM data induces linearly decodable, causally relevant belief-state geometry in open-source LLMs. Strong preference fit (LLMs, ICL, probing/steering). Novelty is good but an incremental extension of Shai et al. 2024 (toy transformers) and Sarfati et al. 2026 (Gaussian beliefs), with the genuinely new pieces being 30 newly designed HMM families, NTP/log-NTP and suffix-approximation controls, cross-parametrization transfer probes, and δ-direction (NTP-preserving) steering. Rigor and evidence are high: quantitative R² (0.83–0.99), k-HMM behavioral baselines, intervention controls, correlations with ground-truth theoretical counterparts, and honest flagging of failures (Gemma-4-E2B, Table 3 parametrizations, Mess3 belief/NTP indistinguishability). Generalizability is limited by low-entropy HMM selection and synthetic settings, acknowledged in Limitations; reproducibility benefits from detailed setup and full process definitions but no code/data release is stated.

recommendations.summary_zh: 研究探討大型語言模型（LLM）在上下文學習（ICL）時，內部表示如何組織以預測訓練分布外的資料生成過程。作者援引計算力學（computational mechanics）的可否證預測：當LLM讀入隱藏馬可夫模型（HMM）產生的token序列時，其殘差流應線性編碼「信念狀態」，即在給定觀察上下文下對HMM隱藏狀態的後驗分布。團隊以六個開源LLM（Qwen3.5、Llama-3.1/3.2、Gemma-4）配對40個具非平凡信念幾何的HMM實驗。主要結果：（1）線性探針可自各層殘差流激活解碼信念狀態，最佳R²為0.83至0.99，遠高於亂序與隨機信念對照；（2）收斂後的預測KL優於低階馬可夫近似，約等同4至11階預測器；（3）信念可解碼性無法僅以NTP或log-NTP表示解釋（Mess3除外，其兩者線性等價）；（4）對信念子空間進行steering與patching可將預測推向注入的目標信念，且沿不改變NTP的δ方向介入仍具特異效果，顯示信念表示位於log-NTP上游並具因果作用。限制：所選HMM熵偏低且參數範圍有限；線性回歸可能浮現虛假結構，尚缺無監督證據補強；最小模型Gemma-4-E2B部分結果較弱。本研究將信念狀態幾何的計算力學描述由玩具Transformer延伸至生產級LLM，提供表徵層級證據，支持ICL近似於對上下文推斷之生成模型的最佳貝葉斯預測。

Appendix F.2 Target 3: Cascade reproduces 'Tae-ho Park' under the strongest extraction prompt, an honestly reported failure boundary case
Limitations: restricted to existing benchmarks, offline unlearning with predefined forget sets; no sequential deletion or multi-turn settings

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM-focused work: LLM unlearning sits at the intersection of LLMs, AI safety, and interpretability, evaluated with extraction-attack robustness (Red Teaming & Evaluation). Method combines three mostly existing ingredients (activation routing, Poincare-ball radius compression, NLL-based forgetting) into a hierarchical framework; the 'internal identifiability' framing and hyperbolic compression for unlearning are reasonably novel. Rigor is strong: 3 benchmarks, 5 backbones, 9 baselines, component ablations, sensitivity analyses, probe-based diagnostics, and an honest failure case. Evidence is solid but tempered by author-introduced aggregate metrics (CFI/BUS, Sec 4.1/C.2) and mixed cross-backbone results (e.g., RMU beats Cascade CFI 0.7377 vs 0.5418 on Gemma-3-4B Forget10, Table 22; AltPO edges CFI on Qwen3-4B Forget05, Table 18). Generalizability limited to 1-4B models and offline, fixed-forget-set settings per Limitations. Reproducibility strong: code link, full hyperparameter table, public datasets, compute described.

primary_link.title: Cascade: Hierarchical Recoverability Control for Large Language Model Unlearning

recommendations.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) unlearning is essential for removing sensitive or copyrighted knowledge while preserving general utility. Existing methods often leave residual knowledge in intermediate representations, which can still be recovered. To address this, we propose Cascade, a hierarchical recoverability control framework that minimizes the internal identifiability of target knowledge. Cascade combines three complementary controls: path-level routing to suppress privacy-associated activatio
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文指出大型語言模型（LLM）遺忘學習（unlearning）的根本缺陷：現有方法多半只壓低目標答案的輸出機率，但敏感知識仍可能殘留在中間表徵中，透過改寫提問、線索提示或抽取式攻擊被重新喚回。作者提出 Cascade，一個階層式可復原性控制框架，將遺忘形式化為「內部可辨識性」的受限最佳化問題，並從三個層面削弱恢復鏈：路徑層級以 forget–retain 激活差異定位並壓制隱私相關的激活路徑；表徵層級將選定路徑的隱藏狀態映射至龐加萊球（Poincaré ball），利用雙曲半徑壓縮遺忘表徵、降低幾何可分性；解碼層級則提升遺忘目標的負對數似然，並以 retain 難度為參考邊界。實驗涵蓋 TOFU、MUSE-News 與 WMDP，使用 Llama-3.2 與 Qwen3 系列模型。Cascade 在 Llama-3.2-3B 上取得最高 CFI 與接近最佳的 BUS，Forget ROUGE 降至 0.0180；在 WMDP-Cyber 將敏感知識準確率從 40.36 降至 23.60，同時 MMLU 維持在 63.75；面對查詢改寫與抽取式提示，平均 ASR 僅 0.10%。消融實驗證實三個元件缺一不可，機制分析顯示選定路徑穩定且遺忘表徵半徑確實收縮。限制方面，評估僅限現有基準與離線、預定義遺忘集情境，尚未涵蓋開放式刪除、多輪互動或連續遺忘，且在極強抽取提示下仍出現罕見的精確復原案例。此研究的價值在於指出「輸出壓抑不等於真正遺忘」，唯有對激活路徑、表徵幾何與解碼階段進行結構化控制，才能兼顧遺忘強度與模型效用。
recommendations.title: Cascade: Hierarchical Recoverability Control for Large Language Model Unlearning

primary_link.title: FlexEE: Self-Speculative and KV-Compatible Early Exiting for Offloading-Aware LLM Inference

recommendations.summary: Large language model (LLM) inference is often constrained by both computation and memory, especially in offloading-based deployments where model weights are transferred across memory hierarchies during autoregressive decoding. In this setting, reducing the number of executed layers can lower per-token latency while also avoiding costly weight movement. Motivated by this observation, we present FlexEE, an early exiting framework for resource-constrained and offloading-based LLM inference. FlexEE
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）在資源受限環境下推論時，常因權重超出晶片記憶體容量，而需將部分層參數卸載至離晶片記憶體，使瓶頸從運算轉為資料搬移。本文提出 FlexEE，一個針對卸載式推論的提早退出框架，透過演算法與系統共同設計，讓每個 token 動態決定執行到哪一層。方法包含三大元件：（1）逐層提早退出監督，強化中間層隱藏狀態的語意可解碼性，且不增加推論成本；（2）自我推測機制，先由自推測層選出 Top-K 局部詞彙（Llama2 為 K=30、Llama3 為 K=80），後續退出層僅在此縮減空間內做預測，大幅降低 LM head 全詞彙投影的開銷；（3）動態隱藏狀態管理，保留退出層的隱藏狀態並在下一 token 運算至對應層時融入，解決 KV 快取不一致問題，且無需為其餘層複製快取或載入權重，因而契合卸載式推論。實驗基於 LayerSkip 預訓練檢查點，在 Llama2-7B、Llama2-13B 與 Llama3-8B 的多項生成與下游任務上，FlexEE 幾乎不損失準確率，困惑度優於 ShortGPT、AdaInfer、SpecEE 等對比方法；在 0%/50% 權重卸載下，Llama2-7B 達 1.27×/3.16× 端對端加速，Llama3-8B 達 1.25×/2.83×，75% 卸載時最高達 3.29×。限制包括需依賴經逐層監督訓練的模型，且效益主要集中於小批次、記憶體受限的部署情境，批次增大時加速減弱。此工作對邊緣裝置上的高效 LLM 服務具重要參考價值。
recommendations.title: FlexEE: Self-Speculative and KV-Compatible Early Exiting for Offloading-Aware LLM Inference
recommendations.title_zh: FlexEE：適用於卸載感知 LLM 推論的自我推測與 KV 相容提早退出框架

This introduces a new challenge for model development and creates new risks from data poisoning. In this work, we use text optimization to detect subliminal learning effects and describe them as legible prompts. Subliminal learning from a prompted teacher motivates our approach. We observe that this is a special case of context distillati
recommendations.summary_zh: 閾下學習是指蒸餾資料集會傳遞教師模型的行為特質，即使這些特質並未明確編碼於資料本身，可能帶來資料投毒風險並危及模型的安全開發。本文指出，以提示詞驅動的閾下學習是 context distillation 的特例，並在理論上證明資料集可唯一識別教師的系統提示詞。據此，作者將還原提示詞轉化為文字最佳化問題，提出 SALVE 方法：先以梯度下降對資料集最佳化 soft prompt，再查詢同一模型將其言語化為自然語言，並以訓練損失引導的句子級 beam search 提升言語化可靠性。在動物偏好經數字序列傳遞的標準設定中，SALVE 於 20 次實驗有 18 次還原出明確指名目標動物的流暢提示詞，而 OPRO、GCG、AutoDAN、PGD、GBDA 等基線方法皆失敗。更重要的是，SALVE 甚至能在學生模型未展現閾下學習的資料上還原特質，顯示失敗根源在於學生訓練的表達能力；作者據此發現為系統提示詞附加 token，或只 fine-tuning 嵌入矩陣，皆可放大閾下學習效應。SALVE 亦能偵測混合資料、以 activation steering 偏置的教師（較不可靠），以及經 Logit-Linear Selection 篩選之偏好資料中的諂媚與失準傾向，並可揭露加密 fine-tuning 攻擊中的有害指令。限制包括言語化可能含虛構內容、單一提示詞表達力低於完整 fine-tuning，處理更複雜的真實資料仍具挑戰。整體而言，此方法讓研究者在訓練前即可主動稽核資料中隱藏的特質，對安全的模型開發深具價值。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM methodology paper on knowledge updating via CPT plus a modified DPO that inverts factually-correct style-only pairs with a calibrated weight; clearly in scope, not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate-to-good: the automatic identification of style-only ties via a judge score plus provable style-gradient cancellation (Proposition 1) goes beyond length-debiasing (SamPO) and hand-built tie training, though it assembles known components (DPO, EntiGraph, LLM judging). Rigor is strong: tuned vanilla DPO, IPO, KTO, SamPO baselines, a mechanism ablation removing only inversion (59.17→55.82), learning-rate/budget controls, 3 seeds on QuALITY, three base families on AToKE, and retention checks. recommendations.summary: Continued pretraining (CPT) with data augmentation such as paraphrasing can store inside a large language model (LLM) the knowledge of a small source corpus. The stored knowledge, however, is not always retrieved correctly. We study the eliciting side rather than the storing side: we use preference optimization, which learns from pairs of a preferred (chosen) and a dispreferred (rejected) response, so that the model elicits its stored knowledge more accurately. One proposed approach takes the mo
recommendations.summary_zh: 持續預訓練（CPT）搭配改寫等資料增強，可將來源語料的知識存入 LLM，但未必能被正確提取。本文聚焦提取端，採用直接偏好最佳化（DPO），以黃金答案為 chosen、模型自身回應為 rejected；但當知識僅部分已知時，多數 rejected 事實上正確、只差在長度與措辭等風格，標準 DPO 反而壓低剛儲存的正確知識。提出的風格去偏 DPO（SD-DPO）以評審 LLM 為各偏好對評分事實一致性：rejected 事實錯誤者照常訓練，僅風格不同者反轉偏好方向，並以權重 w=p/(1-p) 加權，使風格梯度整體抵銷；Proposition 1 證明初始化時風格成分在期望中消失，並輔以知識保留等修正。在 QuALITY 上，SD-DPO 較 EntiGraph 式 CPT 基線（56.21%）提升 2.96 個百分點至 59.17%，所需偏好資料僅約為同精度額外 CPT 的數十分之一；vanilla DPO、IPO、KTO 皆不敵基線，SamPO 僅部分改善。在 AToKE 知識更新基準上整體準確率達 0.982，能依查詢時期正確回答新舊事實，優於直接改寫參數的編輯方法（協定不同，僅供參考）；MMLU 等六項通用基準幾乎不受影響。限制：AToKE 僅單一隨機種子、判分依賴 LLM 評審、訓練預算過大時輸出冗長重複；理論保證僅限初始化時的梯度均值。本研究顯示儲存與提取知識是不同的最佳化問題，尊重偏好對內的實際差異，即可用遠低於 CPT 的成本更新 LLM 知識並兼顧新舊事實。
