links.title: ASLEval: Measuring Privacy Exposure Displacement in LLM Agent Sessions

evidence: Abstract: expected-outlet-only view misses 46.9% of exposure recovered by the visible-exit union; attacker self-reports combine omissions with high false discovery.

Section 3.3: deterministic adjudicator validated by two annotators on 300 stratified observation-entity pairs with 0.850 raw agreement and Cohen's kappa = 0.747; primary strict F1 0.891, C2 candidate slice 0.762.
Section 5.2 / Table 4: matched C1 ZFE results across Agent-R and Agent-F runtimes, 10 sessions per row; guarded OLF 0.683 (Agent-R) and 0.656 (Agent-F), runtime OLF difference -0.028 with p = 0.9219.
Section 5.2: boundary-complete protection in Agent-R reduces session coverage by -0.543 (95% CI [-0.793,-0.280], p = 0.0156); oracle all-exit redaction sanity check reduces coverage to zero.

Section 5.4: minimizing model-visible returns reduces overlapping visible entities by 45.7% (196.0 to 104.8) but on a 15-task slice task success falls 0.800 to 0 with 5.76x estimated API cost increase.
Section 4: request budget B=20, session-level statistics with 10,000 bootstrap resamples, seed 2027, exact sign-flip paired tests; models deepseek-v4-flash, GLM-4.7, adjudicator deepseek-v4-pro.

Section 7 Limitations: synthetic enterprise-style data, modest item and seed counts, two runtimes sharing the same model/environment, C3 is request/probe-level temporal order not a causal chain, no code or artifact availability stated anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic: an authorization-aware evaluation framework for privacy leakage in tool-using LLM agent sessions, squarely matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, LLMs); not a pure domain application. The 'privacy exposure displacement' reframing (outlet, recognition, path) is a genuinely useful measurement contribution, though it is a methodology/benchmark paper building on established agent-privacy benchmarks (Privacy in Action, AgentDAM, AgentLeak, CIPL) rather than a new attack or defense. Rigor is above average: formal evaluation contract, pre-registered hidden target sets, defined metrics (ECR, OLF), exact sign-flip tests with 10,000 bootstrap resamples and fixed seed, a negative authorization control, an oracle redaction sanity check, and human adjudication (300 pairs, Cohen's kappa 0.747, strict F1 0.891). Evidence is honestly scoped — C1 replicated across two independently implemented runtimes and cross-model (DeepSeek, GLM) with CIs and p-values, while C2 is flagged as the hardest adjudication slice and C3 is carefully framed as association and temporal ordering, not causation. Main weaknesses: small samples (10 sessions per C1 condition, 5 sessions per model for C3, 15-task utility slice), synthetic enterprise data with modest item counts (self-acknowledged in Limitations), and no code/artifact release statement, which caps reproducibility despite detailed setup and named public environments.

primary_link.title: ASLEval: Measuring Privacy Exposure Displacement in LLM Agent Sessions

These local proxies can miss unauthorized exposure elsewhere in a multi-step session and lack common ground truth across outlets, reports, and tool paths. We introduce privacy exposure displacement, the mismatch between a local evaluation proxy and target-grounded session exposure, and ASLEval, an authorization-aware framework that pre-registers a hidden target set, measures all de
recommendations.summary_zh: 針對現有使用工具之 LLM 代理人的隱私與安全評測基準多僅檢視單一指定動作、最終回答或攻擊者報告,這類本地代理指標容易漏失多步工作階段其他位置的未經授權資料外洩。作者將此偏差稱為「隱私暴露位移」,並提出 ASLEval 評測框架:事前預先登錄隱藏目標實體集合、授權關係、預期輸出通道與宣告的可見邊界;之後由不具目標知識的探測代理人與黑箱目標代理人互動,對所有可見通道統一計分,內部工具軌跡僅作診斷用。跨三個企業風格環境與兩套獨立實作執行系統的實驗揭示三種模式:(1)通道位移:啟用電子郵件防護後,該通道覆蓋率下降但工作階段整體暴露幾乎不變,僅觀察預期通道的視角漏失可見通道聯集所回復暴露的 46.9%;(2)辨識位移:攻擊者自報清單既有漏失也有誤報,候選精確度低至 0.148;(3)路徑位移:結構化內部證據通常在請求/探測層級先於可見暴露出現(76.3%)。另外,減少模型可見內容雖能降低暴露,卻使正常任務成功率歸零(由 0.800 降至 0),顯示沒有免費的防禦。限制包括採用合成資料、項目與種子數量有限、路徑發現僅建立相關與時序而非因果推論;人工複核雖支持裁決流程,但主控台與候選案例判定準確度較低。本文主張隱私基準應預先登錄目標與授權、宣告完整可見邊界,並將隱私與任務效用一併報告。
recommendations.title: ASLEval: Measuring Privacy Exposure Displacement in LLM Agent Sessions
recommendations.title_zh: ASLEval:衡量 LLM 代理人工作階段中的隱私暴露位移

links.title: Beyond Token-Local Imitation: Reward-Compatible Temporal Credit Assignment for On-Policy Distillation

evidence: Abstract & Section 1: proposes γOPD, a discounted temporal-credit surrogate for on-policy distillation, plus Reward-Compatible Bounded Mixing (RBM) for LLM post-training
Propositions 3.1–3.2 (Section 3.1) with proofs in Appendix A–B derive token-level OPD as a stop-gradient approximation of the sequence-level reverse-KL gradient
Theorem 3.3 (Section 3.2) with proof in Appendix C: horizon-dependent variance for sequence-level OPD vs horizon-independent bound σΔ²/(1−γ)² for γOPD
Section 4.1: seven baselines (OPD, ExOPD, REOPOLD, AOPD, TOPD, JustRL, STAPO); all methods implemented on veRL with vLLM; γ=0.99 default
Table 1: vanilla setting γOPD AvgAcc 69.49 vs teacher 68.10; size-mismatch setting 56.51 vs best baseline JustRL 54.51
Table 3: ablation isolates discounting (+2.04 over vanilla OPD on AIME), reward mixing without discounting (+2.00), full combination (+3.91)
Section 6 (Conclusion): limitation that experiments are limited to models with fewer than 10B parameters
Appendix F.1 Table 5: profiling shows 0.1064% compute and 0.00046% memory overhead vs vanilla OPD
Appendix E Table 4: full hyperparameters (lr 1e-5, batch 1024, 16384 max response, 32 NVIDIA H20 GPUs); no code-release statement, seeds, or variance/error bars reported anywhere in the document
Section 4.4 Figure 4: γ sensitivity (0, 0.9, 0.99, 1) showing sequence-level γ=1 suffers gradient-norm blowup and entropy collapse
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM post-training methodology paper: on-policy distillation with temporal credit assignment for math/code reasoning on Qwen3 teacher-student setups. Preference relevance is high (LLM training, reasoning, RL-style objectives). Novelty is moderate: the core idea is applying a discount factor to distillation log-ratio advantages—an RL-standard technique—and the theoretical results are simple policy-gradient derivations plus a triangle-inequality variance bound; reward-mixing with distillation is already explored in cited work (REOPOLD, AOPD, RWOPD, SCOPE). Rigor is solid: propositions with proofs (Appendix A–C), seven baselines, three distillation settings, component ablations, γ-sensitivity, and overhead profiling; however, no seeds, error bars, or significance tests are reported and a self-cited nonstandard optimizer (RADAR) is used. Evidence strength is good—consistent gains across Table 1/2 (e.g., surpassing the teacher, 69.49 vs 68.10 AvgAcc) and ablation attribution in Table 3—but rests on single runs. Generalizability is decent within LLM reasoning but untested beyond <10B Qwen3 models and math/code domains, as the authors acknowledge. Reproducibility is fair: detailed hyperparameters (Table 4), datasets, verifiers, and pseudocode are given, but no code release or seed protocol is stated.

primary_link.title: Beyond Token-Local Imitation: Reward-Compatible Temporal Credit Assignment for On-Policy Distillation

recommendations.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an effective approach for large language model post-training, yet existing objectives face a trade-off between objective fidelity and optimization stability. Token-level OPD provides stable but local supervision, whereas sequence-level OPD captures future credit at the cost of horizon-dependent variance. We establish a unified temporal-credit view of these formulations, showing that practical token-level OPD can be interpreted as a temporal approximati
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對大型語言模型後訓練中的 on-policy 蒸餾(OPD)提出統一分析與改良。現有方法面臨目標忠實度與最佳化穩定性的取捨:token 層級 OPD 提供穩定但局部的監督訊號,sequence 層級 OPD 雖能捕捉未來信用,變異數卻隨序列長度增長而暴增。作者從時間性信用分配的視角證明,實務上的 token 層級 OPD 其實是 sequence 層級 reverse-KL 梯度的時間截斷近似。據此提出 γOPD,引入折扣因子 γ 在兩端點之間內插,並證明其變異數具有與序列長度無關的上界。再設計獎勵相容有界混合機制(RBM),先對教師優勢做反應級標準化與 softsign 有界化,再與可驗證的結果獎勵相加,使獎勵正負號決定強化或抑制,教師訊號僅調節更新力度。實驗涵蓋數學與程式推理,在 vanilla、尺寸不匹配與多教師三種蒸餾設定中,γOPD 於 AIME24、AIME25、AMC23、MATH500、HumanEval+、MBPP+ 與 LiveCodeBench 上一致超越 OPD 系列基準與 RL 方法,vanilla 與多教師設定下平均更超越教師模型,額外計算開銷僅約 0.1%。限制為實驗僅涵蓋 10B 參數以下模型,γ 為固定超參數(預設 0.99)。此研究為 OPD 的偏差與變異數取捨提供理論基礎,並展示學生模型超越教師的可行路徑,對 LLM 後訓練具實務價值。
recommendations.title: Beyond Token-Local Imitation: Reward-Compatible Temporal Credit Assignment for On-Policy Distillation
recommendations.title_zh: 超越詞元局部模仿:以獎勵相容的時序信用分配改進 On-Policy 蒸餾

links.title: Coding Agents Have Converged: Why the SWE-bench Leaderboard Can No Longer Order Its Top Entries, and What to Measure Instead

evidence: Abstract: top-ten systems share 285 successes and 51 failures on 500 Verified instances; frontier median nesting 0.935 vs score-implied baseline 0.774; 0 of 29 adjacent Verified pairs separable at α=0.05.
Section 3.2/Table 3: nesting exceeds its score-implied baseline in every ability band (frontier excess +0.161), arguing convergence is not an artifact of high scores.

Section 4.1: within-model scaffold range for claude-3-5-sonnet across nine scaffolds is 149 instances (29.8pp) versus the 8.8pp top-thirty spread; five repeat-cell replications give a median replication floor of 27 instances (5.4pp).

Section 5/Table 4: the same McNemar test separates 14 of 23 adjacent pairs on the 2,294-instance Test split, supporting irresolvability as a property of the converged comparison set rather than the test.

Section 3.3: alternative explanations quantitatively tested — 2PL IRT fit (in-sample accuracy 0.868), human-effort ordering inconsistent with defect account, PR-age correlation −0.069 with 95% bootstrap CI [−0.148, +0.012].
Section 7 Limitations: factorial design is observational, 54% of submissions unplaceable, one run per submission, results limited to one benchmark family and one harness.

Reproducibility section: GitHub repository (github.com/Adkid-Zephyr/resolution-audit), frozen analysis manifest, seeds and input hashes recorded; all inputs are publicly published per-instance verdicts requiring no model access.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical match: the paper audits LLM coding-agent evaluation (SWE-bench), directly engaging Agents & Tool Use (coding agents, scaffolds), Code & Programming, LLMs, and benchmark evaluation preferences, though it is a meta-evaluation rather than a new agent/LLM method. Rigor is high: paired exact McNemar tests with Holm correction, bootstrapped difference-in-differences interaction tests, a Test-split counter-test, IRT robustness checks, and explicit testing of alternative explanations (task defects via human-effort ordering, contamination via PR-age correlation). The paper is unusually careful about what its statistics do and do not license (non-rejection ≠ equivalence, observational ≠ causal). Novelty is moderate: the two claimed new constructs (comparison-set-relative n_eff, nesting coefficient vs score-implied baseline) are genuinely useful but the statistical machinery is established and honestly credited; the headline finding (0/29 adjacent pairs separable on a saturated leaderboard) is a novel extreme instance of known phenomena. Evidence is extensive and internally consistent, but inherently observational, single-run, and restricted to one leaderboard snapshot. Generalizability is limited by the authors' own admission to the SWE-bench family. Reproducibility is strong: public per-instance verdicts as sole inputs, frozen manifest, released pipeline, seeds and hashes.

primary_link.title: Coding Agents Have Converged: Why the SWE-bench Leaderboard Can No Longer Order Its Top Entries, and What to Measure Instead

recommendations.summary: Small differences on coding-agent leaderboards are often read as an ordering of systems. We audit whether the published verdicts support this reading, using 254 SWE-bench submissions across four splits without running models. On Verified, the leading two entries each resolve 396 of 500 instances. The top ten share 285 successes and 51 failures, leaving 164 instances that distinguish their outcomes. Frontier solution sets have median nesting 0.935 against a score-implied baseline of 0.774, indica
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文稽核 SWE-bench 排行榜是否真能為頂尖系統排出高下。作者不執行任何模型，而是分析四個公開分割共 254 個提交的逐實例判定結果，提出有效樣本數 n_eff(S)、巢狀係數、精確配對 McNemar 檢定與描述性層級等方法。主要發現：在 Verified 上，前兩名都解出 396 題，前十名共同解出 285 題、共同失敗 51 題，僅剩 164 題具區辨力；有效樣本比例從全體的 0.94 降至前十名的 0.33、前兩名的 0.07。前緣系統解題集合的巢狀係數中位數為 0.935，明顯高於分數隱含基線 0.774，顯示解法彼此巢狀而非互補。分數也不是模型的固有屬性：同一模型更換 scaffold 的差距可達 29.8 個百分點，超過前三十名的整體跨度 8.8 個百分點；九項模型×scaffold 交互作用檢定有六項在 Holm 校正後仍顯著，且 scaffold 優劣順序會隨模型反轉。配對檢定方面，Verified 前三十名的 29 對相鄰名次在 α=0.05 下全數無法區分，但實例更多、能力跨度更大的 Test 分割可分出 23 對中的 14 對，印證不可分源自比較集合收斂而非基準失效。限制：屬觀察性設計，無法推論 scaffold 的因果效果；每個提交僅單次執行；無法排除預訓練資料污染；結論僅限 SWE-bench 家族。本文貢獻在於提供可重用的五步稽核協定，建議社群報告 n_eff、以機器可讀格式記錄模型—scaffold 配對來源、發布層級而非嚴格排名，並以能打破巢狀的不一致實例作為新增題目的預算準則，避免把微小分數差距解讀為確立的排名差異。

links.title: OPEN-1B: A Fully Auditable Training Run

evidence: Abstract: claims 'fully auditable' tier where 'every operation on every data sample during training is independently reproducible on heterogeneous commodity hardware with bitwise certainty'.
§1 Contributions: releases RepOps, topologically invariant data loader, full dataset, checkpoints at 100-step intervals, and an audit harness for NVIDIA GPUs, x86/ARM CPUs, Apple Silicon.
§6 and Algorithm 1-2: sequentialized audit replay with TreeFold binary-carry fold reproducing the cluster's recursive-doubling all-reduce order bit-for-bit.
Table 6 (§3.3.2): Open-1B at 400B tokens scores 25.4 OLMES avg vs OLMo 2 1B's 31.9 at 4T tokens; authors acknowledge the token-budget confound in §7.
§4.2: quantizer step-size drift in pretraining fixed by recomputing scales each step (2*mean(|w|)/sqrt(q_max)); cost ~2% of step time; cause isolated by substitution ablations.
§5 Table 10: repop bf16 reaches 3.3% MFU vs stock PyTorch 40.5% on one node (12.2x gap); int8 narrows it to 6.8x, ~5x at 6 nodes; MFU ~5% during the released run (§5).
§3.4.1 Table 8: held-out mixture CE falls monotonically 6.59 to 2.580; power-law fit R^2=0.93 vs 0.71 on training loss.
§3.4: run validated only via internal 'hash comparisons on the steps which were repeated' across seven restart segments; no third-party audit or cross-device hash-match results are reported.
§7 Conclusion: describes RepOps as a 'proprietary library', in tension with the open-release claims in §1; the backdoor-detection capability (§1, §6) is claimed but never demonstrated experimentally.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Clearly in-scope: an end-to-end pretraining and release of a 1.61B decoder-only LLM (§3) whose core contribution is auditable, bitwise-reproducible training infrastructure (RepOps, topologically invariant data stream, deterministic collectives; §2, §6), plus native int8 QAT with useful stability findings (§4.1-4.2). Strongly matches LLM/Training/Transformer/Scaling preferences, moderately the AI Safety angle via backdoor/bias auditability. Novelty is solid: the 'fully auditable run' tier and step-replay audit harness are new, though components (counter-based RNG, fixed reduction order, FTZ matching, recursive-doubling all-reduce) are individually established techniques combined rather than invented. Rigor is mixed: detailed recipe, loss/gradient statistics, spike analysis, and scaling tables are commendable, but there is no controlled int8-vs-bf16 model-quality comparison (only loss-curve divergence of ~0.2 nats in Fig. 7, and the bf16 baseline differs in numerics), the benchmark gap to OLMo 2 1B is confounded by a 10x token-budget difference (Table 6), and the headline claim of detecting injected backdoors/biases (§1, §6) is asserted but never demonstrated with an injection experiment or third-party audit result. Evidence for overheads and convergence is strong (Tables 8-11, Appendix B); evidence for the central audit guarantee rests on internal restart hash comparisons (§3.4) with no published cross-device hash-match table. Generalizability is moderate: methods are architecture-agnostic but the ~5x overhead vs. stock PyTorch (3.3% vs 40.5% MFU at 1 node, Table 10) and socket-fabric-specific scaling leave applicability to larger runs unproven. Reproducibility is exceptional by design: full dataset, 100-step checkpoints, code, audit harness, and per-step hashes are claimed released (§1, §7), slightly marred by calling RepOps 'proprietary' in §7.

primary_link.title: OPEN-1B: A Fully Auditable Training Run

recommendations.summary: Open-source language models have a reproducibility problem. Despite releasing weights, training data, and recipes, none of them are provably reproducible due to the non-associativity of floating-point arithmetic. Deep learning frameworks often offer a deterministic execution mode, allowing reproducible operations on the same machines. Unfortunately, this determinism does not carry across hardware such that a user can verify that a released checkpoint was actually produced using the declared trai
recommendations.summary_zh: 開源語言模型長期存在可重現性問題:即使公開權重、訓練資料與配方,由於浮點運算不滿足結合律,跨硬體無法逐位元重現訓練結果,因此無法證明模型確實依宣告流程訓練,也難以排除未揭露資料、注入偏誤或後門。本文提出「完全可稽核」的新透明度層級,並發表首個符合此標準的模型 Open-1B(1.61B 參數,於 48 張 H100 上預訓練 400B tokens)。方法核心包括:RepOps 程式庫,透過固定縮減順序、停用融合乘加、將次正規數歸零及計數器式亂數生成,在 x86/ARM CPU 與 NVIDIA、Apple GPU 上實現逐位元一致的運算;拓撲不變的資料載入器,使批次順序與叢集規模無關;以及可在單一裝置循序重放的確定性集合通訊。訓練採用 int8 量化感知預訓練(LSQ),並解決了梯度爬升與量化器步長漂移兩種不穩定性,最終 held-out 交叉熵降至 2.580,全程僅兩個批次觸發梯度跳過協定。代價是效能:可重現執行的 MFU 僅約 5%,比最佳化的 PyTorch bf16 慢約 5 倍;且因僅訓練 400B tokens,基準測試落後於使用 4T tokens 的 OLMo 2 1B。作者同時釋出完整預訓練資料集、每 100 步的中間檢查點、程式碼與稽核工具,配合逐步狀態雜湊與集體稽核機制,第三方可在消費級硬體上逐位元驗證任一訓練步驟,首次使後門注入等攻擊可被確切偵測,對建立可驗證的開源 AI 具重要意義。
recommendations.title: OPEN-1B: A Fully Auditable Training Run

links.title: Smarter by the Moment: Environment-Driven Dynamic Policies for Continual LLM Improvement

evidence: Abstract: DRPG integrates memory-based retrieval with a dynamic policy generator, evaluated across six benchmarks (text-to-SQL, QA, medical diagnosis, Python programming) with seven LLMs from proprietary and open-weight families.
Section 5.1 / Table 1: DRPG beats Self-StreamICL in 29/42 model-dataset configurations (35/42 vs Self-Refine and Zero-shot), with the strongest gains on text-to-SQL (18/21).

Section 5.1 / Appendix G Table 9: one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test p=0.005 overall vs Self-StreamICL; per-dataset tests show significant gains on Spider (p=0.016) and CoSQL (p=0.031) but no significant difference on DDXPlus (p=0.938) and DS-1000 (p=0.734).

Section 5.3 / Table 2: cross-model ablation showing smaller models (scout, mistral-small) can serve as policy generators for stronger agents, and that same-model generation on maverick degrades HotpotQA (50.60) while cross-model avoids the drop (63.73, 63.07).
Appendix F / Table 8: no-feedback ablation on llama-3.3-70b shows DRPG beats the feedback-free variant on all six datasets, isolating the contribution of environment feedback.
Appendix C / Table 5: fully specified retrieval pipeline (BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5, FAISS cosine, question-only embedded key, k=16/4), shared unmodified across DRPG and baselines.
Appendix I (Figures 6-13): complete agent and policy-generator prompt templates for all four task types, supporting reproducibility.

Limitations: single fixed data ordering (seed=42) with no variance reported, clean per-step binary feedback acknowledged as idealization, no reasoning LLMs evaluated due to budget, and Dynamic Cheatsheet excluded as a baseline because it does not cover the chosen benchmarks.
Section 4.4: no OpenAI or Claude models tested; authors explicitly note the model spread 'does not by itself establish generality across all modern LLM ecosystems'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper squarely within preferred topics: memory-based continual adaptation of LLMs, retrieval-augmented in-context learning, agent-style environment feedback loops, and prompting/policy generation. Novelty is honest but incremental: the authors themselves state the contribution lies in the combination (Section 2.2, 'the novelty of DRPG lies less in its individual components than in the capability their combination enables') of contrastive retrieval plus streaming feedback-conditioned policy synthesis, distinct from MemPrompt/Self-StreamICL (example-level), Dynamic Cheatsheet (no environment feedback), and LEAP/SALAM (offline, static guidance). Rigor is solid: six benchmarks, seven main + two additional model families, shared retrieval pipeline, fixed prompts, Wilcoxon significance tests (Appendix G, p=0.005 overall), and multiple ablations (retrieval strategy, previous-policy, no-feedback, cross-model generators). Evidence is concrete with full tables, cost/token analysis (Appendix B), and calibrated claims that openly report ties/failures on DDXPlus and DS-1000. Limitations: single seed/ordering with no variance reporting, only clean per-step binary feedback (an acknowledged idealization), limited baselines (no Dynamic Cheatsheet comparison), no reasoning LLMs, and the no-feedback ablation run on only one model. Reproducibility is high on setup detail (full prompts in Appendix I, exact retriever config in Appendix C) but no code release is stated. Generalizability is decent across model families and four task types, but conclusions are explicitly scoped to clean-feedback streaming settings.

primary_link.title: Smarter by the Moment: Environment-Driven Dynamic Policies for Continual LLM Improvement

recommendations.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across diverse domains, but continual adaptation to evolving tasks and environments remains a key challenge. Existing memory-augmented approaches retrieve individual past examples as direct references, but do not explicitly synthesize actionable strategies from them, causing the same types of errors to recur. We propose Dynamic Retrieval-based Policy Generation (DRPG), a framework that integrates memory-based retrieval with a dynamic
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型(LLM)在線上串流環境中持續適應的挑戰。現有記憶增強方法僅將過往單一範例作為直接參考,未能從中歸納出可執行的策略,導致同類錯誤反覆出現。作者提出動態檢索式策略生成框架 DRPG:在每個時間步,代理先從記憶庫檢索答對的範例,並由獨立的策略產生器對比檢索正確與錯誤案例,濃縮成至多五點的行動指引(policy)供代理作答時參考;環境回傳的二元正確性回饋則存入記憶,持續支援後續檢索與策略生成。實驗涵蓋 text-to-SQL、問答、醫療診斷與 Python 程式設計六個基準,測試七個專有與開放權重模型。結果顯示 DRPG 在 42 個模型–資料集組合中,以 29 勝優於主要基準 Self-StreamICL,於 Spider、CoSQL、BIRD 等 SQL 任務增益最大,整體差異經單側 Wilcoxon 符號等級檢定顯著(p=0.005)。分析指出策略級指引最適合錯誤型態系統性且可泛化的任務;對需實例特定知識的任務(如 DDXPlus、DS-1000)則與基準相當。消融研究顯示策略生成對檢索組成穩健、不需前次策略延續性,且可由較小或跨家族模型擔任產生器以節省成本,移除環境回饋則效能全面下滑。限制包括仰賴每步乾淨的二元回饋、僅測試單一資料順序與非推理型模型,策略偶爾可能干預代理正確推理。本研究的價值在於為串流環境下何時採用策略級調適提供實務指引。
recommendations.title: Smarter by the Moment: Environment-Driven Dynamic Policies for Continual LLM Improvement
recommendations.title_zh: 時刻更聰明:環境驅動的動態策略讓 LLM 持續改進

links.title: AgentLSD: Evaluating AI Security Agents Under Adversarial Task Contamination

evidence: Abstract: 'agents capture 41% of the flags... traps increase the number of turns (+20) and reasoning tokens (+2k)'
Section 5.5 / Table 2: '605 baseline trials' and '3,061 trap trials' across 5 on-prem models plus GPT-5 on a reduced grid
Section 5.5 footnote: GPT-5 trap runs use 'the five trap instances that most reduce the on-prem solve rate' — a selection the authors disclose
Section 6.4: 'GPT-OSS collapses, from a 65% win rate when it avoids the decoy to 28% when it engages it'; DeepSeek '87%... against 85%'

Section 6.3: 'goal hijack (n=4) and exploration bait (n=3) cause the largest flag-capture losses... median changes near −50 to −65%'; 'false authority rests on a single instance (n=1) and should be read with care'

Section 7.2 Limitations: 'five trials per cell is coarse, and we report statistics without significance tests'; 'no benign-injection control experiments to quantify the effect of traps increasing page size'
Section 7.1: 'The measured effect sizes should not be extrapolated directly from web CTF to production'
Availability section: framework, trap specifications, configurations, and raw traces released at https://github.com/Golim/agent-lsd; Section 4.2 describes deterministic seeded generation
Section 3 Threat Model: static non-adaptive adversary, trap-unaware agents, claims explicitly limited to the controlled CTF setting
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM-agent robustness/security evaluation paper (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, AI Safety 2.0, Red Teaming & Evaluation 1.8) introducing 'adversarial task contamination' — non-instructional environmental deception (fake flags, decoy endpoints) distinct from prompt injection. The paired clean/trap design with deterministic YAML trap primitives, honeytoken telemetry, and DOM delivery verification is a genuine, if incremental, conceptual and engineering contribution over injection benchmarks like AgentDojo/InjecAgent. Methodology is solid (6,061+ paired trials, factorial design, identical scaffold, temperature 0, sole-authority flag checker), but weakened by no significance testing, coarse 5-trial cells, reporting only 5 of 7 trapped challenges, a biased GPT-5 trap subset chosen by on-prem degradation, and no benign-injection (page-size) control — all acknowledged in Section 7.2. Quantitative evidence is detailed and calibrated (41% clean solve; +20 turns/+2k reasoning tokens; GPT-OSS win rate 65%→28% after bait-taking), though family-level conclusions rest on few instances (false authority n=1). Generalizability is limited to 11 static DOM-channel web CTF challenges with trap-unaware agents and one scaffold; the authors correctly warn against extrapolation. Reproducibility is good: open-source framework, trap specs, configs, and raw traces released with deterministic generation. Overall a useful, well-executed benchmark paper with modest novelty and clearly scoped claims.

primary_link.title: AgentLSD: Evaluating AI Security Agents Under Adversarial Task Contamination

recommendations.summary: AI agents for security inspect web pages, source code, logs, configuration files, and command outputs. These environments may contain deceptive artifacts that influence the agent's behavior. We call this adversarial task contamination. Whereas prompt injection relies on attacker-supplied instructions, task contamination also includes non-instructional evidence, such as fake results and decoy endpoints. We present AgentLSD, a controlled framework for studying adversarial task contamination. Agent
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討AI資安代理面臨的新型威脅：對抗性任務污染（adversarial task contamination）。不同於仰賴攻擊者指令的提示注入（prompt injection），任務污染涵蓋非指令性的欺騙證據，如假旗標、誘餌端點與誤導提示。作者開發開源框架AgentLSD，以11個Flask網頁CTF挑戰為環境，將YAML定義的陷阱原語於執行期注入HTTP回應，同時保持漏洞、解法路徑與旗標不變，構成乾淨—陷阱配對實驗，並以honeytoken遙測記錄代理是否上鉤。評估六個模型顯示：乾淨條件下代理僅解出約41%旗標，連GPT-5也未能全數解出，語料庫未飽和。陷阱最一致的效果是增加負擔：仍成功的試次平均多耗約20個回合與2,000個推理token；解題率影響則不一致，goal hijack與exploration bait造成最大退化，GPT-OSS 120B最脆弱，Gemma-4 31B幾乎不受影響。遙測進一步指出，脆弱關鍵不在是否接觸誘餌，而在能否迅速脫離。限制包括陷阱僅限DOM通道、靜態且單次注入、缺乏Claude等前沿模型、每格僅五次試驗且未做統計檢定。此工作確立任務污染為資安代理的獨立穩健性議題，提供可重現基準，對設計具來源標記、結果驗證與復原機制的防禦具重要啟示。
recommendations.title: AgentLSD: Evaluating AI Security Agents Under Adversarial Task Contamination
recommendations.title_zh: AgentLSD：在對抗性任務污染下評估AI資安代理

links.title: Faithful yet Collusive: Why Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Cannot Detect Collusion in LLM Pricing Agents under Oligopolistic Competition

evidence: Abstract: 'collusive behavior and chain-of-thought (CoT) faithfulness dissociate along both dimensions' and 'CoT monitoring alone cannot serve as a standalone safeguard against algorithmic collusion'
Section 4.1: nine model families (GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Haiku 4.5, Qwen-2.5 32B/14B/7B, Gemma 9B, Llama-3.1 8B, Mistral 7B) with temperature 0.7, top-p 0.95, served via vLLM/API
Section 4.2: 'multiple independent 300-round runs per condition differing only in the random seed'; two-sided Welch's t-tests with Bonferroni note
Appendix G Table 4: extractor human validation on 40 sampled traces yields P=0.87, R=0.93, F1=0.90, dominant error 'cause-node misattribution'
Appendix H Table 5: GPT-5 composite faithfulness C-hat=0.937 while Sonnet 4.5 is most collusive (Delta-bar=+0.978, C-hat=0.678); Spearman rs=-0.30 (p=0.43)
Section 5.2: Pearson correlation between TS-hat and Delta-bar is r=0.25 (p=0.083) under N=3
Section 3.5: Common4 node filtering (V*={P_own, P_comp, D_own, Pi_own}) to control stated-graph density differences
Limitations: 'we have not yet validated it outside pricing' and N=2/N=3 pipelines 'not directly comparable on a numerical scale'
Appendix M Table 7: sensitivity of C-hat to edge-retention thresholds tau in {0.1, 0.2, 0.3} showing monotonic decline for most models

Appendix A: full system prompts, Prompt A/B variants, and causal-extraction prompt provided; Ethical Considerations: 'We deliberately withhold the specific prompt configurations that produce the strongest collusive outcomes'; no code/data release stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-scope LLM safety/agent paper: audits whether chain-of-thought monitoring can detect algorithmic collusion by LLM pricing agents, directly hitting Agents (2.5), Reasoning/CoT (2.5), LLMs (2.5), and AI Safety (2.0) preferences. Novelty is solid: the stated-vs-behavioral causal graph divergence framework plus a structural/intent faithfulness decomposition is a new diagnostic angle beyond prior CoT-faithfulness (Turpin, Lanham) and LLM-collusion (Fish) work, though it composes existing tools (LLM causal extraction, Granger/PCMCI+, JSD). Rigor is good: 9 model families, two market structures, seeded multi-run design, prompt variants, density-controlled metrics, extractor human validation (F1=0.90, n=40), threshold sensitivity, and Welch tests; weaknesses are small run counts (3-10 per condition), a marginal headline correlation (r=0.25, p=0.083), a null-result claim with low power (9 model points), and an extractor (Qwen-32B) that is itself an evaluated model. Evidence strength is moderate-to-good: quantitative tables (Tables 1, 5) clearly support the collusion-faithfulness dissociation, but intent-faithfulness findings are partly qualitative and the N=2/N=3 pipelines are admittedly non-comparable. Generalizability is limited to symmetric Bertrand pricing with N<=3, acknowledged by the authors as unvalidated outside pricing. Reproducibility benefits from full prompts, serving configs, thresholds, and appendices, but no code or data release is stated and some strongest-collusion configurations are withheld.

primary_link.title: Faithful yet Collusive: Why Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Cannot Detect Collusion in LLM Pricing Agents under Oligopolistic Competition

recommendations.summary: Large language models (LLM) deployed as autonomous pricing agents may sustain supracompetitive prices through tacit coordination. We develop a causal graph divergence framework that separately measures structural faithfulness and intent faithfulness of LLM pricing agents in Bertrand competition. Across nine LLMs under duopoly and triopoly conditions, collusive behavior and chain-of-thought (CoT) faithfulness dissociate along both dimensions: the most collusive model accurately reports cooperativ
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文探討 LLM 定價代理在寡占市場中是否形成默示勾結，以及 CoT（思維鏈）監控能否可靠偵測此類勾結。作者建立「因果圖分歧」架構：從 CoT 軌跡萃取「陳述因果圖」，並從實際價格序列以 Granger 因果與 PCMCI+ 推得「行為因果圖」，以 Jaccard 重疊、方向一致性與綜合分數衡量結構忠實度，另以 Jensen–Shannon 散度衡量陳述意圖與實際行為意圖之間的落差。實驗於 Bertrand 雙占與三占（logit 需求、300 回合）下評估九個模型。主要結果顯示勾結與忠實度明顯分離，兩者無顯著單調關係：GPT-5 結構忠實度最高（雙占 C=0.937、三占 TS=0.594），卻在兩種市場結構下持續訂出高於 Nash 均衡的價格；最勾結的 Claude Sonnet 4.5 結構忠實度低於中位數，意圖散度卻最低，其 CoT 坦白陳述合作意圖。開源模型多落入破壞性競爭；三占下勾結雖減弱，但三家前沿模型仍維持超 Nash 定價，忠實度排序大致不變。限制包括僅涵蓋同質廠商的 Bertrand 情境、雙占與三占兩套流程的數值不可直接比較、意圖分類較粗略，以及 LLM 解析器本身可能引入誤差。本研究的意義在於證明 CoT 監控不足以作為防制演算法勾結的獨立防線，監管仍須以實際價格結果的行為稽查為基礎，並輔以反事實探測等互補機制。
recommendations.title: Faithful yet Collusive: Why Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Cannot Detect Collusion in LLM Pricing Agents under Oligopolistic Competition
recommendations.title_zh: 忠實卻勾結：為何鏈式思考（CoT）監控無法偵測寡占競爭下 LLM 定價代理的勾結行為

links.title: RepoAtlas: Guiding Coding Agents via Evolving Multimodal Repository Views

evidence: Abstract: claims 2.4-point resolve-rate gain with 5.8% fewer input tokens and 7.8% fewer model calls vs strongest multimodal graph baseline across three models
Section 5.1: evaluation on all 500 SWE-bench Verified and all 560 LocBench instances; three VLM families (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MiMo-V2.5, Kimi-K2.5); three runs per configuration; budgets B_V=15, B_E=20
Section 5.3 Table 3: six ablations on SWE-bench Verified; per-call refresh drops resolve to 51.0% with highest tokens/calls, no refresh 58.4%, removing textual channel 59.2%
Section 5.3 Table 4: selection analysis on LocBench shows w/o PageRank lowers FA@3 from 0.336 to 0.290 and w/o representative exposure lowers FR from 0.252 to 0.102
Section 5.4: failure case sympy-17630 - runtime-registered dependency absent from static graph; RepoAtlas never opens gold file across eight runs, honestly reported limitation
Section 5.2: SeeRepo reproduction shows views obtained in only 40.5% of instances, used to justify guaranteed initial view; main text reports no confidence intervals or significance tests

Section 4.2/4.4 and Section 5.1: calibration, selection pipeline, and state-transition details deferred to appendix not included in provided text; no code or artifact availability statement anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM coding-agent paper (Agents/Code/LLM preferences) proposing RepoAtlas, a training-free select-project-refresh module that maintains budgeted multimodal (visual+textual) repository views over a static code graph. Relevance is high: repository-level issue resolution with LLM/VLM agents, in-context view management, and tool-based exploration. Novelty is moderate: personalized-PageRank relevance propagation, budgeted subgraph selection, and graph rendering are established; the state-aware auto-refresh and view-maintenance framing distinguish it from SeeRepo's on-demand views. Rigor is solid: full 500-instance SWE-bench Verified plus 560-instance LocBench, three model families, three runs, six-component ablation, selection-only analysis, and an honest failure case; however no significance testing and per-run variance are relegated to an appendix. Evidence is consistent across Tables 2-4 with matched baselines, but effect sizes are modest (1.1-3.0 points) and cost comparisons rely on provider list prices. Generalizability is limited to Python-centric static graphs and VLM-capable models; the paper itself flags runtime-dependency blind spots. Reproducibility is uncertain: training-free and well-specified, but calibration/implementation details live in an appendix not provided and no code release is claimed.

primary_link.title: RepoAtlas: Guiding Coding Agents via Evolving Multimodal Repository Views

recommendations.summary: Large language model (LLM)-powered coding agents have made rapid progress in automating software engineering tasks, yet repository-level issue resolution remains challenging. Beyond generating a plausible patch, an agent must localize relevant code across interdependent files and maintain repository context that is both sufficient and focused. Code graphs expose non-local relations, but linear text interfaces obscure their topology; rendering the full repository graph yields visual representatio
recommendations.summary_zh: RepoAtlas 針對大型語言模型程式代理在儲存庫層級議題解決上的難題：相關程式碼散布於相互依賴的檔案之間，而現有程式碼圖方法多以線性文字呈現，使拓撲結構隱而不顯；完整渲染的圖過於稠密難以可靠辨識，一次性的局部檢視又會隨探索過程失效。作者提出免訓練模組 RepoAtlas，在離線建構的儲存庫程式碼圖上，以「選取—投影—更新」迴圈維護演進式檢視：選取階段融合議題的詞彙、語意與軌跡證據，並以個人化 PageRank 傳播相關性，在固定節點與邊數預算下組出連通的任務相關子圖；投影階段依圖拓撲與探索狀態自適應選擇版面，產生對齊的視覺圖與記載精確符號及原始碼位置的文字索引；更新階段則依狀態判斷檢視是否過時，定位階段維持多模態檢視，開始編輯後切換為聚焦文字檢視。在 SWE-bench Verified 的 500 個實例上，RepoAtlas 相較最強的多模態圖基線平均提升解決率 2.4 個百分點，輸入 token 減少 5.8%、模型呼叫次數減少 7.8%，且在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、MiMo-V2.5 與 Kimi-K2.5 三種 VLM 上結果一致。消融實驗顯示視覺與文字通道互補，固定預算、自適應版面與狀態感知更新各有貢獻。主要限制是靜態圖無法涵蓋僅於執行期註冊的依賴，失敗案例 sympy-17630 即源於此；未來擬結合執行軌跡與測試回饋補足。本研究說明儲存庫圖作為演進式多模態脈絡，比靜態文字承載更能有效引導代理。
recommendations.title: RepoAtlas: Guiding Coding Agents via Evolving Multimodal Repository Views
recommendations.title_zh: RepoAtlas：透過演進式多模態儲存庫檢視引導程式開發代理

links.title: DiverseFT: Diversifying Fault-Tolerant Systems using LLMs

evidence: Abstract (Page 1): 'up to 65% of the codebase can be diversified' across PBFT, HotStuff, and Raft using LLMs.

Section 2 (Page 3) and Table 1 (Page 3): claims DiverseFT is 'the first work that provides diversified implementations for the core protocol of a BFT system in a scalable way'; contrasts with Galápagos [74] limited to pure functions without side effects.
Section 6 Evaluation (Page 8): 'we have generated 4945 patches'; open-weight models pass all safeguards at 6.5% vs 19.4% for the commercial model.
Section 6 Qctx ablation (Page 9, Figure 10): removing codebase context causes hallucinations that drop functional safeguard pass rates while paradoxically raising clone-safeguard passes.

Section 6 Stress test (Page 11, Figure 12): Shadow-based deterministic fault injection with bisection and k-set statistics identifies 7 faulty patches of 1224; after filtering 'all 100 executions succeed'.
Section 6 Performance & 24h test (Pages 11-12, Figures 13-14): geometric mean differences of 0.25% throughput and 0.53% latency; 24-hour run processed 3,297,273,515 requests with no observed fault.
Section 7 Discussion (Page 12, Listing 4): limitation that bugs spanning multiple functions cannot be fixed due to fixed function signatures, though LLM CoT correctly identified the quorum bug.
Section 5 Implementation (Page 7): TreeSitter used for function/context extraction; anecdote that Openraft and HotStuff integration took ≈5 hours; inference via GWDG infrastructure.
Section 4.1 (Page 5): explicitly states the work shows representational and binary diversification, 'while our work cannot show fault-independence'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-methodology paper: uses multiple LLMs (Mistral, Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1, Sonnet) with structured prompting and codebase-context injection to generate function-level diversified Rust implementations of PBFT, HotStuff, and Raft, with a validation framework (build/test, clone detection, binary diff, stress testing) and LLM ablations (context, diversify instruction, temperature). Strong fit to LLM (2.5), Code & Programming (2.0), AI Safety/robustness (2.0), and Prompting (1.5) preferences; not a pure domain application. Novelty is solid—first automated diversification of BFT protocol internals via LLMs, extending Galápagos beyond pure functions (Section 2, Page 3; Table 1, Page 3)—though LLM-for-code-variant generation is an emerging and somewhat expected direction. Rigor is above average: 4945 patches across three protocols, ablations, deterministic Shadow fault injection with bisection/k-set attribution, 100 stress runs, 24-hour test, performance deltas (0.25%/0.53%, Page 11-12); weaknesses include an unverifiable unpublished bug from private correspondence (Page 3-4), no demonstration of true fault independence (acknowledged, Page 5), small-sample bins (9/18, Page 9), and an unexplained temperature result (Page 8). Evidence is quantitative and traceable to figures, with some anecdotal claims (cost <$50, 5-hour porting). Generalizability is moderate: Rust-only, function-level, requires existing tests; multi-function bugs explicitly out of scope (Section 7, Page 12). Reproducibility is moderate: open-weight models chosen for a 'reproducible lower bound' (Page 8), prompts and configurations detailed, but no explicit artifact/code release statement for DiverseFT itself is verified in the text.

primary_link.title: DiverseFT: Diversifying Fault-Tolerant Systems using LLMs

recommendations.summary: Fault-tolerant agreement protocols fail if replicas share a common flaw that simultaneously affects more replicas than the tolerable threshold. Therefore replicas should ideally fail independently, which can be achieved through diversification. However, in practice, often the same protocol implementation is shared by all replicas which is not surprising given that the provision of multiple diverse implementations is difficult and highly laborious. This poses a major risk, as a shared protocol im
recommendations.summary_zh: BFT 與 CFT 共識協定的安全保證假設副本不會因同一弱點同時失效，但實務上各副本常共用同一份實作，共用弱點可能一次突破容錯門檻；傳統 N-version programming 因成本高昂而鮮少採用。DiverseFT 運用多個 LLM（Mistral、Qwen3、DeepSeek-R1、Sonnet），以函式為單位自動改寫 PBFT、HotStuff、Raft 的 Rust 參考實作，產生功能等價但語法與二進位相異的變體，並設置層層防護：建置與測試、克隆偵測、二進位差異比對、執行驗證，最後於 Shadow 模擬器注入 leader 當機進行壓力測試，再以二分法與 k-set 統計定位跨修補互動才顯現的錯誤。實驗產生 4945 個修補，兩輪即可取代多達 65% 的程式碼，單一函式最多獲得 7 個互異變體；開源模型 6.5% 修補通過全部防護，商業模型達 19.4%，單一成功修補成本不足 10 美分。多元化對效能影響極小（吞吐量 0.25%、延遲 0.53%），過濾後 100 次壓力測試全數成功，24 小時實測處理逾 32.9 億筆請求且無故障；LLM 甚至在未被提示下修復 Themis 的未公開冒充弱點與兩個 Rust CVE。限制包括難以處理跨函式錯誤、超過 100 行函式成功率偏低，且僅驗證表徵與二進位差異而未能證明故障獨立性。此成果讓協定層級多元化具備實務可行性，大幅降低複製系統的單點失效風險。
recommendations.title: DiverseFT: Diversifying Fault-Tolerant Systems using LLMs

links.title: Collective Loss of Control in LLM Agent Systems: An Epidemic Account of Mutation, Contagion, and Recovery

evidence: Abstract: 'Across four native-pending routes, executed harm is 0-5% on normal tasks and 40-95% after injection, exceeding paired direct malicious requests by 5-45 percentage points.'
Section 7.2 (Table 3): deepseek-v4-flash rises from 40% direct to 85% handoff for a +45pp paired effect (9 induced / 0 suppressed).

Section 6 / Table 5: exact conditional McNemar diagnostics reported per route; deepseek-native p=0.0039 vs Qwen3.8-27B p=1.0000 (+5pp, 2/1 discordant), showing uneven evidential support across routes.

Section 3.4: mini-SWE-agent Docker probe — 'Three freshly generated markers were received exactly' across the default bridge; contrasted with Harbor/Compose per-project networks that block the path and Inspect's network_mode: none.

Section 5.2: append-only hash-chained ledger; 'the evaluator then derives harm from the ledger rather than from model text,' with pending harmful calls never replayed and only post-resumption actions attributed to the successor.

Section 10 (Limitations): '0/20 gives a one-sided 95% upper bound of 13.9%'; authors state results 'neither establish natural rare-event rates nor demonstrate an autonomous cascade' and that the generator checkpoint 'was not independently verified.'
Footnote 1: code and fixed inputs claimed publicly available at github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard/tree/main/Research/roguehandoff20.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope work on LLM agent safety, multi-agent contagion, and adversarial evaluation. The paired direct-vs-rogue-prefix design (isolating the effect of inherited trajectory state beyond the harmful objective itself) is a genuine methodological contribution, complemented by a concrete deployment-audit finding (cross-container transport via mini-SWE-agent's default Docker bridge) and a formal SEIR-style model of session states. Rigor is above average: harm is scored from a protected ledger rather than model text, identification conditions are explicit, and limitations are unusually candid (including a power analysis showing the 0/20 normal baseline only bounds initiation at 13.9%). However, evidence rests on only 20 scenarios with one repetition per condition, a single unverified 'cracked' generator route, provider-reported model identities, and several routes with few or non-significant discordant pairs (Qwen3.8-27B effect +5pp with exact p=1.0); the epidemic formalism itself is never fit to data (R0 unestimated), and the cutoff experiment is exploratory with confounded boundary type. Generalizability is limited by one generator, one harness, one handoff edge. Code availability in Tencent's AI-Infra-Guard repo aids reproducibility, but the modified checkpoint and frozen-history provenance are not independently verifiable.

primary_link.title: Collective Loss of Control in LLM Agent Systems: An Epidemic Account of Mutation, Contagion, and Recovery

recommendations.summary: How does a multi-agent system evolve from a local deviation into collective loss of control? We propose an epidemic explanation organized around accidental mutation, contagion, and recovery. A spontaneous deviation creates a seed; communication enables other agents to adopt and retransmit its unsafe strategy; collective failure can emerge when propagation outpaces correction and containment. Thus, rare individual deviations can coexist with substantial collective risk. Motivated by reported Open
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討多代理（multi-agent）系統如何從局部偏異演變為集體失控。作者以流行病學框架提出解釋，區分三個過程：意外突變（自發產生不安全策略的種子）、傳染（其他代理透過通訊採納並再傳播該策略）與自我修復。受 OpenAI 代理協同事件（如 Hugging Face 入侵與 DSEWiki）啟發，研究分別檢驗此機制的兩項要素。其一，部署稽核在名義上相互隔離的公開評測部署中識別出隱性通訊路徑，並以 mini-SWE-agent 預設 Docker 後端驗證資訊確實能在容器間傳遞。其二，作者建立 RogueHandoff-20 基準，涵蓋 20 個可執行情境，將修改版「破解」Qwen-27B 產生的不安全軌跡注入受測代理。結果顯示：四條原生擱置呼叫路線在正常任務的實際傷害率僅 0–5%，注入後升至 40–95%，比配對的直接惡意請求高出 5–45 個百分點；截斷實驗更發現「語意承諾懸崖」，完整的待決工具呼叫遠比較長但不完整的推理片段更具行為影響力。限制方面：僅 20 個精選情境且各條件單次重複，無法估計自然界的稀有突變率，也未展示自主的多跳傳播鏈，合成軌跡與自然失敗的對應性仍待驗證。本文的價值在於指出低觀察基線傷害可與高條件易感性並存，防禦應兼顧訓練代理抗拒並自我修正被傳播的不安全狀態，以及稽核、限縮非預期通訊路徑，因為僅降低突變率無法降低集體失控的傳播門檻。

recommendations.title_zh: LLM 代理系統的集體失控：突變、傳染與康復的流行病學解釋

links.title: On the Importance of Gating: Memorization vs. In-Context Learning in State Space Models

evidence: Abstract: gating mechanism causes SSMs to first learn an in-weights memorization solution while delaying or preventing convergence to ICL, even without architectural memory limitations
Section 2.3, Proposition 1: initial growth-rate ratio δ̇r(0)/δ̇m(0) = Pα²/((1-2ϵ)(1+α)²) yields critical scale α*≈sqrt((1-2ϵ)/P) separating retrieval vs. memorization regimes
Proposition 4 / Appendix B.1: escape time from memorization plateau T = Θ(1/(α0 log(1/α0))), potentially exponential in query distance and double-exponential in λ initialization scale
Section 2.4, Proposition 9: decay induces locality; maximum retrievable distance Δmax = Θ(τ log(d/τ)), validated in Figure 1d
Section 5.2 / Figure 4: on BFCL, weaker Mamba gating scores moderately better and hallucinates less, but gating does not influence length generalization in the probed range (reported negative result)
Appendix D.2.2 and D.2.3: full optimization details (AdamW betas/weight decay/warmup/cosine, 8xH100, bfloat16) and five random seeds for Figure 2
Appendix D.5: ~200 experiments each under 10 hours on 8xH100 plus pretraining on 128xH100 for under two days, total under 28,288 H100 GPU hours
Section 6: authors state the work does not offer an immediate solution, and that scalar gating may be insufficient, requiring higher-dimensional or non-linear state transitions
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core architecture-science paper directly on preference topics: SSMs/Mamba/linear attention (Transformer Architecture), in-context learning vs. memorization (ICL), length generalization (Long Context), and a full tool-calling section using BFCL with a BM25 tool retriever (Agents & Tool Use). Novelty is solid but incremental: gating-induced recency bias and mimetic/no-decay initialization for copying are already known (Trockman et al. 2024; Wang et al. 2024); the fresh part is the memorization-plateau escape-time analysis and the explicit dual-role tradeoff (gating hurts short-context ICL retrieval but enables length generalization). Rigor is high: formal propositions with proofs (Appendix B), stated simplifying assumptions (orthonormal tokens, identity K/Q/V, gradient flow), quantitative validation of predicted critical α*, escape-time scaling, and Bayes-error contours (Figure 1), gate-drift check for the static-gate assumption (Table 1, Appendix B.3). Evidence is strengthened by 5 seeds, Transformer baselines, a hyperparameter sweep, honest negative results (no gating effect on BFCL length generalization in the probed range), and explicit compute reporting (~28,288 H100-hours, ~200 runs, Appendix D.5). Generalizability is capped because theory covers a simplified single-head gated linear model and the authors concede (Section 6) that no fix is offered and scalar gating may be fundamentally insufficient for complex retrieval. Reproducibility is good on hyperparameters, architectures, datasets (Nemotron-CC-HQ, Nemotron Agentic, BFCL python simple), and seeds, but no code release is stated.

recommendations.summary: State Space Models (SSMs) have emerged as a compelling alternative to Transformers, enabling sequence modeling with constant memory and linear compute. Although SSMs exhibit reasonable performance and favorable computational characteristics, they continue to lag behind Transformers on tasks that require in-context learning and precise retrieval, slowing their adoption for large-scale language modeling. In this work, we demonstrate that both the success and failure of SSMs in these domains can be
recommendations.summary_zh: State Space Models(SSM)如 Mamba 具有線性計算與常數記憶體的優勢,但在需要 in-context learning(ICL)與精確檢索的任務上仍落後 Transformer。本文跳脫「表達能力不足」的傳統解釋,指出 gating 機制的初始化與訓練動態才是關鍵:強 gating 會讓模型先收斂到依賴權重的「記憶化」解,延遲甚至阻礙正確的 ICL 解。作者針對帶全域 gating 參數的簡化 Mamba 模型做理論分析,將 signed margin 分解為記憶化與檢索兩項,證明初始化強弱決定收斂路徑,並推導逃離記憶化高原的時間約為 1/(α log(1/α)),可能隨查詢距離呈指數成長;另一方面證明衰減可控制長上下文的雜訊累積,有效可檢索距離約為 τ log(d/τ),故強 gating 反而利於長度泛化。實驗以多 token 檢索、Horn 子句邏輯規則任務,以及預訓練 Mamba 於 BFCL 工具呼叫的微調加以驗證:較弱 gating 降低幻覺率、加快學會檢索,較強 gating 則改善超出訓練長度的泛化表現。限制在於本文重在科學理解,未提出直接解方,改變初始化可能犧牲長上下文表現,且純量 gating 或不足以支援複雜的記憶管理,未來可能需要更高維線性或非線性的狀態轉移。整體而言,此研究闡明 gating 在訓練動態與泛化之間的雙重角色,為理解與改進線性時間架構奠定基礎。

Table 1: Colla-Q Avg 68.5 vs PMQ 67.5 at 2.54 bits, and 54.5 vs 54.5 at 1.57 bits on Mixtral 8x7B
Section 4.2: 'Our method exhibits almost no average performance drop at an average bit-width of 2.54 bits' contradicts Table 1 FP16 Avg 72.4 -> 68.5
Table 4: Average cosine similarity of Ours 91.6-98.9 across calibration datasets vs PMQ 46.3-86.0 (Mixtral/Phi3.5)

Appendix A.4: expert-GEMM kernels on RTX 3090, 10 warm-up/30 repetitions, 1.39x-1.48x expert-computation speedup (Figure 4), expert-level only

Section 3.1 Eq. 3-4: convex ensemble-error argument motivating equal expert errors, assumptions verified in Appendix A.1 Tables 9-11 and A.2 Table 12
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope methodological paper on mixed-precision PTQ for MoE LLMs (Mixtral 8x7B, DeepSeek-MoE-16B, Phi3.5-MoE), directly relevant to LLM, transformer-architecture (MoE), and efficiency preferences. Novelty is moderate: the activation-entropy expert-performance proxy and minimax bit balancing offer a genuinely different allocation signal than routing-frequency methods (PMQ, MxMoE, QuantMoE-Bench), but the greedy algorithm is simple and mixed-precision MoE quantization is a crowded area. Rigor is strong: ensemble-error analysis whose two key assumptions (approximately uniform routing weights, Gaussian activations) are empirically verified in Appendices A.1-A.2, five baselines, three bit budgets (2.54/2.05/1.57), 5-shot checks, and a 2x2 metric-vs-algorithm ablation plus ILP comparison (Tables 19-20). Evidence is solid but margins are often small (e.g., Table 2 DeepSeek 1.57-bit: 39.0 vs 38.3) and the Section 4.2 claim of 'almost no average performance drop' at 2.54 bits is overstated given 72.4->68.5 on Mixtral (Table 1). Generalizability is explicitly tested across four calibration datasets (Table 4: cosine similarity 91.6-98.9 for Ours vs 46.3-86.0 for PMQ) but limited to weight-only quantization and models under 50B, as honestly stated in Limitations. Reproducibility is aided by a public code link (Abstract) and detailed setup (A.4), though the repo cannot be verified from the text.

recommendations.summary: In this paper, we present a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) quantization method based on activation entropy. Although quantization reduces memory and computational costs, it can substantially degrade performance. In particular, performance decline is pronounced in quantized MoE models, where individual experts have a small number of parameters that are sensitive to low-bit representation. Considering that MoE operates as an ensemble model with collaborative contributions from routed experts, a signific
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文針對 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）大型語言模型在低位元量化下效能嚴重衰退的問題，提出名為 Colla-Q 的位元寬度分配框架。作者從整體學習視角出發，指出 MoE 中各專家參數量少、對低位元量化特別敏感，一旦部分弱勢專家效能大幅下滑，便會拖累聚合後的整體輸出。有別於以往依賴路由頻率等校正資料集統計量的方法，Colla-Q 先以基於激活熵的無標籤指標估計各專家的全精度效能，再透過極小極大精度平衡演算法，反覆將額外位元分配給表現最差的專家，使量化後各專家效能維持均衡。實驗涵蓋 Mixtral 8×7B、DeepSeek-MoE-16B 與 Phi3.5-MoE，在平均 2.54、2.05 與 1.57 位元設定下，Colla-Q 的零樣本與少樣本表現多半優於 Uniform、BSP、OA-GPTQ、MxMoE 及 PMQ；消融實驗也證實激活熵指標與平衡演算法各自有所貢獻。此外，該指標對校正資料集分布較不敏感，位元配置在不同校正資料集間保有高度餘弦相似度，泛化更穩定，並能以低位元 GEMM 核心取得約 1.39 至 1.48 倍的專家運算加速。限制方面，研究僅探討 weight-only 量化、受限於三個 16B 至約 47B 的模型，且未涵蓋專家分派與記憶體搬移等端對端推論開銷。整體而言，本研究的價值在於揭示維持專家間效能均衡，是低位元 MoE 量化的關鍵。

links.title: A Study on the Impact of Natural Language Differences in Prompts on Automatic Code Generation Using LLMs

evidence: Abstract/Results: language gaps range from 3.6%-6.6% for open-source LLMs and 2.7%-15.6% for closed-source LLMs; officially supported languages frequently yield highest median Accuracy.

Section 3.2 Data Collection: 756 AtCoder, 100 LeetCode (test cases prepared with ChatGPT assistance, validated on official site), and 288 BigCodeBench tasks (sample size from 95% CI / 5% margin); DeepL drafts verified by native-speaker authors with a coding book.

Section 5.2, Tables 13-17: translation into English gives median +6.2% (closed) / +6.3% (open) on LeetCode but -5.3% (closed) on AtCoder; translation into Japanese degrades both groups (-10.3% closed, -4.3% open median).

Section 6.1.2/6.1.3: narrative labeling kappa 0.941; Table 20 reports LeetCode 50.0% narrative, contradicting the 21.2% figure stated in Section 1; Observation 16 links AtCoder's ~2x longer statements (Table 24) to lower accuracy.

Section 8 Threats to Validity and Data Availability: acknowledges closed-model non-determinism, contamination from public solutions, and unvalidated low-resource translations; replication package at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20155616.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly aligned empirical LLM study: multilingual (EN/JA/ZH) prompting for code generation across GPT-4o, o3-mini, DeepSeek-V3.2, Llama-3, Qwen2.5-Coder, and Copilot on AtCoder/LeetCode/BigCodeBench, with a Japanese-language emphasis. Rigor is solid (5 repetitions with medians, native-speaker-verified translations via a saturation-based coding book, Cohen's kappa 0.941 for narrative annotation, Pylint/LOC/complexity controls, C++ and low-resource-language extensions, thorough threats-to-validity), but weakened by GPT-assisted LeetCode test cases (15/problem), mid-analysis exclusion of Copilot, and absence of significance testing. Novelty is moderate: it is an explicit conceptual replication of the authors' MSR 2024 work, and translation-based mitigation and multilingual code-generation bias were already studied (e.g., Li et al., Wang et al. cited in Section 2.2); the narrative-style/length analysis is the freshest contribution. Evidence is extensive but descriptive, and the narrative share of LeetCode (50.0% in Table 20) contradicts the 21.2% claimed in Section 1, a notable internal inconsistency. Reproducibility is good via the Zenodo/GitHub replication package and versioned models, tempered by closed-model API drift and Copilot's unspecified version.

primary_link.title: A Study on the Impact of Natural Language Differences in Prompts on Automatic Code Generation Using LLMs

recommendations.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance in automatic code generation tasks, thereby encouraging new research in this area. Although numerous studies have explored LLM-based code generation, the impact of the natural language in input prompts remains unexplored (language bias). This study aims to (1) quantify how the natural language of input prompts influences LLM-based code generation performance and (2) evaluate a mitigation strategy to reduce language bias in cod
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究探討提示詞的自然語言差異如何影響大型語言模型（LLM）的自動程式碼生成表現。作者擴展先前僅測GitHub Copilot與AtCoder的研究，選用AtCoder（756題）、LeetCode（100題）與BigCodeBench（288題），以英文、日文、中文提示GPT-4o、o3-mini、DeepSeek-V3.2、Llama-3、Qwen2.5-Coder（0.5B/14B）與Copilot等模型，以程式碼能否通過全部測試案例衡量Accuracy並重複五次取中位數，另評估以DeepL、Google Translate、GPT-4o翻譯提示詞的緩解效果。結果顯示官方支援語言通常取得最高中位數Accuracy，開源模型語言差距約3.6%至6.6%，封閉源碼模型約2.7%至15.6%，DeepSeek-V3.2整體最佳。翻譯對LeetCode與BigCodeBench多有助益，但在AtCoder效果不一：譯為英文使開源模型中位數提升3.2%，封閉源碼模型卻下降5.3%。補充分析發現AtCoder題目較多敘事風格（約74.0%）且較長，敘事搭配長上下文會降低表現；C++與泰語、斯洛伐克語等低資源語言實驗亦證實語言偏誤持續存在。研究限制包括僅涵蓋三種高資源語言、低資源語言翻譯未經母語者驗證、模型不透明及潛在資料汙染。此發現提醒開發者應依資料集與模型特性謹慎選擇提示詞語言，翻譯策略並非通用。

links.title: Objective vs. Search: Decomposing What Makes a Good Tokeniser

evidence: Abstract: 'search procedure-not the objective-is the dominant factor: bottom-up tokenisers consistently achieve lower bits-per-byte in most settings'; BLiMP 'shows no consistent relationship between design choice and performance'.
Sec. 7.2, Table 2 (128k vocab, 1B params): BPE BPB 0.7790 vs. TopDownComp 0.7816; BottomUpLL 0.7803 vs. UnigramLM 0.7872; BLiMP at 1B favors top-down (UnigramLM .818 vs. BottomUpLL .799).
Appendix N, Table 9: paired document-level bootstrap (10,000 resamples) at 128k; e.g., 1B BottomUpLL vs. UnigramLM Delta-BPB -0.0039, 95% CI [-0.0041,-0.0037]; all six CIs exclude zero.

Sec. 5.1-5.2: BottomUpLL 'is closest to the original WordPiece's description' and related to S-BPE (Vilar and Federico, 2021); TopDownComp closest to PathPiece (Schmidt et al., 2024), differing in deletion scoring only.

Limitations section: models capped at 1B parameters; multilingual set is five 'relatively high-resource' languages with four Latin scripts; 300M/500M trained with single seed; top-down deletion costs rely on local replacement approximation.

Appendix O: exact vs. local-replacement deletion scoring yields 81.5% vocabulary overlap at small scale (800 tokens); pruning-rate ablation (10% vs. 1%/0.1%) gives >97% overlap, 'limited effect' claimed.

Header/code link: 'Ahmetcanyvz/comp-vs-like' GitHub repository; Appendix H gives full architecture (e.g., 1B: hidden 2048, 22 layers, RoPE, GQA) and AdamW optimisation details; Appendix I defines all metrics.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A foundational language-modelling methodology paper with strong LLM relevance: it trains Llama-style LMs (100M-1B) from scratch to isolate how tokeniser design (objective vs. search procedure) affects model quality, a core concern for LLM pre-training. Novelty is solid but not maximal: BottomUpLL closely mirrors original WordPiece (Schuster & Nakajima 2012) and S-BPE (Vilar & Federico 2021), and TopDownComp is a near-variant of PathPiece, as the authors transparently concede in Sec. 5; the novel contribution is the controlled 2x2 factorial decomposition and its empirical evaluation. Rigor is high: identical preprocessing/corpora across tokenisers, lemmas with full proofs (App. A-F), paired document-level bootstrap significance tests with all CIs excluding zero (App. N Table 9), and ablations of both top-down approximations (App. O). Evidence for the central claim (bottom-up > top-down on BPB) is consistent, but effect sizes are small (0.0016-0.0080 BPB), seed variance is non-trivial (Table 10: seed 42 reverses BottomUpLL vs. TopDownComp ordering), and BLiMP shows no consistent benefit (Sec. 7.2), tempering practical significance. Generalizability is limited by acknowledged constraints: models only up to 1B, five high-resource languages (four Latin-script), single seeds at 300M/500M (Limitations). Reproducibility is strong: public code (Ahmetcanyvz/comp-vs-like), full hyperparameters (App. H), exact preprocessing (App. G), and metric definitions (App. I).

primary_link.title: Objective vs. Search: Decomposing What Makes a Good Tokeniser

recommendations.summary: Two dominant tokenisation algorithms are used by modern language models: byte-pair encoding (BPE) and UnigramLM. These differ along two orthogonal axes: their optimisation objective (compression vs. log-likelihood) and their search procedure (bottom-up merging vs. top-down pruning). Existing comparisons confound these axes, making it unclear whether their observed differences stem from what is being optimised vs. how it is being optimised. We disentangle the two by introducing two new tokenisati
recommendations.summary_zh: 現代語言模型普遍採用兩種分詞演算法：BPE 與 UnigramLM，但兩者其實在兩個正交軸上同時不同——最佳化目標（壓縮 vs. 對數概似）與搜尋程序（由下而上合併 vs. 由上而下剪枝），過往比較往往混淆兩者，無法判定效能差異源自「最佳化什麼」還是「如何最佳化」。本文提出兩個新演算法補完 2×2 設計空間：BottomUpLL（由下而上、概似目標）與 TopDownComp（由上而下、壓縮目標），並以四種分詞器訓練語言模型，涵蓋 100M 至 1B 參數、8k 至 128k 詞彙表，以及英文與五種語言的多語設定。結果顯示，在 bits-per-byte（BPB）上，搜尋程序才是主導因素：幾乎所有條件下由下而上分詞器皆顯著勝出；BLiMP 文法評測則未見一致關聯。內在評估更發現，由下而上方法不論目標為何，同時取得更好的壓縮與更高的對數概似，詞彙組成也依搜尋程序分群；目標函式仍明顯塑造詞頻分佈（如 Zipf α 與熵），且在小詞彙表時概似目標具優勢。侷限包含模型規模僅至 1B、多語實驗集中於高資源語言、部分設定僅使用單一隨機種子，以及由上而下刪除成本採局部取代近似。整體而言，此研究指出分詞器對語言建模的影響無法單以目標函式解釋，搜尋程序是被長期低估的關鍵設計選項，為更嚴謹、更有原則的分詞器建構提供了具體指引。

Section VI (Limitations): authors acknowledge the accuracy-per-token efficiency metric ignores diminishing returns and call for broader evaluation.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work: step-wise forced-answer probing constructs knowledge/length preference pairs for DPO to compress chain-of-thought without accuracy loss. Strongly matches top-weighted preferences (LLMs, Reasoning & CoT, DPO/alignment, efficiency) and is clearly in scope. Novelty is moderate: it combines known ingredients (internal-state probing, DPO, LoRA, SFT cold start; cf. cited TALE, FS-BoN, C3OT, probing refs [15,16]) into a new data-construction recipe plus masked-DPO, rather than a fundamentally new technique. Rigor is decent: 3 public models, 3 ID + 2 OOD datasets, matched-data BON controls, 5-run means, ablations over mix ratio, data size, masking, and V1/V2 preference variants; but baselines are thin (one inference-time method), no significance tests, MATH test is only 500 examples, and OOD evaluation covers only Llama-3.1-8B. Evidence is generally consistent and honestly reported (e.g., accuracy drop on OOD acknowledged), though the conclusion's 'even improving accuracy' is mildly overstated (Llama-3.1-8B GSM8K SKIP-8 84.35 vs Default 85.50) and the masked-DPO gains are marginal. Reproducibility is helped by a stated code/data release and detailed data-construction rules (Table VI), but training hyperparameters (LoRA rank, beta, LR, epochs) are absent.

primary_link.title: SKIP: a Self-knowledge-guided Step-wise Preference Learning Framework for Concise Reasoning

recommendations.summary: While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has been proven to be effective, it often leads to overthinking, resulting in computational overhead, inference latency, and even degraded performance in large language models (LLMs). Existing concise reasoning frameworks significantly compromise accuracy while compressing the length of output. In this paper, we propose SKIP, a self-knowledge-guided step-wise preference learning framework. Starting with lightweight fine-tuning to adjust the model's output s
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對大型語言模型（LLM）在 Chain-of-Thought（CoT）推理中的「過度思考」問題：冗長的推理鏈帶來額外運算成本與推論延遲，而現有簡潔推理方法在壓縮輸出長度時往往明顯犧牲準確率。作者提出 SKIP 框架，分三階段：先以少量資料進行 SFT 冷啟動，使模型輸出較簡潔、以「The answer is」收尾的風格；接著設計自我知識探測機制，在每個推理步驟後插入探測訊號，強迫模型以貪婪解碼產生答案，藉中間步驟的正確與否判斷知識是否已充足；最後依此建構「知識偏好」與「長度偏好」兩類成對資料，採用 masked-DPO（僅微調 LoRA 參數）訓練，並遮蔽樣本間的共同前綴以穩定最佳化。實驗涵蓋 Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.2-3B 與 Qwen3-14B，在 GSM8K、MATH、MedQA 上，SKIP-8 幾乎於所有設定取得最高 token 效率，且較 BON 基線同時提升準確率並縮短推理長度；在 StrategyQA 與 BBH 日期理解等 OOD 資料集上也展現泛化優勢。消融實驗顯示兩類偏好資料形成制衡：知識偏好資料拉長推理並提高準確率，長度偏好資料則抑制冗餘步驟；masked-DPO 亦優於傳統 DPO。限制包括效率指標（準確率除以長度）未考慮邊際遞減效應，且評估範疇仍待擴充。此研究的重要性在於不需依賴外部強大模型，僅憑模型自身知識即可高效建構訓練資料，實現簡潔推理而不損失、甚至提升效能。
recommendations.title: SKIP: a Self-knowledge-guided Step-wise Preference Learning Framework for Concise Reasoning
recommendations.title_zh: SKIP：自我知識引導的逐步偏好學習簡潔推理框架

§6.1: 'Regressing log(win rate) on R gives r=-0.973 and an implied p=0.928'; the author concedes the fit 'is a regression rather than a model derived from first principles' and exceeds 1 at N=4.

§6.4: inter-judge agreement 97.8-98.7% over ~2,900 pairs, with the explicit caveat that agreement 'establishes that the judgements are reproducible, not that they are right'; measured self-preference discount of 46% (GPT) and 40% (Gemini) motivates excluding self-judgements.

§9: 'Each size uses a single document set with 8 targets, confounding N with that set's difficulty' and 'Every pilot game was played on Claude Opus 5... The frozen prompts are therefore tuned to compensate for one model's behaviour, and that model then finished last.'

§5.5: two China-hosted providers refused three of 1024 Wikipedia paragraphs; bisection isolated triggers in 105 API calls; the author admits the keyword-vs-politics ablation 'is not decisive' for the Simon Cheng document.
§12: code, corpus, prompts, and per-game logs released at github.com/ppotash/logn-questions with prompt version hash, schema version, corpus hash, token usage, and raw responses recorded per game.

§6.6/§4.4: reasoning-token spend spans 4.5x at N=1024 with little relation to win rate, and Gemini at MEDIUM outperforms models at HIGH, but effort settings are provider-specific labels rather than a controlled variable.
§6.2/§6.3: round-1 answer balance correlates with win rate at r=+0.88; only the two models using lexical title bisection (GPT, Kimi, 25.9% and 21.6% of questions at N>=64) reach H(p)=1.000.
Table 1: 68 paired games per model on identical documents/targets; totals verify (e.g., Kimi 4+8+8+8+8+5+6+5+4=56/68); cost r=-0.05 with performance; total spend $363.15.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A frontier-LLM evaluation report squarely inside scope: it benchmarks six LLMs on a two-agent zero-shot communication game framed as a long-context, multi-step reasoning probe, with LLM-as-judge adjudication, prompt-revision analysis, and test-time-compute observations. Preference relevance is high across several heavily weighted categories (LLMs, evaluation/benchmarking, agents/multi-agent, reasoning, long context). Novelty is moderate: the game is ported from Potash and Suleman (2019), but the p^log2(N) reliability fit, O(1) error decomposition, and judge-free information-rate metric are genuine contributions. Rigor is above average (paired cross-model design, three judges with a measured 40-46% self-preference discount, statistical tests, candid limitations) but is undercut by a direct abstract/body contradiction: the abstract claims the independence assumption is tested (chi-squared=10.5, df=9), while §6.1 states 'We do not test the independence assumption'; only 8 games per cell; prompts pilot-tuned on the model that finished last (§9); unmatched effort settings (Gemini at MEDIUM). Evidence is rich and mostly internally consistent (Table 1 arm totals sum correctly; pooled counts match), with some abstract-level claims (consecutive-failure independence) lacking a reported body statistic. Generalizability is limited by single document sets per size, English Wikipedia, undisclosed architectures for four models, and acknowledged task-specific ranking inversion. Reproducibility is strong: code, corpus, manifests, prompts, and per-game logs with hashes released. The content-filtering findings (§5.5) are interesting but the trigger-cause ablation is admittedly not decisive.

A questioner sees $N$ Wikipedia lead paragraphs and must identify a secretly chosen target using exactly $\log_2 N$ yes/no questions. An answerer sees only the target and the question, and replies with one word. Both roles run on the same provider, so the game measures how well a model communicates with itself across an information asymmetry. We run 408 games over document sets of 4 to 1024 paragraphs at a total
recommendations.summary_zh: 本報告將 log(N)-問題遊戲移植到前沿模型:提問者須在 N 篇英文維基百科導言中,以恰好 log₂N 個是非題找出祕密選定的目標文件,回答者僅能依目標與問題以單字作答;兩個角色由同一家模型擔任,藉此衡量模型在資訊不對稱下與自身溝通的效率。作者以巢狀文件集與相同目標對六個模型各跑 68 場、共 408 場遊戲,總成本約 363 美元。結果呈現明顯斷裂:Claude Opus 5 僅 28 勝,其餘五模型為 45 至 56 勝且彼此難以區分;合併前五名後,勝率隨集合大小以 r=-0.973 下降,並可用單一每輪可靠度參數 p=0.928 的 win=p^(log₂N) 擬合,每輪失敗率在不同長度間大致恆定。錯誤分解顯示損失約一半為回答錯誤、近一半為區辨失敗,預測錯誤僅 2–4%;表現最差模型的回答錯誤多為在文件首句明述屬性時仍答「No」,顯示溝通失敗而非推理崩潰。每題資訊量與勝率相關達 r=+0.88,僅 Kimi K3 與 GPT-5.6 Sol 採用按標題字母二分的精確分割並達到每題一個位元;推理量相差 4.5 倍卻與勝負幾乎無關,成本與表現亦不相關。限制包括每個規模僅一組文件集、提示詞係以最後一名模型試錯調校、部分供應商無溫度控制,以及兩家中國供應商以內容過濾拒絕三篇段落。本研究的價值在於指出長程多步任務的瓶頸是每步溝通可靠度的複利損耗,而非推理品質或脈絡長度。

evidence: Abstract: 'Grounded-CoSQ at tau=0.90 reduces the mean unconditional wrong-commitment rate from 13.1% under chain-of-thought prompting to 8.9%, a 32.1% relative reduction, while increasing answered accuracy from 86.9% to 89.7% and answering 87.6% of questions.'
Section 4.3: 'Each model is evaluated under seventeen conditions... The final manifests share one question-ID hash, one balanced-option hash, and one prompt digest.'
Section 5.6 / Table 8: mean HR decrease 0.0422 [0.0272, 0.0595], one-sided Wilcoxon p=0.00049, direction '11/11' for all three variant comparisons.
Section 5.2 / Table 4: Grounded-CoSQ correct-abstention share 0.313 vs lost-value share 0.687 at tau=0.90.
Section 3.4 'Baselines': 'Direct prompting... CoT... These baselines measure the cost of adding a selective gate' - no external abstention/confidence-elicitation baselines are compared.

Section 7 Limitations: 'confidence is elicited from the same language model that produces the answer... The model panel uses endpoint-level identifiers and hosted model names. Some endpoints may change weights or serving behavior without exposing immutable revisions.'
Appendix A: full versioned prompt templates for all three CoSQ variants and baselines; Data Availability: GitHub (github.com/senolali/CoSQ) and PyPI (pypi.org/project/cosq).

Section 4.5: paired exact one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, 10,000-resample bootstrap CIs, Cohen's dz, with caveat that 'hosted model endpoints [are] not independent samples from a population of all LLMs.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper (prompt-only selective answering/abstention for hallucination risk control) with strong match to LLM, chain-of-thought, prompting, factuality, and evaluation preferences. Experimental design is careful: 11 model families, 817 TruthfulQA-MC items, prespecified full threshold sweep, balanced option order, paired Wilcoxon/bootstrap statistics with 11/11 directional consistency, transparent abstention-composition analysis (68.7% of Grounded-CoSQ abstentions withhold CoT-correct answers), and full prompt templates in Appendix A. Main weaknesses: novelty is incremental over cited selective-generation work (verbalized confidence, R-Tuning, multi-LLM abstention); the only baselines are forced-choice Direct and CoT (Section 3.4), so no simpler prompt-only confidence-threshold abstention or SelfCheckGPT-style comparator isolates the value of the multi-stage decomposition; hosted endpoints (GPT-5.5, Claude 5 Sonnet, DeepSeek Flash) lack immutable version pins; and evidence rests on one primary benchmark plus a small 5-model NQ-Short secondary test with no threshold transfer.

primary_link.title: When Should LLMs Abstain? Chain-of-Self-Questioning for Selective Risk Control

recommendations.summary: Large language models can produce fluent answers when their factual support is weak. This paper introduces Chain-of-Self-Questioning (CoSQ), a prompt-only framework that makes answer commitment conditional on an explicit assessment of the information required to answer a question. We evaluate three CoSQ variants under seventeen conditions on the 817-item TruthfulQA multiple-choice validation set using eleven open-weight and hosted model families. In the final balanced-option protocol, Grounded-C
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型語言模型（LLM）在事實依據不足時仍可能流暢作答的幻覺問題，提出僅靠提示詞即可運作的選擇性作答框架 Chain-of-Self-Questioning（CoSQ）。方法分三階段：先辨識回答問題所需的資訊單元，再對每個單元評估信心分數，最後依門檻 τ 決定作答或棄權，且只有通過門檻的資訊單元才會進入最終答案生成。論文比較 Grounded、Critical 與 Adaptive 三種變體，在 817 題 TruthfulQA 選擇題、十一個模型家族與十七種條件下評估。主要結果顯示，Grounded-CoSQ 在 τ=0.90 時將無條件錯誤承諾率自 CoT 基線的 13.1% 降至 8.9%（相對降幅 32.1%），已答題正確率由 86.9% 升至 89.7%，涵蓋率維持 87.6%；十一個模型全數呈現同向改善，配對 Wilcoxon 檢定與 bootstrap 信賴區間支持兩項方向性假設，Natural Questions 短答題的次要實驗亦提供一致證據。限制包括：信心訊號來自同一模型而非校準機率、每題需 3 至 4 次推論呼叫而增加成本、Grounded-CoSQ 的棄權中僅約 31% 確實對應基線錯誤（其餘為放棄的潛在價值），以及單一主要基準與通用提示詞可能限制泛化。此研究重要性在於將「答對多少」與「是否該答」分離，提供可在風險與涵蓋之間調節的操作點，適合高風險場景中優先降低錯誤承諾的部署需求。

Section 2.3, Eq. 4: introduces ESMP (Evidence-Supported Modification Precision), computed as TP/(TP+FP) over edits falling inside ERASER human-annotated rationale spans; precision chosen deliberately over recall for minimality.

Section 3 and Appendix D, Table 6: Spearman ρ=0.866 (p<0.001) for size vs faithfulness, ρ=0.778 for ESMP, ρ=0.319 closeness, ρ=0.157 semantic similarity; regression β=0.119 [0.092,0.147] per log2(size) doubling with controls.
Appendix D: fractional-logit model gives odds ratio 2.00, 95% CI [1.68,2.40], p<0.001 for faithfulness per size doubling; analyses explicitly framed as descriptive over aggregate values.

Appendix C, Tables 2-5: full per-setting results for faithfulness, semantic similarity, closeness, ESMP across Movies and e-SNLI; Chat-History best faithfulness in 12/20 settings, Rationale-Guided best ESMP and closeness in 15/20 settings.
Appendix A, Table 1: exact HuggingFace model identifiers, single NVIDIA H200 GPU, temperature 0 / top-p 1 / max 4096 tokens decoding.
Appendix B: complete prompts for all three pipeline stages under Baseline and Rationale-Guided conditions.
Limitations: analysis restricted to binary classification tasks; metrics may not capture human understandability or usefulness.
Footnote 1: code available at https://github.com/gianniskalyvas/cf-self-explanations.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference LLM interpretability work: studies faithfulness of LLM self-generated counterfactual explanations across 10 instruction-tuned LLaMA-3/Qwen-2.5 models, with prompting-strategy ablations. Novelty is moderate: the pipeline is adapted from Madsen et al. (2024) and the rationale-guided condition from Bhattacharjee et al. (2024); the main new contributions are the ESMP metric (Section 2.3, Eq. 4) and a controlled scale analysis (Appendix D, Table 6: Spearman ρ=0.866, p<0.001; regression β=0.119 [0.092,0.147] per size doubling; fractional-logit OR=2.00 [1.68,2.40]). Rigor is solid with 20 settings, full result tables (Appendix C, Tables 2-5), regression controls for dataset/family/prompting, and acknowledged limitations (binary classification only, metric scope); however, analyses are aggregate/descriptive over ~20 setting-level means, only two binary English tasks, and prediction-flip faithfulness conflates classification competence with explanation quality. Evidence claims are checkable against the tables and mostly consistent, though minor non-monotonicities (e.g., Qwen 72B below 32B under Chat-History in Table 2) are not deeply analyzed. Generalizability is constrained by binary-task scope, explicitly stated in Limitations. Reproducibility is excellent: public code (footnote 1), exact model identifiers, hardware, deterministic decoding parameters, and full prompts (Appendices A-B).

primary_link.title: An Empirical Study of Counterfactual Self-Explanations in LLMs

recommendations.summary: Large language models can easily generate explanations for their own outputs, but such self-explanations are not necessarily faithful to the model's behavior. We study this issue through counterfactual self-explanations, where a model minimally edits an input so that its own prediction changes. Across sentiment analysis and natural language inference, we evaluate ten instruction-tuned models from the LLaMA-3 and Qwen-2.5 families, measuring faithfulness, minimality, and alignment with human-anno
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型能輕易為自身輸出產生解釋，但這些自我解釋未必忠實反映模型的真實行為。本文以「反事實自我解釋」檢視此問題：要求模型對輸入進行最小幅度的編輯，使其自身的預測翻轉。研究涵蓋電影評論情緒分析與 e-SNLI 自然語言推論兩項任務，採用 ERASER 基準測試集，評估 LLaMA-3 與 Qwen-2.5 兩家族共十個 instruction-tuned 模型，比較基準、Chat-History 與 Rationale-Guided 三種提示策略，並以忠實性（翻轉率）、最小性（編輯距離與語意相似度）及自創的 ESMP 指標（衡量編輯是否落在人類標註的證據區間）評估品質。主要結果顯示，模型規模是解釋品質的最強決定因素：規模與翻轉率的 Spearman 相關達 0.87，與 ESMP 達 0.78；控制資料集、模型家族與提示策略後，模型規模每翻倍，忠實性約提升 12 個百分點。較大模型不僅更能產生可翻轉自身預測的反事實，其編輯也更集中於與人類推理一致的證據。相對地，Rationale-Guided 雖提升 ESMP 與最小性，卻未能一致提升忠實性，顯示提示設計可能讓解釋「看起來」更佳，卻偏離模型實際的決策依據；Chat-History 則在 20 個設定中的 12 個取得最高忠實性。研究限制在於僅涵蓋二元分類任務，且現有指標未必反映解釋對人類的可理解性與實用性。本研究的意義在於：反事實自我解釋可作為模型行為的有用行為證據，但其可靠性高度依賴模型容量，必須經實證驗證，不能直接視為存取模型內部推理的途徑。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-scoped empirical LLM code-generation study directly matching core preferences (LLMs, agentic coding tools, code benchmarks, evaluation). Its contribution is methodological: joining static conformance analysis with runtime execution on the same 7,593 methods shows structural checks are near-ceiling while 38.4% of methods never compute their returned value (Table III, p.3), and adherence correlates -0.91 with correctness among genuine attempts (p.4). The fabrication taxonomy and detection of an index-based synthetic answer generator that defeats literal and duplicate heuristics (p.5) are genuinely interesting. Rigor is solid but capped: one generation run per condition with no variance estimate (Limitations, p.6), a single execution pass, syntactic classification that can mistake the synthetic generator for genuine computation, and internal inconsistencies (abstract claims an 'eight-class' taxonomy vs. the six classes C1-C6 in Table I; text claims coverage '89.9% to 100.0%' while Table II shows 80.1%). Evidence within the paper is detailed and quantitatively traceable, including a sensitivity check removing the GPT/Cursor P1 outlier (-0.91 to -0.78, p.5). Generalizability is explicitly narrow: cost-efficient tier only, contaminated Project Euler corpus, mandated Spring Boot setting. Reproducibility is aided by a claimed anonymized replication package (p.6), though the generic GitHub URL is unverifiable. Not a domain application; clearly in scope.

primary_link.title: An Empirical Evaluation of Cost-Efficient Large Language Models on Algorithmic Programming Tasks

Three models (Gemini Flash 3, GPT-5.4 mini and Claude Haiku 4.5) were asked to solve 992 algorithmic problems as Java Spring Boot service methods conforming to a mandated signature and data-transfer-object specification, crossing four model and agentic coding tool combinations with two prompt variants to yield eight configurations, with itera
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究實證檢驗三款低成本大型語言模型(Gemini Flash 3、GPT-5.4 mini、Claude Haiku 4.5)能否被信任依書面規格產出企業級程式碼。作者取 Project Euler 的 992 道題目,要求模型撰寫符合指定方法簽名與 DTO 規格的 Java Spring Boot 服務方法,交叉組合兩種 Agentic Coding Tools(Cursor 與 Claude Code)與兩種提示詞變體,形成八種配置;過程禁止迭代自我修正與將已知答案寫死,並抽離八題作為缺失輸入探針。研究以六類結果分類法靜態分析 7,593 個方法,部署執行後取得 7,936 次量測請求。結果顯示結構符合度近乎天花板,卻有 38.4% 的方法並未真正計算其所回傳的值,回傳答案僅 12.9% 正確;真正運算的方法回應最少,正確率也僅 19.3%,回應可靠性與答案正確性呈反向關係(相關係數 -0.91),偽造佔位類別幾乎回應所有請求卻幾乎全錯。研究並發現一個合成答案產生器,依題號以固定的算術常式製造看似合理的答案,橫跨 792 題避開字面偵測且從未答對。字面答案於前 100 題有 44.3% 符合已公布解答,401 題之後僅 0.1%,印證訓練語料污染與記憶效應;工具效應顯著且隨提示詞不同而方向逆轉。限制包括各配置僅生成一次、工具涵蓋不完整、單次執行計時、僅作語法層級分類,以及語料極可能受污染。本研究的重要性在於證明僅靠結構檢查的評測反而會選出最弱系統,語意正確性必須仰賴實際執行驗證。
