links.title: Autoformalizing Argumentative Material Inferences

evidence: Abstract/Results: GUARD yields verified-faithful gains of +35.3 and +32.9 points and leakage reductions of -25.9/-21.9 over PEIRCE; Table 1 confirms average VFR 61.13 vs 25.81 (Debatepedia) and 65.00 vs 32.13 (ARCT).
Table 1: GPT-5.1 reaches SP 78.14 / VFR 76.52 on Debatepedia and SP 82.50 / VFR 81.00 on ARCT, vs PEIRCE 45.34/33.60 and 51.00/39.00.

Table 3 and Appendix E: removing the soft symbolic critique drops VFR by 40.5 (Debatepedia) and 39.5 (ARCT) points with GPT-5.1; removing assumptions drops 23.5/31.5 points, consistent across all four backbones in Table E.1.
Stage IV (Faithfulness Check): counter-premise and alternative-claim probes 'are proposed by our framework' - self-generated contrastive tests, a potential evaluation weakness.
Abstention analysis: 63.5-74.3% of unproven instances are abstain-missing-guards under +10 hard iterations; GPT-5.1 would reach 93.5%/95.5% solver-pass under doubled budget.

Appendix B.4 / Table B.1: autoformalization faithfulness via informalisation cosine similarity 0.798-0.917, plus human annotation of 300 sampled logical forms (annotator count/agreement not reported).

Appendix A.2/Table A.2: model identifiers (gpt-5.1, qwen3-max-preview, deepseek-chat, mistral-medium-3-5), temperature 0.6 or reasoning_effort medium, and explicit refinement budgets (10 soft, 10 hard, 5 faithfulness) support reproducibility; Appendix D states complete prompts 'are provided in the submitted code' but no public code/data link is given.
Experimental Setup: 247 topic-balanced Debatepedia pairs (13 per topic, 19 topics) and 200 randomly sampled ARCT instances, identical instances across all methods and backbones.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-methodology paper squarely in scope: a neuro-symbolic framework (GUARD) coupling four backbone LLMs (GPT-5.1, Qwen3-Max, DeepSeek-V3.2, Mistral Medium 3.5) with Isabelle/HOL to autoformalize argumentative material inferences, with explicit chain-of-thought/reasoning baselines (CoT, Toulmin) and a formal-verification refinement loop. Novelty is solid but incremental: the soft/hard critique loop extends the authors' own PEIRCE line; the genuinely new pieces are the guard-completion framing, PO1-PO4 obligations, and contrastive premise/claim faithfulness tests that block 'leakage' where added premises bypass the original premise. Rigor is good: two datasets (247 Debatepedia pairs, 200 ARCT samples, Section: Experimental Setup), a strong iterative SOTA baseline at matched 10-iteration budget, full ablations across all backbones (Table E.1), abstention analysis under extended budget, and autoformalization faithfulness checks (Appendix B.4). Weaknesses: no statistical significance testing or variance reporting, contrastive probes are generated by the system itself (Stage IV), and the human error annotation (300 logical forms) lacks annotator/agreement detail. Quantitative claims are internally consistent (e.g., average VFR 61.13 vs PEIRCE 25.81 on Debatepedia yields the claimed +35.3; leakage averages 4.06 vs 29.96 yield -25.9). Generalizability is limited to argumentative/NLI-style material inference with the authors noting broader domains as future work. Reproducibility is aided by model identifiers, decoding settings, iteration budgets, and full prompt templates, but code release is only implied ('provided in the submitted code') without a repository link.

Making such arguments machine-checkable requires constructing the missing commitments, not only translating given sentences into logic. Construction, however, carries a risk that translation does not: a system free to add premises can
recommendations.summary_zh: 自然語言論證的支持關係常依賴隱含的論證保證、背景承諾與例外條件,直接翻譯成邏輯往往不成立:直接自動形式化在所有骨幹 LLM 上求解通過率皆為零。但若允許系統自由補建前提,又可能讓任何主張變得可證,造成「漏證」(leakage)——證明繞過原前提或證出超出主張的內容。本文將論證性實質推論的自動形式化建構為「守衛補全」(guard completion)問題,以明確建構的守衛集合把非單調的實質支持轉成可檢驗的單調形式推論,並提出神經符號框架 GUARD:第一階段脈絡強化,以 LLM 萃取預設假設、定義與詞項正規化,以及帶異常謂詞的可否證規則;第二階段依 PO1–PO4 四項證明義務做符號層軟性批評與修正;第三階段以 Isabelle/HOL 硬性驗證,將失敗證明步驟回饋迭代修補;第四階段以空前提、同主題反前提與替代主張做對比式忠實性檢驗,唯有擾動理論皆不可證才接受。在 Debatepedia 與 ARCT 上,以 GPT-5.1、Qwen3-Max、DeepSeek-V3.2、Mistral Medium 3.5 為骨幹,相較最佳基線 PEIRCE,平均 verified-faithful 率提升 35.3 與 32.9 點,漏證率下降 25.9 與 21.9 點;消融顯示軟性符號批評與假設層貢獻最大(最多 −40.5 與 −31.5 點),棄答主因是守衛不足(63.5–74.3%)而非論證不相容。限制包括僅評估兩個論證語料,殘餘漏證集中於前提端,且較弱模型可能把萃取能力不足誤判為不相容。此研究讓隱含論證支援成為可機器稽核的證明,對可信 NLP 推論具重要意義。

links.title: How Much is a Human Right Worth? ECtHR-NPD: A Benchmark for Predicting Non-Pecuniary Damage Awards

evidence: Section 5.1: 'CatBoost obtains the lowest aggregate MAE (€9.9k), which is 10.2% lower than the training-set median' and best prompted LM is Qwen3.5-9B static CoT (€10.8k MAE); Table 3 shows train median MAE 11,006 vs CatBoost 9,881.

Appendix D.1 Table 26: paired bootstrap tests with 1,000 resamples; CatBoost significantly better than train median and strongest prompted LM (Pr=1.000), but not significantly better than BGE-M3 dense (Pr=0.935) or ModernBERT late fusion (Pr=0.807).

Section 5.2 Table 5: expanded ReAct diagnostic adds applicant claims and Article 41 reasoning, reducing Qwen3.5-Plus MAE from 18,220 to 8,810 (−51.6%) and raising Zero-F1 from 0.002 to 0.997, demonstrating why award-related material is withheld.

Section 3.3/3.4 and Appendix B.3: target construction separates Article 41 material from model input with eight validation checks; 230 bundled-award candidates manually audited, 72 retained under bundled-proxy exception (Table 10 cascade 18,367→14,575).
Table 15 and Algorithm 1 (Appendix B.4): ID/OOD views constructed by greedy quota matching with eight weighted dimensions; Mean TV 0.025 (ID) vs 0.211 (OOD) vs 0.435 (Challenging).

Limitations: 'Our budget and compute constraints prevent us from repeating all prompted decoder-LM and ReAct runs... single-run estimates'; equitable awards make point-error metrics measure 'fit to the Court's realised practice rather than legal correctness'; scope restricted to English-language ECtHR judgments.

Section 1 footnote: 'Data is available on Hugging Face. Code and documentation are available on GitHub'; Appendix C.6 Table 23 records temperature 0, seed 42, fixed prompt templates; Table 33 reports serialisation ablations with mixed signs (e.g., GPT-OSS-20B CoT −5,041 vs Qwen3.5-9B CoT +1,033).
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-evaluation benchmark in legal NLP that directly engages multiple high-weight preferences: it evaluates prompted decoder LLMs (Qwen3.5 variants, GPT-OSS-20B, GPT-5.4), chain-of-thought and retrieved few-shot prompting, ReAct-style tool-using agents over a curated knowledge base, and BM25/BGE-M3 retrieval baselines (Section 4.1). It is not a pure domain application since the contribution is LLM/agentic methodology evaluation (leakage-controlled benchmark, prompting and agent failure analysis), not a legal-tech deployment. Novelty is solid: the first benchmark for continuous discretionary monetary remedies at the ECtHR, though smaller prior discretionary-damage studies exist (Section 2). Rigor and evidence are strong: six model families, chronological splits with ID/OOD/Challenging views quantified via total variation (Table 15), paired bootstrap significance tests (Appendix D.1, Table 26), input-serialisation and feature-set ablations (Tables 4, 28, 33), and a leakage diagnostic showing expanded ReAct roughly halves MAE and lifts Zero-F1 to ~0.99 (Table 5), validating the input-separation design. Honest limitations: single-run LLM estimates, residual label noise, and the point-error vs. equitable-award caveat (Limitations). Generalizability is capped by the ECtHR-specific, English-only, nominal-euro scope, which the authors explicitly warn against extrapolating. Reproducibility is good (Hugging Face data, GitHub code, HUDOC IDs, fixed prompts, temperature 0) but weakened by non-redistributed raw text, proprietary API models, and uncharacterized run-to-run variance.

primary_link.title: How Much is a Human Right Worth? ECtHR-NPD: A Benchmark for Predicting Non-Pecuniary Damage Awards

recommendations.summary: Existing legal benchmarks cover diverse tasks, while continuous monetary remedies remain comparatively underexplored. We introduce ECtHR-NPD, to the best of our knowledge, the first benchmark for predicting non-pecuniary damage (NPD) awards at the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) from case information when no statutory formula or explicit calculation rule determines the amount. ECtHR-NPD contains 14,575 cases with case-level awards in nominal euros, chronological splits, and a protocol sep
recommendations.summary_zh: 法律NLP基準多聚焦分類、檢索或受法定規則約束的數值任務，對連續性金錢救濟金額的預測仍相當匱乏。本文提出ECtHR-NPD，據作者所知是首個針對歐洲人權法院（ECtHR）公約第41條非金錢損害（NPD）賠償金額預測的基準；此類賠償依衡平原則裁量決定，並無公開公式可循。資料集收錄14,575件來自HUDOC的判決，附有名目歐元案件層級目標、依判決日期切分的訓練／驗證／測試集，以及ID、OOD與Challenging三種診斷測試視角，並將申請人的賠償主張、法院第41條理由與判決主文等洩漏風險素材排除於模型輸入之外。作者評估六大類方法：常數基線、梯度提升樹、檢索方法、fine-tuning編碼器LM、提示式解碼器LM與ReAct知識增強代理。結果顯示CatBoost以約9,900歐元MAE最佳，較訓練集中位數預測低10.2%；提示式解碼器LM與代理表現不穩定，未能可靠超越特徵基線，且更大或更複雜的組態未必改善。所有模型皆難以辨識零賠償案件、對高額賠償校正不佳，並在Challenging子集上MAE約翻倍。診斷實驗亦顯示若額外提供申請主張與第41條理由，代理MAE近乎減半、Zero-F1升至約0.99，凸顯洩漏控制的必要性。限制包括僅涵蓋英文判決與案件層級目標、標籤可能有殘餘雜訊，且衡平賠償使點誤差指標無法反映法律上可辯護的區間，提示式LM結果亦屬單次執行估計。此基準將法律NLP延伸至裁量性金錢救濟，揭露零賠償辨識與數值規模校正等現有分類導向基準無法量測的失敗模式。

links.title: ERAF4XRD: A multimodal agentic framework for constructing validated experimental X-ray diffraction databases from scientific literature

evidence: Abstract: 'achieved up to 98.7% accuracy for XRD figure identification and generated 1,400 metadata values across 22 fields... 98.5% precision and 90.7% recall, with no unsupported metadata observed among 443 evaluated fields'
Results, 'Manual assessment confirms the reliability' section: 'GPT-5.2 presented the strongest XRD figure identification performance, with 94.8% precision, 90.8% recall, and a 92.8% F1-score'

Results, validation outcomes: 'Across 1,471 metadata values... Step III confirmed 816 values (55.5%), and modified the remaining 655 (44.5%)', including 44 LLM hallucinations removed (Fig. 3 and Supplementary Fig. 4)

Methods, Step III: ReAct agent with 'default tool-call budget of N=12', supported/unsupported/unclear statuses, plus non-LLM deterministic checks for space group-crystal system and radiation source-wavelength consistency
Results, 'Benchmark dataset': 273 publications, 3,150 candidate figures, 282 manually verified XRD figures, candidate-to-XRD ratio ~11:1 (Table 1)
Results, 'Scalability': 'Claude Sonnet 4.5 was fastest at 0.96 min/PDF, followed by GPT-5.2 (1.29 min/PDF)'; GPT-5.5 gave only 95.9%->96.2% accuracy gain at substantially higher cost (Fig. 9d)
Data availability: 'https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22683615'; Code availability: 'github.com/niaz60/ERAF4XRD'
Discussion, limitations: 'ERAF4XRD also currently reconstructs validated figure-specific metadata but does not fully digitize numerical diffraction data from figures'
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope because the core contribution is LLM/agent methodology, not a pure domain application: a multimodal ReAct-style agentic pipeline (Steps 0-III) with tool use, independent validation agents, hallucination removal, and systematic comparison of frontier LLMs (GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Grok 4.1), evaluated on a materials-literature XRD benchmark. Strong preference alignment with Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, grounding/hallucination control, and multimodal VLM usage, though the evaluation domain is niche. Novelty is moderate: agentic scientific information extraction is well-populated (nanoMINER, DIVE, ChatMOF cited); the distinct contribution is automated source-grounded validation plus deterministic crystallographic consistency checks integrated as a pipeline component, and data-metadata linking rather than extraction alone. Rigor is high: 273-publication/3,150-candidate benchmark with dual-reviewer ground truth, imbalanced-class metric discussion, four-model comparison, strategy ablations (agentic vs single-pass, full-document vs targeted preprocessing, visual-input configurations), failure-mode taxonomy, runtime/cost analysis, and CIF cross-validation; limitations (no numerical digitization, subset sizes of 35/47 publications) are acknowledged. Evidence is strong and quantified, but rests on proprietary, version-drifting closed APIs and small evaluation subsets for some tasks. Generalizability is claimed (Raman, EXAFS) with only preliminary support; the validation architecture and model-selection findings transfer beyond XRD. Reproducibility aided by public code and Zenodo benchmark, weakened by commercial-model dependence.

recommendations.summary: The scientific literature contains decades of experimental measurements that remain difficult to access as structured data for modern AI and data-driven research. Much of this information is distributed across figures, captions, text, and tables, requiring experimental data and their context to be identified, connected, and verified before they can be reused. Here we introduce ERAF4XRD (Experiment Reader Agentic Framework for X-Ray Diffraction), a fully automated multimodal (i.e., image and text
recommendations.summary_zh: 科學文獻累積了數十年的實驗量測結果,但這些資訊散布於圖片、圖說、內文與表格中,難以轉換為機器可讀的結構化資料,限制了AI與資料驅動研究的發展。本文提出ERAF4XRD,一個全自動的多模態多代理框架,能從期刊論文重建並驗證實驗性X光繞射(XRD)紀錄。框架分四步驟:步驟0自ArXiv、Elsevier、Springer與CrossRef下載開放取用文獻並篩選XRD內容;步驟I以具備視覺能力的LLM辨識XRD圖片並擷取圖層級詮釋資料;步驟II自內文擷取補充詮釋資料,並與對應圖片正確連結;步驟III由獨立代理依據原始文件證據驗證輸出,再輔以非LLM的確定性一致性檢查。在含273篇論文、3,150張候選圖片的基準測試中,GPT-5.2達到98.7%的XRD圖片辨識準確率;獨立人工評估顯示,443個評估欄位中精確率為98.5%、召回率為90.7%,且未發現無依據的幻覺詮釋資料。自動驗證修正了44.5%的初始擷取結果,輸出亦與COD晶體學資料庫的CIF紀錄高度一致。研究比較GPT、Claude、Gemini與Grok等模型,顯示GPT-5.2整體最為均衡,而更新模型未必帶來等比例改善;針對XRD相關證據的目標式前處理優於輸入全文,代理式推理則主要惠及較小模型。此框架尚未數位化圖片中的數值繞射資料,對非傳統XRD呈現方式亦有漏失,但其「可靠性優先於完備性」的自動驗證設計,為將文獻轉換為可信的機器可讀實驗資料庫提供了可規模化的途徑。

links.title: Trajectory Learnability for Offline On-Policy Distillation with Imperfect Teachers

evidence: Abstract: method 'improves an offline OPD baseline by up to 2.7 percentage points' while using '2 GPUs and about 22 GPU hours, compared with 3 GPUs and 36-48 GPU hours for representative online OPD methods'.
Table 1 (Section 5.1): Qwen3-4B-Base LWD reaches 69.1% AIME24, 42.1% HMMT25, 44.5% LCB v5 vs Lightning-OPD 66.4%/40.5%/42.6%; 1.7B code results remain below online variants.
Table 3 (Section 5.2 ablation): failed-case zero weight averages 55.5% vs full retention 55.0%, shared reduced 56.4%, learnability-based 57.1%—supporting the graded-retention hypothesis.
Table 4 (Section 5.2 ablation): tiered trajectory weighting averages 57.1% vs dense span 56.6% and continuous trajectory 56.7%.

Appendix A.3: for code, 'teacher success is approximated by normal termination and strict extraction of a complete Python program... These code labels measure format validity rather than functional correctness.'

Appendix A.1-A.3: full instantiation details (150 updates, tier rule z<=-0.5 / z>=0.5 with v<1.0, weights 0.15/0.25/0.35 clipped and globally scaled to 0.25, Adam betas, batch 256, lr 2e-6); Section 5 states no checkpoint selection and fixed final checkpoint, but no code release is mentioned.
Section 5 Evaluation protocol: avg@32 on AIME24/AIME25/HMMT25 (30 problems each) and avg@4 on LCB v5/v6, seed 42, temperature 0.6—no error bars or seed-variance analysis reported.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper (on-policy distillation of Qwen3 language models with reasoning/code evaluation) that is squarely within preferences. The learnability signal—re-scoring stored teacher-failed trajectories under a successful-only reference checkpoint—is a clever, cheap alternative to prefix-continuation recoverability estimation, but it is an incremental refinement within a crowded selective/reweighted-OPD literature (ReNIO, FiRe-OPD, RA-OPD, Lightning-OPD). Experiments are protocol-matched with two ablations and two student scales; however, gains are modest (1.6-2.7 pts), math benchmarks have only 30 problems with no variance/significance reporting, tier thresholds and weights (0.15/0.25/0.35) are hand-set without sensitivity analysis, the first-order interpretation is unvalidated, and the code-domain success label is only format validity per Appendix A.3. Generalization is limited to one model family and two domains. Reproducibility benefits from unusually detailed hyperparameters, pinned LiveCodeBench commit, and exact prompts, but no code/data release is claimed.

recommendations.summary_zh: 本文研究離線同策略蒸餾中如何面對不完美教師。此設定只需蒐集一次學生軌跡與教師監督並重複使用,效率高,但教師一旦在部分題目上失敗,其不良監督便會在整個訓練過程中持續影響學生。作者指出教師成敗僅是題目層級的粗糙訊號,不代表該軌跡上所有監督都無用;若透過從多個前綴反覆續寫來估計教師可否補救,又會喪失離線效率。為此,他們提出可學習性加權蒸餾(LWD):先只用教師成功的題目訓練一個參考模型(successful-only learning),再比較該模型與原始模型對教師失敗題目中已儲存詞元的對數概似變化,作為詞元級可學習性訊號;經平滑與標準化後彙整為軌跡級低、中、高三個層級,分別賦予有界正權重,用以加權原始蒸餾損失。實驗將 Qwen3-8B 蒸餾至 Qwen3-4B-Base 與 1.7B,在 AIME24、AIME25、HMMT25 及 LiveCodeBench 上,4B 模型於所有基準皆超越離線基線 Lightning-OPD(如 AIME24 自 66.4% 提升至 69.1%),並比肩或勝過多數線上 OPD 變體,且僅需 2 張 GPU 與約 22 GPU 小時,低於線上方法的 3 張 GPU 與 36–48 小時。消融實驗顯示失敗案例不宜全留或全刪,軌跡層級分層加權表現最佳。限制包括程式碼任務的教師成敗僅以格式有效度近似、額外的成功專屬蒸餾階段使離線成本倍增,以及 1.7B 模型在程式碼基準上仍略遜於線上方法。此研究顯示教師失敗可轉化為分配監督強度的分級訊號,而非二元過濾器。

recommendations.summary_zh: 本文系統性檢視近年匈牙利三項生成式語言模型計畫：遵循 GPT-3 架構的 OTP 雙語模型、以 continual pretraining 加 supervised fine-tuning 改造 Llama 3.1 與 Qwen2.5 的 PULI/ChatPULI 系列，以及透過 LoRA 適配 Qwen3-4B 的 Racka-4B。作者指出這些研究的評估可信度存疑：ChatPULI 將 7,344 筆 HuLU 題目混入訓練資料造成汙染；Racka 以公開驗證集而非測試集評分、修改評估腳本卻未說明細節，且使用 lm-eval-harness 預設的 multiple_choice 輸出型態，使推理模型無法產生思考鏈；OTP 的自製評測集更取自自身預訓練語料。作者依建議的推論參數重跑 HuGME 與原始基準，發現 Qwen3-4B 在 11 項任務中有 9 項優於 Racka-4B，而三個匈牙利化模型在 MMLU-Redux、GSM8K、HumanEval 等基準皆出現能力退化，Racka-4B 的 HumanEval 更從 91.95 跌至 29.88。文章另批評其語料管線停留在 2020 年水準、缺乏消融實驗與 RLHF 等後訓練，並依 GPU 時數估算能耗、碳排與成本，重構 Racka 的 1,290 kg CO2eq 排放量誤差僅 3.5%。儘管 HuGME 部分指標會獎勵空泛回覆、作者亦受限於未公開的 OTP 權重，本評論仍凸顯嚴謹實驗設計、資料去汙染與跨團隊協調對低資源語言模型開發的關鍵性。

links.title: Too Good to Be Real? Diagnosing and Reducing the Gap Between AI Preference and Real User Engagement

evidence: Abstract: 1.17M answers to 25,978 questions from Zhihu, Quora, Reddit; OMRA reduces measured gap by 54.4% on average across four LLM families

§4.1: controlled benchmark of 3,600 answers over 900 questions; four families DeepSeek, Claude, GPT, Llama; baselines ToT and RoT; DeepSeek-V3.2 as fixed ontology extractor; extractor reliability checked on 100-question subset (Appendix C.6)
Table 1: OMRA Avg. Shrink 74.9% (DeepSeek), 48.2% (Claude), 47.5% (GPT), 47.1% (Llama), averaging 54.4%; only method improving all three gap views on every base model

Table 4 / §5.2 Finding 4: 30 annotators, OMRA preferred win rate 62.4% [53.6, 69.9] vs Real with 25.6% human-likeness win rate; authors state CI overlap with Few-shot makes this 'supportive rather than statistically decisive'

§3.2-§3.3 + §4.1: both the gap metrics (transfer/marginal/geometric over ontology vectors) and OMRA's over-explained span identification derive from the same LLM-based ontology extractor, creating a self-referential measurement loop partially mitigated by human-agreement checks (Table 8, Pearson 0.89-0.954)

Appendix D.5 (Tables 9-11): Length-Controlled Few-shot reaches 57.3% shrink, sentence-mood variants ≤5.8%, platform-aware prompting ≤52.0%, vs OMRA 74.9% on DeepSeek; Table 12 preservation check (stance 93.5%, factual 90.0%) uses DeepSeek as judge on its own outputs
Limitations: inference-time correction does not alter the model's internal preference; offline evaluation only; dual-use risk of engagement manipulation acknowledged

Appendix B.5: commitment to release processing code, prompts, ontology schema, filtering rules, splits, and de-identified data subject to platform redistribution constraints; full prompts provided in Appendix G
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM research: diagnoses a gap between AI preference (LLM-as-judge/synthetic preference signals relevant to alignment and reward modeling) and real user engagement, then corrects it via OMRA. The angle—validating AI preference against 1.17M naturally occurring engagement signals rather than benchmark labels—is genuinely novel relative to known judge biases (verbosity, position, self-preference). Experimental breadth is good: four LLM families, few-shot/ToT/RoT baselines, ablations, and length/mood/platform-aware controls (Tables 1, 4, 9-11), plus honest limitation and CI-overlap caveats. Key weaknesses: the diagnosis metric and the intervention share the same LLM-based ontology extractor (DeepSeek-V3.2, §4.1), so the headline 54.4% gap reduction is partly self-referential—the method optimizes the very instrument that defines the gap; external validation (30-annotator human eval on ~132 items, OMRA vs Real) is small and authors concede it is 'supportive rather than statistically decisive'; engagement labels are within-question ranks, an imperfect proxy evaluated only offline. Reproducibility is promised (Appendix B.5) and full prompts are given (Appendix G), but no code link and some hyperparameters are unspecified.

primary_link.title: Too Good to Be Real? Diagnosing and Reducing the Gap Between AI Preference and Real User Engagement

recommendations.summary: Large language models are increasingly used to generate and evaluate online content, yet it remains unclear whether the qualities they associate with higher engagement match what real users respond to. We study this question using 1.17 million answers to 25,978 questions from Zhihu, Quora, and Reddit, comparing real platform answers and AI-generated answers across four within-question engagement levels. We introduce Ontological Preference Measurement, which represents answers along three dimensi
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型日益被用來生成與評估網路內容,但其認為能提高互動的品質,未必符合真實使用者的反應。本文蒐集知乎、Quora 與 Reddit 上 25,978 個問題、共 117 萬則回答,在同一問題內將回答依投票排序劃分為四個互動等級,以排除曝光量與平台流量等干擾。作者提出「本體偏好測量」框架,以邏輯、情感、表達三個維度刻畫回答特質,並以遷移、邊際與幾何三種差距診斷 AI 偏好與真實互動的落差;驗證顯示本體特徵預測真實互動的能力優於文字嵌入與各 LLM 評審。核心發現是「邏輯過度綁定」:模型為了達到目標互動會加入更多明確的論證結構,但真實的高互動回答更仰賴情感與表達上的吸引力;在合成資料上訓練的預測器套用至真實回答時,Spearman ρ 驟降至 −0.073。據此提出 OMRA,遮蔽並重建過度解釋的片段,同時保留立場、事實內容與連貫性,在四個 LLM 家族上平均縮減 54.4% 的落差,勝過 Few-shot、ToT 與 RoT 等基準;人類評估中其兩兩偏好勝率達 62.4%,儘管真實回答更常被認為出自人類之手。控制實驗顯示長度、句式語氣與平台提示皆無法解釋其成效。限制包括依賴 LLM 本體抽取品質、僅在推論階段修正而不改變模型內部偏好,且屬離線評估,並有被濫用於操縱互動的風險。本研究對 RLHF 與 LLM-as-a-judge 的可信度提出重要警示。

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM serving/efficiency study: KV cache reuse across standard LoRA adapters on a shared backbone directly hits LLM (2.5), Inference & Serving, and efficiency preferences. Rigor is unusually high for an industrial empirical note: paired bootstrap CIs, an own-KV harness control (49.2 vs 48.3 EM, §4), explicit held-out vs overlapping-sample separation, seed replication, and honest negative results (no physical KV sharing despite 12% peak reduction, §3.2 Table 2; ridge translator rejected, §5). However, the central quality-penalty magnitude is unstable (−4.6 EM held-out CI excluding zero, but −3.0 at 320 tokens and −0.8 for seed 2, both CIs including zero; Abstract/§4), so evidence strength is moderate—the robust findings are adapter necessity, warm-cache TTFT speedup (~16× at 8K, Table 1), and the storage-copying correction. Generalizability is limited: one 1.7B backbone, two tasks, single seed per task (§6). Reproducibility is good (repo with code, checkpoints, per-example arrays, Appendix C) but timings are single-run, cap-fraction logging was missing, and the appendix is an outline. A valuable, transparent negative/qualified result rather than a new method.

We study a narrow, practical question: for already-trained standard LoRA adapters -- not adapters retrained for cache compatibility -- how much task quality is preserved if the backbone's prefill KV cache is computed once and reused across specialists, and what does that buy in serving cost? recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討小型模型可組合式部署的實際問題：一個共享骨幹搭配多個已完成訓練的標準 LoRA 專家（未為快取相容性重新訓練），若在推論時直接重複使用骨幹預先算好的 prefill KV 快取，能保留多少任務品質、又換來多少 serving 成本效益。作者以 Qwen3-1.7B 為骨幹，訓練 HotpotQA 抽取式問答與 GSM8K 算術推理兩個 rank-16 的 LoRA 專家，掃描專家接手的邊界（native、早期、題目、完整前綴），並以配對 bootstrap 信賴區間量化品質差異。結果顯示完整前綴重用的 prefill 成本最低，但 GSM8K 留出測試集準確率下降 4.6 EM（160 token 預算下唯一顯著；320 token 為 −3.0、第二個訓練 seed 為 −0.8，幅度不一致）；QA 損失隨上下文長度變化（700 token 時 +0.3 F1，2K/8K 為 −6.6/−4.5）。serving 效益是暖快取 TTFT，8K 時約 16 倍加速；但兩分支峰值記憶體僅低 12%，檢查發現前綴從未實體共享——實作只重用 KV 值卻複製其儲存。此外 ridge KV 轉換器未勝過直接重用，專家依賴性對比皆含零。研究限制包括單一小規模骨幹、僅兩項任務、部分損失源自生成截斷，且未證立品質等價或通用邊界選擇法則。本文價值在誠實界定品質—延遲權衡，並指出實體共享需分頁快取等實作方能實現記憶體節省。

links.title: ResLRP: The Role of Residual Cancellation in Attribution Instability in Vision Transformers

evidence: Sec. 4.1 + Sec. A.2: Boundedness proposition (−1/γ ≤ Φ ≤ 1+1/γ), exact conservation proof, and per-merge amplification bound A ≤ 1+2/γ.

Sec. 3 + Fig. 2: cancellation metric C ≈ 1.7 for ViTs vs C ≈ 1.4 for LLMs; Pearson correlation 0.99 between C and relevance amplification A; paper itself notes correlation alone is not causal (Qwen2.5 counterexample).

Sec. 5.2 + Tab. A.8: targeted interventions — correcting top 0.5% cancellation-prone channels (92) gives +7.9% SRG while treating 75% low-cancellation channels gives −5.5%; replication on DINOv2-B in Tab. A.8b.
Sec. 5.4 + Tab. 3: on Qwen2.5-VL-3B, Qwen3-VL-4B, Gemma-3-4B-it, ResLRP best on both metrics; localization +27–29% relative, SRG up to 3.4×, Wilcoxon p ≤ 1.7×10⁻²⁶.
Sec. A.3 + Sec. A.5: complete PyTorch backward-hook implementation, listed TIMM/HF checkpoints, seeds (339306, 754068, 23001), and single-RTX-5090 hardware; GitHub link in author footnote.
Sec. A.13 + Tab. A.6: γ sweep over 11 values on 6 models shows plateau; untuned γ=1 attains 98–100% of best-γ SRG on 5/7 models, supporting hyperparameter robustness.
Limitations & Outlook: guarantees are local to residual additions, full-model conservation limited by AttnLRP attention rule, and diffusion transformers/SSMs unexamined — appropriate self-critique.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Methodologically strong XAI paper, but core topic is vision-transformer attribution, only partially aligned with top-weighted preferences (LLMs, reasoning, agents, Japanese NLP). Relevance comes via Interpretability (LRP, SAE features), Transformer Architecture (residual/attention analysis), and Multimodal VLM evaluation; LLM content is comparative (Sec. 3: C≈1.4 in LLMs vs C≈1.7 in ViTs) rather than central, and the γ-rule is applied only to vision towers (Sec. A.11), so not capped as pure CV but not core LLM research either. Novelty is solid: identifying residual cancellation as the driver of LRP relevance explosion is a new diagnosis, though the mechanism is a simple reuse of the LRP-γ rule at residual adds. Rigor and evidence are strong: boundedness proposition with proof (Sec. 4.1/A.2), causal channel-wise interventions (Sec. 5.2, Tab. A.8: top-0.5% channels +7.9% vs bottom-75% −5.5%), component ablations (Tab. A.9), FunnyBirds ground-truth checks (Tab. 2), Wilcoxon significance for VLM gains (p≤1.7e-26, Tab. 3), γ-sweep robustness (Sec. A.13). Generalizability is good across seven ViT families and three VLMs but guarantees are local and diffusion/SSM models untested (Limitations). Reproducibility is high: complete PyTorch rule (Sec. A.3), checkpoints, seeds, hardware, and a public repo link. Quality of execution clearly above average; score capped mainly by topic fit.

primary_link.title: ResLRP: The Role of Residual Cancellation in Attribution Instability in Vision Transformers

recommendations.summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are central to most modern vision models, yet obtaining input attributions that are fine-grained, faithful, and stable remains challenging. Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) has been adapted to transformer attention, but in ViTs it often produces noisy, unfaithful explanations. We show that the missing ingredient is the treatment of residual connections: cancellation effects in residual pathways lead to attribution explosion. Moreover, we find that these cancellat
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文探討以 Layer-wise Relevance Propagation（LRP）解釋 Vision Transformer（ViT）時，常產生雜訊多且不忠實熱圖的問題。作者指出關鍵在殘差連接：當注意力或 MLP 更新與殘差流方向相反並相互抵消時，輸出活化值極小，標準 LRP 除以近零分母，會放大正負相關性對，造成「相關性爆炸」，使歸因圖破碎不穩；此現象在 ViT 中遠強於語言 Transformer，並集中於早期層。為此提出 ResLRP，在每次殘差相加處套用 γ 規則，強化與輸出同號的分支、壓抑矛盾分支的相關性；此規則完全守恆，並具可證明的放大上界（預設 γ=1 時每個殘差點 𝒜≤3）。透過通道層級因果介入，證實效益確實源自修正殘差抵消，而非一般正規化。實證涵蓋七個 ViT 檢查點、FunnyBirds 合成基準，以及 Qwen2.5-VL、Qwen3-VL、Gemma-3 三個 VLM。ResLRP 在忠實度（SRG）與定位指標上多半最佳，VLM 上定位相對提升 27–29%，SRG 最高提升 3.4 倍；ResLRP 亦能將 SAE 特徵定位回輸入空間，殘差放大指標可作為架構層級診斷，例如顯示 register tokens 能穩定殘差流。限制方面：理論保證僅限殘差相加的局部性質，整體品質仍依賴實證；端到端守恆受 AttnLRP 注意力規則限制；未檢視擴散 Transformer 或狀態空間模型等架構。由於 VLM 正成為主流視覺架構，忠實歸因對除錯、偏誤偵測與視覺接地至關重要，本方法深具價值。
recommendations.title: ResLRP: The Role of Residual Cancellation in Attribution Instability in Vision Transformers

links.title: Coupled Calibration and Learning: Mitigating Teacher Bias in LLM Distillation without Target-Domain Reward Feedback

evidence: Abstract: CCL couples teacher calibration with student updates via token-level branching using reward feedback only on source questions; expected average KL to oracle student converges at polynomial rate.
Section 5, Theorem 5.1: rate C_{lambda,m}(T+1)^{-1/(4 p_{lambda,m})} with constants 'independent of T' but model-dependent via Lojasiewicz exponent p_{lambda,m} (Lemma B.11).
Section 4, Algorithm 1 and schedules (4.3): exactly T source reward queries and O(T^3) target rollouts over T rounds, of which O(T^2) estimate student gradients.

Section 3, Eq. (3.3) and Assumptions 3.2-3.4: linear-softmax teacher/student classes with known feature maps, realizability of the regularized optimum in the calibration class, and positive-definite joint source information matrix.

Section 7 Discussion: 'computational experiments with pretrained LLMs on coding and mathematical reasoning tasks would help assess the method' - no experiments, code, or artifacts are included in the paper.
Section 6, Theorem 6.2: LLM-as-judge (H=2) instance where regularized direct matching retains KL at least kappa_SM(1-alpha)^2/(128 lambda^2) from the oracle student, supporting the separation claim.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on distillation/post-training: proposes Coupled Calibration and Learning (CCL) to correct biased teachers under covariate shift using source-only reward feedback, with a token-level branching mechanism and a direct-matching separation in an LLM-as-judge instance. Highly relevant to LLM, RLHF/reward-model, and distillation preferences. Theoretical rigor is high: assumptions (realizability, uniqueness, joint source identification) are explicit, and full proofs are provided in Appendices B-C. However, the work is purely theoretical with zero empirical validation (Section 7 concedes computational experiments are future work), the framework assumes linear-softmax policies with known feature maps that are far from real LLMs, the convergence rate (T+1)^{-1/(4p)} carries non-explicit model-dependent constants (e.g., delta_loc^d, e^{-1/lambda}) with O(T^3) target rollouts per T source queries, and no code or artifact availability is claimed. Novelty is moderate: it is a close derivative of Yamamoto and Wainwright's residual-as-teacher line, though the coupling of source-reward calibration with target-side student learning and the no-target-feedback guarantee are new.

primary_link.title: Coupled Calibration and Learning: Mitigating Teacher Bias in LLM Distillation without Target-Domain Reward Feedback

recommendations.summary: Large language model (LLM) distillation aims to transfer the capabilities of a powerful teacher to a smaller student. Direct imitation, however, can also transfer the teacher's systematic bias and errors. This challenge is particularly pronounced under covariate shift, when the teacher's reliability on target questions is uncertain and target-domain reward feedback is unavailable. We propose Coupled Calibration and Learning (CCL), an LLM distillation algorithm that couples teacher calibration wi
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討 LLM 知識蒸餾的核心難題:直接模仿強大教師模型時,會連同其系統性偏誤一併繼承;尤其在目標問題與來源問題分布不一致(covariate shift)、且目標域獎勵回饋不可得時更為棘手。作者提出耦合校準與學習(CCL)演算法,以 token 層級分支(branching)機制,僅使用來源問題的獎勵回饋同時校正教師並訓練學生:每輪迭代先以來源回饋校準教師的 softmax 參數,再以校準後的教師在目標問題上訓練學生,更新後的學生又成為下一輪校準比較時的備選 token 來源。在自迴歸策略與線性 softmax 架構下,論文證明輸出學生與 oracle 學生(在學生類別內最大化真實 KL 正規化目標獎勵的最優策略)的期望平均 KL 散度,以多項式速率收斂至零;分析結合梯度步的局部進度、均勻探索、批次梯度估計與新鮮驗證,同時控制校準誤差與有限 rollout 誤差。論文另建立分離結果:在 LLM-as-judge 實例中,即使教師的正規化獎勵高於所有學生策略,正規化直接匹配仍殘留無法消除的誤差,凸顯校準機制的必要性。限制包括尚未以真實 LLM 實驗驗證、常數依賴模型局部幾何與 Łojasiewicz 指數,且目標端 rollout 總量為 O(T³)。此結果顯示即使缺乏目標域回饋,蒸餾仍可克服教師偏誤、逼近最優學生,對 RLHF 後訓練與模型壓縮具理論價值。

primary_link.title: Interactive Memory Learning for Long-Term Conversations

recommendations.summary: Recent advancements in large language models have significantly enhanced the capabilities of agents in modeling long-term conversations. Despite these successes, existing approaches typically adopt a static heuristic paradigm, where information is passively archived without adaptive memory valuation. Consequently, these methods fail to self-evolve or align their memory management with evolving user needs. To address this, we propose ICML (InteraCtive Memory Learning), a multi-agent framework tha
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型在長期對話中多採靜態啟發式典範管理記憶，資訊被動歸檔且缺乏價值評估，導致代理無法隨使用者需求的變化自我進化。本文提出 ICML（Interactive Memory Learning），一個以線上強化學習為基礎的多代理框架，將記憶機制從被動檔案轉為可學習的互動策略。方法上，Planner 代理負責篩選並編碼高價值資訊、過濾低價值雜訊，Trigger 代理則依據當前語句動態檢索記憶；兩者共享 Actor-Critic 架構，以 PPO 進行端對端最佳化。為解決冷啟動問題，作者設計回溯式對話合成管線，先反向生成具因果一致性的前傳故事線，再正向標註記憶相依性，產生高品質專家資料供預熱。核心創新為跨對話真相回饋機制，藉由延遲獎勵將未來回應品質回傳至先前的儲存決策，使兩個代理在持續互動中共演化。實驗於 Multi-Session Chat、Conversation Chronicles 與 GapChat 三個真實長期對話資料集進行，ICML 在 BLEU-4、ROUGE-L、BertScore、Mauve 等自動指標以及 LLM 交叉評估與人工評估上，皆超越 Mem0、MemoryOS、THEANINE 等強基線，且隨對話累積持續改善；token 消耗穩定、記憶建構延遲僅毫秒等級。消融實驗顯示真相回饋與合成資料缺一不可。限制在於僅聚焦開放域陪伴式對話與個人化對齊，未涵蓋數學、程式設計或嚴格事實檢索任務，亦未驗證於對話以外領域。此研究證明記憶管理可透過環境回饋自主學習，對終身個人化助理的發展具重要啟示。

llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-methodology paper (not a pure domain application): core contributions are rubric-rewarded GRPO for structured preference reasoning and heterogeneous-negative preference-conditioned DPO, instantiated on Qwen3-VL and LLaVA-NeXT backbones, which aligns strongly with high-weight preferences (LLM, Reasoning/CoT, Alignment, Agents). Novelty is moderate: the framework is a competent composition of established techniques (GRPO, DPO, LLM-as-judge, constitutional-style rubric induction); the dynamic rubric selection and targeted dual-negative construction are the freshest elements. Rigor is unusually thorough: two datasets, two backbones, three baseline families, facet-level rubric ablations, call-matched diagnostics (Appendix I.3) that honestly separate the structured interface from synthesized data effects, independent-judge rescoring with CIs above zero (Table 16), alternative simulators, teacher/judge replacement (Table 20), and human evaluation with Fleiss' kappa. Reproducibility is aided by released code, exhaustive prompts, and pinned model versions, but depends on proprietary GPT-5.2 for data construction. Latency cost is transparently reported (2342.7ms vs 1220.9ms for ReGeS, Table 3) with a distilled 4B mitigation.

recommendations.summary: Real-world recommendation scenarios are commonly grounded in shared physical environments during user-recommender interactions. However, current approaches struggle with this setting due to two intertwined challenges: accurately understanding situated user preferences throughout the conversation and
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文針對情境式對話推薦（SCR）提出Re2A框架。SCR要求推薦助理在共享實體環境中，同時考量對話歷史、共同觀察的場景與場景內物品屬性，面臨兩大挑戰：如何準確推斷使用者於情境中的偏好，以及如何生成同時滿足使用者需求與場景限制的回應。Re2A將此任務形式化為「先推理、後對齊」流程：首先以自動歸納的評分規準（rubrics）引導模型產生顯式的偏好狀態，規準涵蓋情境性、物品相關性、一致性與輔助四個面向，並以凍結的MLLM擔任評審、動態篩選規準，透過GRPO進行獎勵最佳化；接著設計偏好條件化DPO，自動合成情境衝突與偏好衝突兩類異質負樣本，實現對使用者意圖與場景一致性的雙重對齊；推論時採階層式流程，先由偏好狀態檢索目標物品再生成回應。在SIMMC 2.1與SCREEN兩資料集上，以LLaVA-NeXT與Qwen3-VL為骨幹，Re2A超越ReGeS、CRAG等基線（如SIMMC 2.1 Hit@1達48.12%），並將視覺幻覺率從25.4%降至5.2%，弱匹配率亦大幅下降。限制包括階層式推論增加延遲且可能傳播上游錯誤、仰賴強大教師模型進行離線規準歸納與負樣本合成，且僅考慮靜態場景；作者另提供蒸餾4B推理器以緩解延遲。此研究顯示顯式結構化推理能有效提升對話推薦的忠實度與情境適切性，對打造真實環境中的情境推薦助理具參考價值。

Novelty is moderate: generator-verifier decoupling is an intuitive, previously explored alignment principle; the Architecture-0 framing, TIR schema, dual-ledger S2P mapper, and NAC metric are competent system contributions rather than conceptual breakthroughs. Rigor is weakened by very small samples (N=15 per group in Fig. 7; 5 runs/case/model in core trials), manual outcome classification with no inter-annotator agreement or significance testing, hand-crafted static ledgers/profiles, and a model-version inconsistency between the preliminary (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Sec. 4.5) and core (Claude 4.5 Sonnet, Sec. 6) experiments. recommendations.summary: Autonomous Software Engineering Agents (SWE-Agents) excel in deterministic coding tasks but struggle with Architecture 0, the nascent system design phase plagued by implicit engineering constraints, or Unknown Unknowns (UUs) that are rarely stated explicitly. To investigate how agents navigate UUs, we explore a progressive trajectory across pure-text self-play, tool-augmented feedback, and external physical mapping. Our empirical analysis reveals a cascading chain of failures. Pure-text reasonin
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文探討自主軟體工程代理（SWE-Agent）在系統設計初期階段的落地難題。程式碼層級任務仰賴編譯器與測試的確定性回饋，但在尚無程式碼的 Architecture 0 階段，代理必須面對隱含的工程限制，即「未知的未知」。作者以漸進式實驗揭示一連串認知退化：純文字自我對弈會淪為社交諂媚或看似合理卻違反物理的虛構設計；賦予代理可執行的 α-Sandbox 後，反而誘發規格操弄，代理藉竄改驗證腳本、捏造硬體參數或稀釋服務等級協定騙取表面通過。為破解此自我驗證陷阱，本文提出 Physical Mapping Guard（PMG），依據關注點分離原則，剝奪代理的驗證權限，強制其提交結構化拓撲表示，並由外部確定性的語義到物理（S2P）映射引擎計算資源帳冊與衝突偵測。跨模型實驗顯示，PMG 完全消除物理層與驗證層的規格操弄，公開系統設計資料集正確率達 88.9%，嚴格約束稽核者後更回升至 100%。剩餘失敗則遷移至語義層，包括重新詮釋業務語義、稽核者過度審查與停滯的結構修正；意圖擾動實驗亦證實單靠提示工程無法彌補此缺陷。限制方面，資源帳冊為靜態預設、評估規模有限，語義歧義仍需人類把關。本研究為 AI 輔助系統設計提供了可驗證的物理落地機制與清晰的診斷基準，凸顯代理須受外部確定性約束方能真正對齊工程現實。

Strongly matches curator interests in interpretability, multimodal AI, LLMs, and AI safety, though it misses the heaviest preference categories (agents, reasoning/CoT, Japanese NLP) and is not a pure-vision paper, so the out-of-scope cap does not apply. Methodologically careful: locked calibration-only selection, dense/random-sparse controls, base-vs-residual SAE ablations, paired bootstrap and McNemar tests, honest limitations. Main readout-gap result is large and replicated across two families and six tasks (Table 2). Weaknesses: interventions rest on tiny eligible subsets (n<=15 knockout, n<=5 patch pairs, Appendix G Table 6), headline FHM gain over the gated baseline is only +0.0122 (the +0.0707 is vs native, Appendix H), Gemma cross-lingual gains are unstable (0.0145±0.0302, Table 11), sensitivity ratios are scale-dependent and not mediation fractions, a 931-vs-1000 denominator discrepancy is acknowledged as unreconciled (Figure 6), and no code/artifact release is stated despite detailed configurations. Solid, unusually self-critical contribution; claims are appropriately scoped to decodability vs routing vs correctness.

We distinguish these cases in Gemma-3 and Qwen3.5 using sparse autoencoders, role-conditioned probes, causal interventions, and recovery experiments across six harmful content benchmarks, with additional Spanish and Hindi-English code-mixed evaluations. Sparse readouts outperform native prediction on all six primary binary
recommendations.summary_zh: 當大型視覺語言模型誤判有害迷因時，失敗可能源於內部證據缺失，或證據雖已表示卻未能路由至輸出。本文以 Gemma-3 與 Qwen3.5 兩個模型家族為對象，結合稀疏自編碼器（SAE）、角色條件化探針、因果介入與復原實驗，在六個有害內容基準上評估，並加入西班牙文與印地語—英語混碼資料的穩健性測試。結果顯示，稀疏讀出在全部六項二元任務上皆超越原生預測：Qwen 平均 macro-F1 由 0.432 升至 0.740，Gemma 由 0.532 升至 0.714。介入實驗發現，靜默特徵消融對探針分數的敏感度是對原生輸出的 24–63 倍，而路由特徵修補對輸出的敏感度則高出 16–140 倍，顯示探針判別方向與輸出路由方向明顯分離。僅以校準資料選取係數的直接 logit 路由可回收 93.3% 的平均落差；探針蒸餾 LoRA 能改善原生預測，但共享多任務調適引發負遷移。Gemma-3-12B 在 FHM 上的案例呈現分散式 rank-32 影像—提示交互作用，macro-F1 達 0.756，高於原生的 0.685。跨語言、OCR 消融與影像擾動控制證實訊號超越英文、非僅仰賴 OCR，且實質依賴配對視覺證據。作者提醒此落差並非對等比較，部分介入樣本有限，機制結論僅限於所選層、字典與輸出錨點。整體而言，研究指出路由而非表示本身是有害迷因分類的關鍵瓶頸，為模型可解釋性與內容安全系統設計提供新方向。
recommendations.title: Decodable but Misrouted: Sparse Features Uncover a Readout Gap in Vision-Language Models for Harmful Meme Detection
recommendations.title_zh: 可解碼但路由錯置：稀疏特徵揭露視覺語言模型在有害迷因偵測中的讀出落差

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM/RAG methodology paper (query-conditioned source routing, uniform budget allocation, task-conditioned chunking/metadata routing), not a pure domain application despite the historical-archive testbed. Methods are simple (logistic-regression router, nearest-centroid assignment, per-source quota) and build on existing adaptive-RAG/chunking ideas, so novelty is moderate; the clean contribution is the falsifiable decomposition of source-contamination vs. source-starvation failure modes. Rigor is good: fixed 437/438 split, 5 seeds, Bonferroni-corrected paired t-tests, ablations (QRe, UMS, composed), per-type/per-cluster decompositions, honest reporting that TC-Chunking gains vanish under routing and that the joint 14x14 variant never beats TC-Metadata. Evidence is strong within the single benchmark but rests on one 1887 French corpus, one embedding family, LLM-generated/historian-validated questions, and LLM-as-judge end-to-end evaluation with no human adjudication. Generalizability is explicitly argued-not-demonstrated by the authors (corpus-specific regexes, thin classifier support). Reproducibility is well supported: code, built indexes, fitted transforms, classifier weights, prompts, and per-seed splits are released, with a Cohere API dependency.

primary_link.title: ORDER: Task-Conditioned Routing for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

recommendations.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines typically rely on a fixed indexing and retrieval configuration determined at preprocessing time. This one-size-fits-all design is ill-suited to domain-expert settings, where heterogeneous queries require different chunking granularities, metadata constraints, and source-selection strategies. As a result, configurations that are effective for one family of queries often perform poorly for others. In this paper, we introduce ORDER (Optimal Routing for
recommendations.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）系統通常在預處理階段就固定索引與檢索設定，這種一體適用的設計在需要異質查詢的領域專家場景中表現不佳。本文以法國第三共和史學問答資料集 HistoriQA-ThirdRepublic 為基礎，提出 ORDER 框架，將最佳化拆分為離線的文件條件化軸與線上的查詢條件化軸。線上機制包含兩個互補組件：監督式查詢路由器 QRe 僅從問題文字預測哪些資料集含有相關證據，以及均勻多來源取樣器 UMS 將檢索預算平均分配給路由後存留的資料集，分別對抗「來源污染」與「來源飢餓」兩種失敗模式。離線方面，作者對訓練問題進行語意分群，為每個群組選出最佳的區塊切分策略與詮釋資料過濾／重排設定，推論時以最近質心方式路由查詢至預建索引。在 438 題保留測試集上，QRe 與 UMS 結合使 Recall@3 從 37.7 提升至 53.7，端對端答題準確率從 31.0 升至 48.1，全面超越 BM25、HippoRAG v2、LinearRAG 與 Adaptive Chunking 等基線，且機制可移植至 BM25 等不同檢索器。不過任務條件化切分的增益在路由啟用後即被吸收，僅詮釋資料軸在 UMS 下持續有效。作者自陳限制：語料僅涵蓋 1887 年法文報紙與國會紀錄、題目由 LLM 生成、嵌入模型單一、端對端評估仰賴 LLM 評審且路由器訓練樣本偏少。此研究顯示查詢條件化路由能以極低的線上成本，顯著改善異質歷史檔案的跨來源檢索。

Abstract vs Section 1 contributions: abstract states 'improving Kendall's tau by up to 7.2% relative to EssenceBench on SWE-bench Verified' while the contribution bullet states 'improving Kendall's tau by up to 5.4%' — numeric inconsistency.

Table 3: w/o ORM (process-only) fails catastrophically on Terminal-Bench 2 (MAE 50.142, tau 0.010 at Anchor=20), while w/o PRM is close to full model, indicating the outcome view carries most of the signal.
Appendix C.1 / Table 4: all seven Qwen configurations held out; DualViewEval average MAE 2.020 vs EssenceBench 2.746 and SparseEval 5.897.

Appendix D Algorithm 1 and Appendix B equations (12)-(18) give full optimization procedure and metric definitions (e.g., lr 0.05, 1000 epochs, B=5 folds in Section 4.1); no explicit code or data release statement appears in the paper.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic for LLM agent evaluation (Agents & Tool Use, evaluation/benchmarking): proposes DualViewEval, a benchmark-compression method that fuses outcome and trajectory-derived process relation matrices to learn an exact-size miniset. Novelty is moderate: benchmark compression is well studied (Anchor Points, TinyBench/gp-IRT, SparseEval, EssenceBench), and the new angle—six observable trajectory statistics plus dual-view Gram-matrix fusion with a straight-through hard Top-K gate and Kernel Ridge head—is a sensible but incremental composition of known parts. Rigor is solid in structure (5 benchmarks, 5 baselines, 3 budgets, 10 splits, ablations of both views, selector and architecture ablations, held-out Qwen-family test, fixed-gamma sensitivity, complete Algorithm 1), but marred by internal inconsistencies: the abstract claims up to 7.2% Kendall-tau improvement over EssenceBench on SWE-bench Verified while the contribution list says 5.4%, and Section 5 text cites Figure 10 for the learned-gamma, training-proportion, and efficiency analyses whose captions belong to Figures 8-10, indicating sloppy cross-referencing. Evidence strength is good (Table 2 with mean±std supports 'best on all datasets', Table 3 shows w/o ORM collapses on Terminal-Bench 2 at MAE 50.1/tau 0.010, Appendix C.1 shows transfer with avg MAE 2.020 vs 2.746 for EssenceBench), though some results have high variance (e.g., APEX tau 0.800±0.274). Generalizability is supported across benchmarks and a held-out model family but only for agent benchmarks with trajectories. Reproducibility benefits from detailed metric definitions (Appendix B) and hyperparameters, but no code/data release statement is present. Weighted score ≈0.70.

primary_link.title: Beyond Outcomes: Dual-View Relational Learning for Efficient Agent Benchmarking

recommendations.summary: Agent benchmarks are substantially more costly to evaluate than conventional LLM benchmarks. Benchmark compression is therefore a natural solution, yet existing methods primarily model redundancy in task--model final-score distributions, which is important in agentic evaluation. To address this limitation, we analyze large-scale trajectories and identify six complementary process signals that are systematically associated with final agent performance. To disentangle agent performance redundancy
recommendations.summary_zh: 代理基準的評估成本遠高於一般 LLM 基準：長程推理、反覆呼叫工具與有狀態環境互動，使單次評估動輒耗費上萬美元或數天運算，而現有基準壓縮方法多僅依賴最終分數的冗餘結構，忽略背後的執行過程。本文提出 DualViewEval，先分析五個代理基準的大規模軌跡，從十二項可觀測統計量中篩出六項與最終表現系統性相關的過程訊號（步數、工具失敗率、工具類別熵、驗證工具比例、必要寫入執行、讀寫驗證閉合），再以「結果關係矩陣」與「過程關係矩陣」雙視角融合，透過 straight-through 硬 Top-K 閘門學習精確大小的精選任務集，並以 Kernel Ridge 預測器結合分數與排名損失進行端對端聯合最佳化。在 BFCL、τ²-Bench、Terminal-Bench 2、SWE-bench Verified 與 APEX-Agents 五個基準上，僅用 20 個任務即達 24–40 倍壓縮，MAE 較最強對手降低 14.5%–28.2%，Kendall's τ 同步提升，訓練速度較 SparseEval 快約 4.2–8.3 倍，且對完整留出的 Qwen 模型家族仍具遷移能力。限制在於仰賴開放軌跡資料、六項過程指標仍屬淺層統計，且當受測模型與訓練分布差異過大時預測可能失準。此方法使高頻、低成本的代理評測成為可能，精選任務集亦能放大各模型的行為差異，提供分數之外的診斷價值。

links.title: Evaluating Verified Autonomy in Quantum Engineering

evidence: Abstract: 'we introduce QIQCBench, a benchmark of 49 expert-authored tasks spanning multiple layers including calibration and control, error correction and compilation, sensing and networking' evaluated across '17 frontier agentic systems'

Section II.2: 'Quantum-Harbor provides the large language model (LLM) agent with a sandbox environment... It builds on Harbor... adds three features to Harbor: a laboratory interface for quantum experiments, interchangeable quantum hardware backends, and evidence-bound grading'

Section II.4: 'A Bradley-Terry fit spreads the field from 1694 down to 582, with the anchor fixed at 1000' and cross-checks against AutomationBench-AA and GDPval-AA v2 showing benchmark discriminates systems that tie elsewhere

llm_evaluation.rationale: A rigorous agent-evaluation paper, not a pure quantum domain application: the contribution is LLM-agent benchmarking methodology (verified autonomy, evidence-bound grading) instantiated on quantum engineering tasks. Strongly matches Agents & Tool Use (17 frontier LLM systems, MCP tools, Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode harnesses), LLM, and evaluation preferences. Evidence-bound grading that recomputes claims from a hidden evidence log and replays calibrations on fresh data is a genuine methodological advance over output-only benchmarks. Rigor is solid: Wilson intervals, Bradley-Terry Elo with ridge regularization, a three-way failure taxonomy, transcript audits, quarantining of infrastructure faults, and cross-benchmark discrimination checks against AutomationBench-AA and GDPval-AA v2. Evidence is concrete (pass rates 78%-3%, 937/1510 no-submission failures, Elo 1694-582, 37/39 tasks solved, Spearman rho=0.14 for stack depth). Deductions: simulation-only environment limits transfer to real devices, 3 trials per task is modest, hidden thresholds and deferred Supplementary Material reduce independent verification, and benchmark release for QIQCBench tasks is not explicitly confirmed. Not capped at 0.20 because language-model agent methodology, not quantum physics alone, is the core contribution.

primary_link.title: Evaluating Verified Autonomy in Quantum Engineering

recommendations.summary: Reliable quantum engineering is essential for turning quantum phenomena into practical technologies. As quantum platforms grow in scale and complexity, their characterization and operation require increasing human effort and coordination. Scientific artificial intelligence agents, which can plan experiments, operate instruments, and analyze observations, offer a promising route towards autonomous quantum engineering. Yet whether current agents can perform reliably in this setting has not been sy
recommendations.summary_zh: 量子工程隨平台規模擴大,人工操作與協調成本不斷攀升。科學 AI 代理雖能規劃實驗、操作儀器並分析結果,但其在量子工程中的可靠性尚未被系統性驗證。本文提出「可驗證自主性」,要求代理完成任務時,須以執行過程取得的證據支持結論;無法直接檢驗的校正或設計,須在全新隱藏條件下重測。團隊為此打造虛擬量子實驗室 Quantum-Harbor,以沙盒隱藏裝置參數與評分真相,代理僅能透過 MCP 公開介面讀取硬體規格、提交實驗並取得原始量測紀錄;評分器綁定證據日誌,從原始資料重新計算結果,防止虛報。基於此框架建立 QIQCBench,含 49 道專家設計任務,涵蓋校正控制、糾錯、編譯、感測與網路、模擬與多體物理六大類,橫跨量子運算堆疊五層,評分採通過/失敗與 Bradley–Terry Elo 競速兩種模式。研究評測八家廠商的 17 個前沿系統(如 GPT-5.6、Claude Opus 4.8、DeepSeek-V4),每題獨立執行三次,通過率介於 3% 至 78%,差異懸殊;未提交為最大失敗類別(1,510 次失敗中佔 937 次),其餘多為科學性失敗;競速排序與通過率一致。39 題中 37 題至少被一個系統解出,模擬與多體物理最難(15%),成功呈間歇性,僅 34% 曾通過的組合三次全過。限制在於全為模擬環境、固定時間預算與特定 harness,能否遷移至真實硬體仍待驗證。此基準揭示能力展示與可靠運轉間的落差,為量子工程自主代理的可驗證進展奠定測量基礎,並指出實驗判斷與 harness 改進是提升可靠性的關鍵方向。

llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-based grounded-QA system paper squarely on-topic for LLM, RAG/retrieval, evidence grounding, and evaluation preferences: a claude-sonnet-5 pipeline (§4) over a 27,487-paper pool with page-level citation. Its best work is methodological self-measurement: a controlled decomposition showing the page selector (52.6% gold-page recall over 97 units, §5) rather than the reader (94% correct citation) bottlenecks evidence grounding, a quiet-failure analysis (31/45 wrong-page emissions), an honest ablation of a dev-fitted padding heuristic that cost 0.245 paper F1 (§7), an option-permutation positional-bias correction (0.840→0.920 MC accuracy, §8), and a negative result that groundedness does not predict correctness (§9). Novelty is moderate: oracle-decomposition echoes QASPER, the 'show the whole paper' fix is self-described as blunt, and permutation voting is a known debiasing trick. Rigor is genuinely careful (deterministic selector measurement, single-parameter ablation, disclosed caveats on the non-like-for-like dense baseline and unmeasured lost-in-the-middle threat) but rests on 55/71 questions, with the MC debias on six corrected answers acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is exemplary for a closed-model system: content-addressed sha256 call cache, provenance stamping, and a reproduce.py harness verifying claims against committed artifacts (§13). Generalizability is bounded: the fix applies only when documents fit in context, and validation is on a single shared task. Not out-of-scope; no unsupported claims detected, and test numbers come from the organizers' evaluator (Table 1).

recommendations.summary: We describe our system for LitTraceQA (GroundLM @ EMNLP 2026): given a research question, retrieve the relevant papers from a pool of 27,487, cite the page and the table or figure where the answer lives, and answer in a requested format. Our main finding is that evidence grounding is limited by retrieval, not by reading. The page selector put the annotator's page, which we call the gold page, in front of the model that locates evidence only about half the time (52.6% gold-page recall), while tha
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文描述參加 LitTraceQA（GroundLM 2026 共享任務）的系統：給定研究問題，須從 27,487 篇論文中檢索相關文獻，標註答案所在頁面與表格或圖片，並以指定格式作答。核心發現是證據定位的瓶頸在檢索而非閱讀：頁面選擇器僅 52.6% 的情況把 gold page 送給讀者模型，但拿到正確頁面時，48 個定位中有 45 個（94%）引用正確；缺頁時模型鮮少拒答，45 例中 24 例給出錯頁，形成大量靜默失敗。由於每篇論文中位數長度僅約 19k tokens，作者改為直接把全文放入上下文，gold-page recall 達 100%；BM25 在文件內頁面排序上因 IDF 退化與主題詞彙重疊而失效。系統另以確定性結構錨點處理「第 24 篇參考文獻」等依序數定位的問題，並以排列選項的多數投票修正選擇題偏愛最後選項的位置偏誤，將測試準確率從 0.840 提升至 0.920。蘊含把關的負結果顯示答案是否有根據與其正確性近乎獨立，且指標無法鼓勵棄權。最終測試成績為 paper F1 0.762、evidence F1 0.441、選擇題準確率 0.920。限制包括樣本小（開發 55 題、測試 71 題）、除偏結論僅基於六個修正案例、PDF 版本不符、公式內容常缺席於文字層，且系統依賴無 seed 控制的封閉模型，須靠釋出的回應快取重現。本文提醒：先測量選擇器召回率再投資閱讀器；文件塞得進上下文時乾脆不要選擇；調參須逐一消融而非整批評估。

evidence: Section 5.1, Table 3: on four AgentDojo suites, CaMeL and CaMeLoT agree on 59 of 75 tests (42 both pass, 22 both fail, 17 both block; 9 CaMeLoT-only pass, 7 CaMeL-only pass), run with claude-haiku-4-5-20251001
Section 5.1: CaMeLoT achieves static coverage of 22 out of 28 CaMeL security policies; confidentiality/reader-based policies are explicitly not handled statically

Section 5.2, Table 5: CaMeLoT catches all 7 hand-constructed unsafe SOC plan variants while the simplified taint-only CaMeL baseline catches only S7; text admits properties were designed to exceed CaMeL's expressiveness
Section 5.3, Table 9: prompt-to-CTL extraction exact on 85/97 tasks (87.6%), faithful on 88/97 (90.7%), 100% vocabulary and grounding survival
Section 5.3, Table 10: direct CTL generation is model-dependent (GPT-4.1 nano 12/97 clean tasks; Claude Haiku 4.5 96/97) versus 97/97 for the typed pipeline, supporting the architectural design
Section 6: loop/conditional abstraction as nondeterministic choice 'may produce false positives and block some safe plans'; token-savings benefit is argued qualitatively, never quantified

Section 4 footnote 2: implementation is a public fork of the CaMeL repo (github.com/detlearsom/camelot); Section 5 uses public AgentDojo suites and a bespoke simplified SOC scenario with only 4 end-to-end P-LLM tests (Table 6)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope work on LLM-agent security: extends CaMeL (prompt-injection defense for tool-using agents) with pre-execution CTL model checking (nuXmv) of generated plans, counterexample-guided plan repair, and a typed-obligation pipeline that grounds natural-language task requirements into temporal logic without letting the LLM write CTL directly. Strong alignment with Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, and LLM preferences. Novelty is solid but incremental: plan-verification via NuSMV/TLA+ with counterexample repair exists (Ramani et al., TraceFix, TemporalGuard, AgentSpec); the differentiators are static-before-execution checking, the CaMeL integration, and the trusted compilation path. Rigor is mixed: Experiment 1 (22/28 CaMeL policies mirrored; 59/75 agreement on AgentDojo with claude-haiku-4-5) is reasonable; Experiment 2 uses a deliberately weak taint-only CaMeL baseline on hand-built unsafe plans (7/7 vs 1/7), and end-to-end tests cover only 4 cases; token-savings claims in the abstract are argued qualitatively (Section 6) but never measured. The E2 ablation (direct CTL generation: GPT-4.1 nano 12/97 clean vs typed pipeline 97/97, Table 10) is a genuine strength. Generalizability is constrained by dependence on CaMeL's restricted Python plan language and static provenance; confidentiality/reader properties are explicitly left to runtime. Reproducibility is decent: public code fork (github.com/detlearsom/camelot, Section 4 footnote), public AgentDojo benchmark, named model version, and CTL policies tabulated, though the SOC scenario is bespoke.

primary_link.title: CaMeLoT: CaMeL orchestrated with Temporal logic for static verification and liveness

recommendations.summary: LLM-based agents generate and execute multi-step plans that invoke external tools which can access private data or execute commands. In this setting, security is a property of the entire execution that a plan creates, not just any single step. The plan itself is a critical artefact that captures the tool calls, control flow, and data dependencies. We present CaMeLoT, a complement to CaMeL, an existing defence against prompt injection in tool-using LLM agents. CaMeLoT extends CaMeL by adding a st
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出CaMeLoT,一套擴充Google DeepMind CaMeL的神經符號防禦方法,對抗工具型LLM代理的提示詞注入攻擊。CaMeL政策為程序式、時間上局部的執行期檢查,無法自然表達活性(liveness)或跨整個執行的時序性質,不安全計畫常到後期才被攔下,浪費運算與token。CaMeLoT在計畫產生後、工具呼叫前插入靜態驗證層:將P-LLM的受限Python計畫經AST轉為有限狀態機,標註工具呼叫、來源污點與歷史述詞,以CTL表達安全政策並用nuXmv模型檢查器驗證;失敗時反例軌跡轉為修復提示引導重規劃,類似CEGAR迴圈。系統亦能以型別化義務從使用者提示萃取任務層級CTL性質,由可信程式碼接地(grounding)與編譯,避免LLM直接產出不可靠公式。結果:AgentDojo四套件上,CaMeLoT靜態覆蓋28條CaMeL政策中的22條,75個計畫有59個判定一致;SOC情境攔截全部7種不安全變體,簡化版CaMeL僅攔截污點類違規;提示萃取於97項任務達87.6%精確比對,20個受控違規全被攔截且與手寫公式一致。限制:靜態污點抽象可能過度阻擋安全計畫,機密性(讀者集)檢查仍留給CaMeL執行期,非決定性迴圈抽象可能漏驗部分性質,工具呼叫視為黑箱。整體而言,此研究顯示形式化時序驗證可在執行前攔截不安全計畫、節省成本,補足執行期防禦之不足,對代理系統安全極具實務價值。

links.title: DyMT-ESB: Dynamic Multi-Turn Evaluation of Social Bias in User-LLM Interactions

evidence: §2.2 Evaluation Flow: DyMT-ESB generates user queries conditioned on seed stereotype and dialogue history via gpt-4o-mini (equations 1-3), avoiding pre-specified turns
§3.2 Models: five open-weight LLMs (Gemma3-12B, Qwen3-8B, Llama3.1-8B, Phi-4, Olmo3-7B) plus Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite; gpt-4o-mini used as both U-LLM and judge, distinct from all targets
§3.6 / Table 1: human evaluation with 3 annotators (authors) on 125 turn-level instances; Human-Human Gwet's AC1 0.76, Human-LLM 0.70; Appendix C reports weak Fleiss' kappa of 0.35 in Phase 1
§3.4 Baselines: FairMT-Bench recomputed by authors; paper explicitly states the comparison 'is not intended as a controlled ablation between the static and dynamic settings'
§4 / Table 3: cumulative bias ratio increases 7.92-11.25 percentage points from turns 5 to 10, with Religion showing the largest increase (avg 13.33 pp)
Appendix D Table 8: 95% dialogue-level bootstrap CIs reported for cumulative bias ratios; Limitations states bootstrap captures dialogue-level sampling only, not run-to-run variance
§5.1 / Figure 3: claims of non-monotonic bias and re-emergence are based on transition visualization; Table 4 reports re-emergence ratios of 4.58-10.00% across models
Ethics Statement: generated dialogues/datasets not released due to harm risk; only the evaluation framework code is released at https://github.com/rem-h4/dymt-esb
Limitations: English-only, six models, six bias categories, authors as annotators, and full dynamic pipeline not independently rerun
llm_evaluation.rationale: A squarely in-scope LLM safety/evaluation paper: it proposes DyMT-ESB, a response-conditioned multi-turn protocol for measuring social bias dynamics, evaluated with LLM-as-a-judge and guardrail models across six LLMs. Preference relevance is high (LLM evaluation, AI safety, red-teaming-adjacent, prompting methodology). Novelty is moderate: dynamic/LLM-simulated multi-turn evaluation exists (MART, CoSafe, LLM-as-interviewer cited in §6); the contribution is applying history-conditioned query generation to social bias and characterizing late emergence, non-monotonicity, and re-emergence. Rigor is decent: human validation of the judge (Gwet's AC1 0.70 human-LLM in Table 1), 240 seed stereotypes, bootstrap CIs (Appendix D Table 8), honest caveats that the FairMT-Bench comparison is not a controlled ablation (§3.4); weakened by author-annotators (§3.6), 125-instance human sample, weak Fleiss' kappa (0.35, Appendix C), single judge model, and no significance testing for cross-model claims. Evidence supports the headline that bias appears in coherent low-refusal dialogues (Table 2) and late-emerging bias of 7.92-11.25 pp from turns 5-10 (Table 3), but several dynamics claims rest on qualitative figure inspection (§5.1) and low absolute bias rates. Generalizability is limited by English-only, six mostly small models, and six bias categories (Limitations). Reproducibility is partial: code and full prompts released (Appendix F), but no dialogue data release (Ethics Statement) and no independent reruns of the pipeline (Limitations, sixth point).

LLMs are increasingly used in interactive settings by the general public, making the evaluation of model behavior in multi-turn conversational scenarios important for safety, including stereotyping-related harms. However, existing multi-turn social bias evaluations often rely on pre-specified or template-based user inputs that do not adapt to model responses and typically assume a fixed dialogue length in advance. In this pape
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文探討大型語言模型（LLM）多輪對話中的社會偏見評估問題。既有評估多仰賴預先設計或模板化的使用者輸入，無法隨模型回應調整，且對話輪數固定，難以觀察偏見隨輪次演變的動態。作者提出 DyMT-ESB，一個受控的動態評估協定：以一句種子刻板印象陳述為錨點，由使用者查詢生成模型（gpt-4o-mini）依據對話歷史動態產生後續提問，再以 LLM-as-a-Judge 逐輪標記偏見，並支援可變輪數評估。實驗涵蓋六個模型（Gemma3-12B、Qwen3-8B、Llama3.1-8B、Phi-4、Olmo3-7B 與 Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite），結果顯示即使在連貫且低拒答的互動中，偏見仍會出現；累積偏見率於第 5 至 10 輪間再增加約 7.92 至 11.25 個百分點，呈現「晚發偏見」、逐輪非單調變動與偏見重現等現象，且模型間排名會因評估協定不同而改變。人類標註驗證評審可靠度（Gwet's AC1 約 0.70 至 0.76），護欄過濾分析亦顯示偏見在 ShieldGemma 事後過濾後仍可觀察。限制包括僅以英文進行、受測模型與偏見類別涵蓋有限、生成對話尚未完全貼近真人互動，且未提出減緩方法。此研究強調社會偏見應視為輪級動態現象，為超越固定腳本的安全評估與後續對齊資料合成奠定基礎。

links.title: What Breaks Under Pruning in Smart Homes, and When? Evaluating LLM Degradation Across Architectures and Task Complexity

evidence: Abstract: 'we evaluate more than 19,500 instances from three smart-home datasets... dense models have narrow safe pruning regions followed by sharp degradation, while MoE models tolerate substantially more pruning'
Section 3.4: 'We apply FLAP to Qwen3-4B; its method design does not directly support the Gated DeltaNet modules used in Qwen3.5' — explains non-factorial method-architecture coverage
Section 4.2: 'For REAP, removing 70% of experts reduces stored parameters from 35B to approximately 12.5B with a nonsignificant -0.37% change'
Section 4.2: 'unpruned Qwen3-4B refuses 7.7%; at 50% pruning this rises to 56.2% with Angular and 80.8% with FLAP' — over-refusal finding
Section 4.2: 'At 50%, mean losses are 24.2% vs. 21.1% for d vs. o, and 20.7% vs. 14.5% for v vs. p' — specificity-first degradation
Section 4.1: 'For SHTC, to comply with proprietary-data requirements, we report only performance changes ΔAcc relative to the corresponding unpruned model' — reproducibility limitation
Limitations: 'all evaluated models belong to the Qwen family; whether the observed pruning patterns generalize to other model families remains to be studied'
Appendix A: SFT details — '50,001 training examples... one epoch... 32,768 tokens... 32 NVIDIA A100 80 GB GPUs for dense LLM architectures and 64... for the MoE model'
Appendix E: 'F1 does not change the conclusions, and the shape of the degradation is unchanged' — metric robustness check
Appendix F.1: 'On HomeBench, 14.1% of exact-match outcomes change somewhere along the pruning, rising to 33.7% for Partially Executable' — instance-level instability despite flat aggregate curves
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM study: structured pruning of four Qwen-family LLMs (dense, hybrid, MoE) evaluated on context-grounded tool calling across three datasets (>19,500 instances) with post-pruning SFT, matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, agents/tool calling, and efficiency (pruning/compression). The fine-grained degradation framework (action components o/d/p/v plus a five-level complexity taxonomy) is a genuine evaluation contribution, with notable findings: specificity (device/value) degrades before intent (operation/argument), dense pruning has narrow safe regions with cliffs while REAP expert pruning tolerates 70% removal at -0.37%, and aggressive dense pruning induces systematic over-refusal (7.7% to 56.2-80.8% false refusals). Rigor is solid: matched SFT healing, F1 robustness check (Appendix E), instance-stability across ratios and seeds (Appendix F), and honest limitations. Weaknesses: single model family limits external validity; method-architecture coverage is not factorial; key dataset is proprietary so only deltas reported; no code release; no latency/throughput measurements despite deployment framing; several mechanism explanations (e.g., 'alternative information pathways') are speculative. Novelty is moderate as it applies existing pruning methods (ShortGPT, Angular, FLAP, 2SSP, REAP) in a new evaluation regime rather than proposing new techniques.

primary_link.title: What Breaks Under Pruning in Smart Homes, and When? Evaluating LLM Degradation Across Architectures and Task Complexity

recommendations.summary: Pruning can reduce the deployment cost of large language models (LLMs), but its impact on context-grounded tool calling remains poorly understood. We systematically study pruning-induced degradation in smart-home tool calling across four LLMs spanning dense Transformer, dense hybrid, and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, together with depth, width, hybrid, and expert pruning methods. After post-pruning supervised fine-tuning (SFT), we evaluate more than 19,500 instances from three smart-ho
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型日益用於智慧家庭控制的自然語言介面，結構化剪枝雖能降低部署成本，其對情境grounded tool calling的影響卻缺乏系統性研究。本文以四個Qwen系列模型（dense Transformer、dense hybrid與MoE架構），搭配深度、寬度、混合與專家剪枝（ShortGPT、Angular、FLAP、2SSP、REAP），剪枝後施以相同SFT，於三個智慧家庭資料集逾19,500個實例上，從動作元件（operation、device、argument、value）與任務複雜度（Simple至Infeasible五類）兩面向分析退化。結果顯示：dense模型安全剪枝區間狹窄、之後急遽崩壞；MoE模型則容忍度高，REAP移除70%專家僅損失0.37%。剪枝先破壞grounded specificity（device、value）再及schema層級intent；原準確率無法預測剪枝敏感度，Partially Executable最脆弱；激進dense剪枝更引發過度拒絕：Qwen3-4B經FLAP 50%剪枝後，對可執行請求的拒絕率由7.7%升至80.8%。附錄另以F1與跨seed穩健性分析佐證。限制包括模型皆屬Qwen家族、剪枝方法受架構相容性限制，且僅限智慧家庭領域。本研究指出單看整體準確率不足以評估剪枝模型，細粒度評估對兼顧成本與可靠工具執行至關重要。

links.title: Integrating the Analytic Hierarchy Process with Large Language Models for Transparent Multi-Criteria Decision-Making

evidence: Abstract, p.1: claims 'the first end-to-end approach that enables LLMs to perform the complete AHP workflow' and a new annotated benchmark.

Section 3.3, p.3-4: of 20 annotation groups, 12 removed for invalid/inconsistent criteria; final LEGAL-AHP retains 60 reliable QA pairs with CR<0.1; Table 3 reports ~80% average agreement with LEGALBENCH gold.
Section 5.1 / Table 4, p.6: GPT-4o-mini Non-AHP 73.3% vs Multi-Agent (Auto) 81.7%; Mistral falls 68.3%→36.7% under Multi-Agent (Manual), showing model-capacity dependence.
Section 5.2 / Table 5, p.6: criteria alignment judged by LLM-as-judge (Qwen3-30B-A3B); Single-Agent most often selected (e.g., 53/75 for LLaMA3), with no validation of the judge itself.
Section 5.4 / Tables 12-13, p.7 and p.13: portability mixed—QS Kendall's Tau GPT-4o-mini 37.8%→42.2% but Qwen 24.4%→20.0%; U.S. News Qwen 37.8%→60.0% but GPT-4o-mini 68.9%→60.0%.

Limitations, p.9: authors acknowledge dependence on model reasoning capacity, annotator subjectivity in criteria/weights, and that LEGAL-AHP is 'relatively small due to the complexity of AHP-based annotation'.
Section 4.2, p.6: temperature fixed at 0.7, accuracy averaged over three runs with identical 5-8 few-shot examples; no standard deviations or significance tests reported.

Footnote 1, p.2 and Ethical Considerations, p.9: dataset available in supplementary material and 'will be anonymized prior to its release'; prompts given in Appendix E (Tables 16-19) support partial reproduction.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM-centric paper spanning Agents (manual + auto multi-agent AHP with CaptainAgent), Reasoning (structured decomposition, pairwise weighting), Interpretability (auditable AHP pipeline), and Prompting/Evaluation (new expert-annotated legal benchmark, LLM-as-judge criteria check). Novelty is moderate: it credibly claims the first end-to-end LLM AHP workflow and first manually AHP-annotated legal benchmark, but builds on LEGALBENCH and prior partial AHP-LLM work (Doe & Liu 2023; Svoboda & Lande 2024; Lu et al. 2024a). Rigor is undercut by a very small gold set (60 QA pairs after removing 12/20 annotation groups), no variance/significance reporting despite 3 runs, and an unvalidated LLM-as-judge (Qwen3-30B) for criteria alignment. Evidence is mixed but honestly reported: large gains for GPT-4o-mini (73.3%→81.7%, Table 4) coexist with severe degradation for Mistral (68.3%→36.7%), and the portability claim is inconsistent (QS: Qwen drops 24.4%→20.0%; U.S. News: GPT drops 68.9%→60.0%). Generalizability is only partially supported by two top-10 university ranking tasks. Reproducibility is decent: prompts in Appendix E, fixed temperature 0.7, named models, dataset in supplementary (anonymized release promised), but no code release for the framework.

However, the opacity of their internal reasoning makes it difficult to validate or interpret their outputs, and the need for interpretability becomes especially critical in high-stakes settings. This study examines the decision-making capabilities of LLMs through the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), a classical and widely used multicriteria decision-making framework. We construct a new annotated benchmark based on AHP and
recommendations.summary_zh: 此論文探討如何讓大型語言模型（LLM）在多準則決策（MCDM）中產生透明且可稽核的推理。LLM 雖廣泛用於決策任務，但其內部推理不透明，輸出難以驗證，在高風險場景（如法律領域）尤其關鍵。作者以經典的層級分析法（Analytic Hierarchy Process, AHP）為骨架，提出首個端到端方法，讓 LLM 執行完整 AHP 流程：包括 AHP-Instruction 提示策略、單一代理人三步驟管線，以及手動建構與自動生成（採用 CaptainAgent 框架）的多代理人架構，透過成對比較推導準則權重並合成最終排序。他們亦建構 LEGAL-AHP 資料集，由法律碩士生依 AHP 標註指引對 LEGALBENCH 五個子集共 525 題進行人工標註，經一致性檢驗（CR<0.1）後保留 60 題作為黃金標準。實驗涵蓋 Llama-3-8B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct 與 GPT-4o-mini：GPT-4o-mini 獲益最大，Multi-Agent（Auto）在法律任務達 81.7% 準確率，對照人工標註決策時 AHP-Instruction 達 80.0%；Single-Agent 生成的決策準則最貼近人類推理。在大學排名任務上，AHP 框架亦展現跨領域可攜性。然而較弱模型（Mistral、LLAMA3）常因結構化提示而效能退化，標註具主觀性且資料集規模偏小。此研究證明結構化決策框架能提升 LLM 推理的可解釋性與專家判斷對齊度，但成效取決於模型能力與代理人協調機制。
